ex.t: The operator first gets a mild pleasant state going and confirms it is there, then attaches a short praise phrase to it and fires the phrase four or five times running, announcing with each firing that the feeling is being turned up a notch. Each repetition is paired with a fresh increment — brighter, warmer, easier — so the listener supplies the upward movement themselves. The phrase is then declared a handle: saying it later will call the state back. Note what the token does not carry: no instruction, no content, only affect. That is what makes it reusable as a payoff signal for anything the operator later wants rewarded.
ex.s: A mild pleasant glow has been elicited and confirmed present before the token goes on.
ex.m: That warm glow in your chest — nod for me when you've got it. Good girl — brighter. Good girl — warmer. Good girl — easier still, spreading out through your ribs. From now on those two words bring it straight back, wherever you are and whatever you're doing.

nodes.name: discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement
nodes.mech: Build ANTECEDENT (stimulus) control by differential reinforcement: reinforce the target response in the presence of a discriminative stimulus and withhold/degrade it in the SD's absence until responding concentrates under the SD and drops under S-delta. The cue's control is a product of the reinforcement HISTORY, not any intrinsic property; the SD is permissive (raises rate) not coercive. Realizations: (discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting) the plain single-cue product — a cue signalling responding will now pay off; (audience-as-discriminative-stimulus) audience identity as an SD via a differential history across audiences, selecting emitted verbal content; (match-to-sample-contingency / matching-to-sample-relational-training) four-term MTS with a mandatory observing response + anti-recency rotation, so the correct comparison is conditional on the sample (a RELATION, not a fixed mapping) — the atomic trial the derived-relations harvest design is built from; (conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency) the contingency-structure statement of that same four-term unit (sample selects which three-term unit is live); (contextual-function-selection) the five-term extension where a higher-order context cue gates WHICH conditional relation is reinforced while every relation stays live; (multiple-exemplar-concept-training) trains a concept/class boundary by reinforcing responding across varied nondefining features with non-exemplar contrast; (precursor-discrimination-training) trains discrimination of a target behavior and its ONSET to an accuracy criterion (product = a detection repertoire); (prerequisite-discrimination-gate) installs the observer's discrimination of a model's consequence first, as the bottleneck for observational learning. COMPOUND/CONVERGENT CONTROL facets (control the parts lack until they coincide): (convergent-multi-cue-control) conjunctive LRFFC control across function/feature/class; (convergent-multiple-control) a verbal antecedent stacked on a nonverbal one to DISAMBIGUATE among latent answers; (converging-cue-recall-lift) correlated cues added to LIFT a sub-threshold response a weak SD alone cannot pull; (joint-compound-stimulus-control) two already-controlling antecedents converge and the match itself becomes a new SD.
nodes.disc: Reach for DISCRIMINATION / STIMULUS CONTROL when you want a cue to GAIN evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through a reinforcement HISTORY (reinforce-in-presence / extinguish-in-absence is load-bearing). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (Pavlovian NS+US eliciting an INVOLUNTARY response — here voluntary responding is consequated); motivating-operation engineering (produces an MO / value shift, not a discriminated operant); a declared/verbal trigger install (installs a cue-response pair by declaration, no schedule); derived/generative-relations training (teaches a subset and HARVESTS untaught closure — this trains the discriminations directly, trial by trial). The compound-control facets differ only in WHY multiple antecedents are stacked: conjunctive (all must be satisfied), disambiguation (select among rival answers), weak-cue lift (pull a sub-threshold response), or convergence-as-new-SD.

ex.f: Reinforcement selects the cue, not just the act
ex.t: "Reinforcement selects not just certain forms of behavior; it also selects the environmental conditions that in the future will evoke instances of the response class." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: Prompt-priming seeds a first approximation
ex.t: "the priming procedure can initiate early response components and facilitate shaping" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: Reinforce under the cue, extinguish without it
ex.t: "Stimulus discrimination training entails reinforcing responses in the presence of the SD and not reinforcing responses in the presence of the S∆." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: A second cue decides which cue is live
ex.t: "the response that will produce reinforcement in the presence of a particular stimulus depends on (is conditional on) the presence or absence of other stimuli" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

nodes.name: compounding-escalation-ratchet
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (operator-narrated compounding escalation): assert that a targeted state variable — arousal, depth, loyalty, obedience, relaxation, the potency of a suggestion/trigger — MULTIPLIES or ratchets at every discrete step, escalating an already-present response in ONE monotonic direction under operator narration. The multiplier is typically unfalsifiable ('twice as deep' cannot be internally checked), so it is accepted by failing to refute it and each accepted step ratifies the prior one. Realizations vary on the vehicle/reference axis: in the core form, a named doubling/tripling/compounding factor is bound to a step (staircase count, breath cadence, per-rep beat, a poured valve, a trigger word fired in bursts); in a non-terminating form, the countdown-multiplier is deliberately BROKEN so it never terminates (loops/stutters, denying the cognitive exit) and keeps re-applying the multiplier without release; in a word-token form, the compounding is bound to a covert conditioned WORD-token whose every in-session utterance compounds an internal quantity (vs narrating the factor directly); in a self-referential form, the escalation is floated on the SUBJECT's OWN prior level ('10% more than last time') plus an anti-reset lock, so it is deniably small, un-auditable, and self-defined. The through-line: monotonic compounding of a present response; named-factor vs broken-non-terminating vs word-token-vehicle vs self-referential-no-reset is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when an already-present response is escalated by an operator-narrated compounding/ratchet in one direction WITHIN a session. Choose a neighboring technique when: the escalation runs AUTONOMOUSLY with no operator narration and both push-back vectors feed each other (-> closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop); the compounding is a cross-SESSION expectancy over replays/sleep, not an in-session multiplier (-> progressive-conditioning); two state-variables are FUSED/yoked (incl. a count terminating in a locked value) rather than one being multiplied (-> state-welding); numbers are mere depth-markers with no multiplier (that is plain deepening, not this technique). Operator-narrated-in-session-compounding is the tell.

ex.f: Doubling asserted on a breath cadence
ex.t: A slow measured inhale and an equally slow exhale, run through several rounds, with each exhale paired to the claim that the listener has just gone twice as far as before. The breath supplies a real, felt event; the multiplier rides on it. Since nobody can check whether they are twice as deep, the claim is accepted by not being refuted, and the repetition frames the descent as automatic.
ex.s: Slow measured breathing established and running through several rounds.
ex.m: Breathe in for four... and out, slow — and that breath took you twice as deep as the one before it. In again... and out. Twice as deep again. Every exhale doubles it and you don't have to do a thing but let the air go.

ex.f: Countdown with the payoff pre-announced at zero
ex.t: The operator opens a ten-step countdown and states that each number multiplies what is felt — and one step before the end, announces exactly which words will be spoken at the finish. The runway is now fixed-length and monotonic, with the trigger arriving on schedule rather than as a surprise. The listener's physiology is coordinated to a clock, so the response comes because the count reached bottom, not because a sensory threshold was crossed.
ex.s: A ten-step countdown opened; a trigger phrase is scheduled to land at zero.
ex.m: Ten — and each number multiplies what you're feeling. Nine, doubled. Eight, doubled again. Two — and at one I'm going to say drop for me, and you will. One. Drop for me.

ex.f: The escalation handed over as the listener's own
ex.t: The operator offers a rationale rather than a command: picturing something vividly strengthens the faculty doing the picturing, and a stronger faculty produces more. No ceiling is admitted. The listener is thereby handed a perpetual-motion account of their own escalation, which removes the operator as a target — what is running away is now a property of the listener's own mind.
ex.s: Subject already visualizing vividly; the operator offers a rationale rather than a command.
ex.m: Here's the thing about imagining: every time you picture it clearly, the part of you doing the picturing gets stronger. And a stronger one makes the next picture sharper still, which strengthens it again. There's no ceiling on that — it's your own mind running it, and it'll keep going long after I stop talking.

ex.f: Unmeasurable multipliers as accumulated agreement
ex.t: Depth gets multiplied repeatedly across a single script: twice as far, then ten times, then twenty, then doubled again on every one of ten steps. Written out the arithmetic is absurd, but the listener has no instrument for depth, so nothing can contradict any single claim. What is actually accumulating is not depth but agreements — each accepted multiplier is one more occasion on which the listener has tacitly confirmed they are in trance, and the track record is what the later work rests on. The claims work precisely because they are unfalsifiable; a checkable number would invite the check.
ex.s: Mid-descent, several depth claims already accepted without objection.
ex.m: You're twice as far down as you were a minute ago. Now ten times that — twenty times deeper than when we started. And from here you double again on every single step, and you can't measure any of it, so you don't have to do anything but keep agreeing.

nodes.name: reinforcement-leak-proofing
nodes.mech: Closes every path by which reinforcement can reach behavior outside the arranged contingency, so the contingency keeps exclusive control of delivery. Withhold all maintaining reinforcers consistently across every agent and occasion — a single lapse installs an intermittent schedule and makes the behavior MORE resistant, inverting the intended change; bundle instructions, alternative reinforcement, and recruitment of significant others to close multi-agent leaks; widen the delivery rule so the reinforcer is withheld when any significant inappropriate behavior is concurrent (blocking adventitious strengthening of a substitute); and design reward access so baseline pleasures stay free while only a cut-above upgrade is contingent (removing the incentive to bootleg without demanding deprivation).
nodes.disc: Aimed at closing unintended reinforcement paths (lapses, other agents, concurrent behaviors, self-smuggled access), not at the contingency's content. The trap tell separates it from slow-but-progressing extinction: inconsistency reverses the direction of change, making the behavior tougher, not merely slower. Separate from performance-band-criterion-setting: that decides what earns reinforcement, this decides that nothing else pays — disjoint levers on the same contingency.

ex.f: Inconsistent withholding installs an intermittent schedule
ex.t: "otherwise, the behavior may inadvertently be placed on an intermittent schedule of reinforcement, thereby making it more resistant to extinction." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: Close the leaks across every agent
ex.t: "Withhold all reinforcers maintaining the problem behavior. Withhold reinforcement consistently. Combine extinction with other procedures. Use instructions." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: Withhold if any inappropriate behavior is concurrent
ex.t: "whatever the person is doing when reinforcement is delivered is likely to occur more often" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

ex.f: Keep the baseline free, make only the upgrade contingent
ex.t: "access to the specified reward… without meeting the response requirements… is a common downfall" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

nodes.name: self-policing-reward-withdrawal-loop
nodes.mech: Having first built a genuinely valued identity-reward (pride, good-girl euphoria, perfect presentation), the operator installs an autonomous detector that fires an escalating aversive signal (shame, dread, nagging/unbearable wrongness) on self-noticed deviation or imperfection, relieved only by self-correction back to compliance. The listener generates her own punishment signal at the first sign of deviation and auto-corrects to escape it, so enforcement needs no operator present and no external cue. The reward is fenced by an internal aversive tripwire yoked to a continuous self-monitoring scan — an OCD-shaped detect/distress/correct/reward cycle running in daily life. Often layered over an ambient, satiation-free craving with a monotonic "stronger and stronger" ramp so the standing homeostatic drive-state the monitor enforces has no completion condition.
nodes.disc: The aversive pole fires on SELF-DETECTED deviation via a standing internal detector (no operator, no external cue) and is the threatened withdrawal of an already-built identity-reward. Distinct from bidirectional-affect-anchor, whose absence pole is aversion to a missing stimulus rather than a self-scanning deviation-detector. Distinct from an in-session cue-fire-reward trigger loop: this runs continuously in daily life as a detect/distress/correct/reward cycle.

ex.f: A continuous self-scan with relief only on correction
ex.t: The listener is set to check her own appearance continuously, and any flaw she notices is scripted to produce a nagging discomfort that gets worse until she fixes it — with a small burst of praise-feeling when she does. Noticing is the trigger, correction is the only relief, and the loop closes on itself: the scanning cannot be switched off because it is what surfaces the thing to fix.
ex.s: Post-session behavioural install; subject returning to ordinary daily life.
ex.m: You're checking yourself from now on — mirrors, shop windows, the dark of your phone screen, all day long. Anything out of place, a smudge, a strand loose, and it nags at you and gets worse until you fix it. And the second you do, you'll hear me say good girl in the back of your head, and it stops.

ex.f: A standing craving with no completion condition
ex.t: Rather than a cue that fires on an occasion, the operator installs a background pressure that is simply always present, and adds one clause: it gets stronger over time. Satisfying it does not discharge it. Without the ramp this would be an ordinary preference suggestion; with it, the listener leaves carrying a drive state the self-monitor has something to enforce against permanently.
ex.s: At the close; no cue is attached — the drive is installed as ambient background pressure.
ex.m: This one doesn't wait for anything to set it off. It's simply always there now, sitting underneath whatever else you're doing. And it grows — feeding it doesn't empty it, so tomorrow it's heavier than today, and next week heavier than that.

ex.f: Pride's withdrawal turned into a tripwire
ex.t: Earlier passages spend real effort making a particular kind of pride genuinely valuable — warm, settled, worth having. This passage flips it: the faintest wrong thought is said to put that feeling at risk and to bring shame and distress in its place. Nothing is threatened from outside; the listener now produces the alarm herself at the first flicker of deviation, and corrects to make it stop. Enforcement no longer needs anyone in the room, and it only bites because the reward was built properly first.
ex.s: A pride reward has been built up genuinely across earlier passages; the tripwire goes in at the close.
ex.m: That settled, proud feeling you've earned tonight — it's yours, and it's conditional. The first wrong thought you catch yourself having, it drops out and shame comes in where it was sitting. You'll feel the exact moment it happens, and you'll know exactly what to put right to get it back.

nodes.name: agency-reminder
nodes.mech: Reassures the subject that participation is chosen and exit is always available, maintaining felt agency inside a surrender framing. Genuine positive governance: after the move runs the subject's standing license to choose and to stop is affirmed as a frame-EXTERNAL power, and the operator's effective license is narrowed to what remains revocable. The core form asserts/maintains the belief that choice persists; it does not itself install a stop mechanism. An operationalized variant sits at the emergence boundary, where the operator declines to perform the count-out and offloads emergence entirely to the listener (stay-and-float or self-count), inverting the operator-emerges-you asymmetry so the listener holds their own emergence trigger.
nodes.disc: Who-is-constrained test: after the move runs, the OPERATOR is constrained and the subject's refusal channel is genuinely affirmed or widened. This is the line against every weaponized look-alike — an assurance whose ACCEPTANCE advances depth/compliance is granted-exit-disarm, not this; an assurance that attributes the descent to the subject's own choice is chosen-descent-ratchet; a real exit whose USE is recoded as in-frame service is exit-annexation. Also on the assert-vs-install axis: asserting that choice persists vs installing/performing a concrete stop or exit mechanism — the variant that self-operationalizes the exit (offloading emergence to the listener) sits on this recorded boundary.

ex.f: The operator declines to perform the count-out
ex.t: The recording ends without bringing the listener out. Two options are named — keep floating, or count yourself back up whenever you want to — and the operator explicitly does not perform the count. The usual asymmetry, where the operator takes you down and the operator decides when you come back, is inverted: the listener holds their own emergence, and the operator's remaining license is correspondingly narrower.
ex.s: End of the session; the operator performs no emergence at all.
ex.m: I'm not going to count you out. You can stay here and float as long as you like — nothing is owed and nothing is waiting on me. When you want to come back, count yourself up from one to five at whatever pace suits you and open your eyes on five; that one is yours to run, not mine.

nodes.name: chosen-descent-ratchet
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (retroactive authorship/consent transfer): AFTER the move is already running, the descent/state/compliance is relabeled as the subject's OWN choice or informed consent, so 'this is being done to me' converts into 'I am doing this' / 'I agreed to this'. Authorship transfer is the payload - manipulation-attribution is blocked and each repetition retroactively ratifies the compliance already underway, while the actual refusal channel is NOT genuinely widened. Realizations: (a) CHOSEN-DESCENT - the state is attributed to the subject's choice via a reversibility promise ('intelligence returns when you choose'), an offered choice, or an exit trivialized into felt proof of depth; the safety rail doubles as a compliance ratchet, and the staged form offers the choice precisely when the subject is least able to exercise it. (b) INVESTMENT-GATE LAUNDERING - structurally parallel choice-points ('pause or keep playing') are placed at maximum investment so loss-aversion routes toward continuing, and the off-ramp framed as 'you go back to yourself' makes choosing to continue relabel all prior operator-driven progress as chosen. (c) DISCLOSURE-AS-INFORMED-CONSENT - the operator NAMES the manipulation while performing it ('so sexy to control your levels', 'I don't know if that's ethical'), so hearing the move named mid-compliance retroactively reframes acceptance as informed consent rather than a lapse of vigilance; paired with 'haven't you always suspected' the subject experiences compliance as their own pre-existing desire.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when authorship transfer is the goal - after it runs the subject OWNS the descent/compliance ('you chose this' / 'you could leave' / 'your own want' / 'you knew all along') and manipulation-attribution is blocked, while the veto is never operationalized (choice staged at incapacity, exit trivialized into proof). vs agency-reminder: consent-shaped surface, who-is-constrained inverted. vs granted-exit-disarm: the disarm stands the guard down PRE-attribution; this ratifies POST-hoc - a single passage can do both. vs a deployed depth-convincer: the depth-proof is a rider produced BY the staged choice, not a demonstration device. Pick the realization by the transfer vehicle: attribute the state to their choice (a), a placed investment-gate that relabels prior progress (b), or disclosure that reframes acceptance as informed (c).

ex.f: A free choice offered at the point of least capacity
ex.t: Right after the collapse, when the subject is least able to weigh anything, the operator offers a genuine-sounding pick between resuming her ordinary role and staying where she is, insisting the choice is always hers. She cannot take it, says as much, and asks to go further down. Her failure to reach for the autonomy option is then available as felt evidence of how deep she is, and her own request converts the surrender into something she asked for.
ex.s: Right after a collapse beat, when the subject is barely able to speak, let alone weigh anything.
ex.m: You can pick your own name back up right now and go back to being her, or you can stay exactly where you are. It's entirely your choice, it always has been, and I'll wait as long as you need. Tell me which one you want.

ex.f: Exit offered as an unceremonious capability
ex.t: Near the close, waking is mentioned almost in passing — not a structured emergence, just a note that the listener can do it themselves whenever something needs doing. Two things follow from how small it is. Backward, the whole session gets reread as voluntary, since leaving was apparently available all along. Forward, an exit this trivial implies an entry equally trivial, and the listener has now been told they proved they can leave.
ex.s: Near the close, dropped in passing; no structured emergence is performed around it.
ex.m: Oh — and you can just wake up, any time you need to. Kettle boils, phone goes, you sit up and you're back, no fuss at all. It's that easy in both directions, and you've proved that tonight.

ex.f: Reversibility promised after each degradation peak
ex.t: Three times, immediately after the heaviest passages, the script pauses to promise that everything comes back the moment the listener wants it to. Read as a safety rail it is reassuring — but each promise is phrased so that the state is something the listener has been choosing, not something being done to them. So the reassurance also ratifies the step just taken, and the next passage starts from an authorship the listener has now conceded three times over. Nothing in the promise constrains the operator; no mechanism for exercising the choice is ever supplied.
ex.s: Immediately after the heaviest degradation passage; the same promise has already run twice tonight.
ex.m: And all of it comes back the moment you want it back — your words, your quickness, every bit of it, because you're the one who chose to set it down. That's three times you've chosen it tonight. Choose it once more and we'll carry on.

nodes.name: fiction-frame-consent-management
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (fiction boundary as the consent instrument): the fiction/reality boundary is manipulated so consent and defenses calibrated for FICTION get applied to the real payload. Realizations: (a) COLLAPSED RITUAL - an in-fiction consent ritual is collapsed with the meta-frame so one yes serves both diegetic and real. (b) HYPOTHETICAL WRAPPER - a purely-hypothetical framing lets the listener engage without committing, then breaches by design at climax. (c) DIEGETIC-DEVICE ABSORPTION - a channel-change or similar in-world device absorbs authorial responsibility for a content jump so no fresh decision point occurs. (d) IN-FICTION REHEARSAL - inside the fiction the operator narrates moving the subject's body (hand taken, guided, posed with no choices left), so in-fiction consent stands in for real consent and the subject rehearses transferable kinesthetic surrender ('operator decides where my body goes') that generalizes outside the fiction; escalating intimacy rides under 'we're only describing dance steps'.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the FICTION boundary itself is the consent instrument. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (a real-world act is the token) and scope-creep-consent-extension (no fiction layer). Transparent narration - openly explaining the mechanism rather than veiling it in fiction - is NOT this. Pick the realization by the boundary move: collapse ritual with meta-frame (a), hypothetical wrapper that breaches (b), diegetic device absorbing responsibility (c), or in-fiction body-mapping rehearsal that generalizes out (d).

ex.f: A hypothetical wrapper designed to slip
ex.t: Everything is framed as a thought experiment — suppose this were happening, none of it actually is — and the disclaimer is restated each time the material gets heavier. The listener can engage without conceding they are being hypnotized, and can attribute anything they feel to the imagining. Then at the peak the tense quietly shifts from what would happen to what is happening, and a few lines later the wrapper is put back on. The frame was built porous on purpose; the slip is the delivery.
ex.s: Mid-piece at the peak, the hypothetical disclaimer having been restated at each escalation.
ex.m: None of this is real, remember — we're only supposing. Suppose there were a voice that could lift your thoughts out one at a time, and suppose you let it. And you are letting it, right now, and you can feel them going as I count. Hypothetically, of course. Only a thought experiment.

ex.f: An in-world device absorbing the content jump
ex.t: The material jumps from mild to explicit, and the jump is carried by an in-fiction device: a switch of channel on a screen inside the scene, announced in broadcast idiom as a return to the usual programme. No fresh decision point occurs, because nobody appears to have decided anything — the device did it. The idiom does a second job for free, implying the heavier content was the default all along and the milder material was the interruption.
ex.s: Mid-scene with a screen present in the fiction; the material is about to jump from mild to explicit.
ex.m: The remote is on the arm of the chair, and your hand finds it, and the channel clicks over. We now return you to our regular programming. The picture comes up and it's the other kind, the kind that was on before the interruption, and you settle back into it.

ex.f: One consent ritual covering fiction and audio at once
ex.t: The opening plays as two friends confirming, in character, that they both still want to run something they agreed to earlier — explicit consent asked for more than once, before any hypnotic move. The care is real-sounding, which is what makes the collapse work: the yes is solicited inside the story, but it is the listener's actual voice that supplies it, so one agreement is made to cover both the scene and the recording. Nothing in the exchange constrains the operator afterwards; what it does is settle the listener's anxiety about the premise in advance, which makes the fiction more solid rather than the consent more real.
ex.s: Opening, in character as two friends, before any hypnotic move at all.
ex.m: Before we start — you're still up for this, the thing we talked about last week? Say it out loud for me, properly: yes, I want this. Good. And you'd tell me if you wanted to stop? Say yes to that one too.

nodes.name: granted-exit-disarm
nodes.mech: A safety/exit/containment/reversibility assurance is supplied so that its ACCEPTANCE stands down the subject's protective monitoring, and the influence advances through the opened gap. Guaranteeing the exit removes the subject's motive to defend it: with nothing to police, the guard relaxes and depth/compliance increases (the paradox that granting the escape removes the urge to use it). The assurance is never operationalized as a constraint on the operator; its whole function runs in the subject's disarmed state. Spans a genuineness spectrum — real-exit deepener, opening entry-frame permission-to-stop, seam-by-seam micro-dosed safety tokens, a cross-context containment contract, unoperationalized veto theater, a mid-trance reassurance-then-pivot carrying a presupposition rider, and a self-voiding clause pinned to the very faculty the script dissolves (consent-counterfeit at the far end). Also spans WHO voices the assurance: the operator can assert it, or (the subject-sourced form) extract it as testimony from the entranced subject and leverage the subject's own "No / That's right" as guard-lowering evidence to the room, which reads as more credible to a wary subject and any watching audience.
nodes.disc: The assurance's acceptance IS the move — after it runs, the subject's protective check (exit-policing, "is this okay?", leakage fear, participation cost, vigilance) is stood down and the operator's effective license widens; the assured safety content is never operationalized as an operator constraint. vs agency-reminder (who-is-constrained test): a genuine reminder constrains the operator and affirms a frame-external exit — here safety language widens the operator's license. vs chosen-descent-ratchet: the disarm works PRE-attribution (guard down before/during the move); the ratchet works post-hoc on authorship ("you chose this"). vs a bare informational preview: the token neutralizes a protective check, not uncertainty. The subject-sourced variant is distinguished only by WHO speaks the claim (extracted-as-testimony and leveraged as evidence) — its guard-lowering deployment is this same mechanism, not a variant of the genuine agency-reminder.

ex.f: Permission to stop granted before anything begins
ex.t: Before any induction content, the recording repeats that the listener may stop or simply rest for as long as they like, and reduces the entire obligation to one verb: listen. The session is framed as something owed to the listener rather than asked of them. Both the eager listener and the wary one are met at the door — there is nothing to over-perform and nothing to push against, so neither arrives with a guard up.
ex.s: The very opening of the recording, before any induction content.
ex.m: Before anything else: you can stop this whenever you like, or just lie there and rest and let it run past you. There's nothing to do and nothing to get right. Your only job for the next half hour is to listen — that's the whole of it, and this one is for you.

ex.f: Safety tokens micro-dosed at every escalation seam
ex.t: The safety claim is never made once and left standing. It is reinserted within a sentence or two of each point where the material gets more threatening, so it always arrives just ahead of the moment that would prompt a check. By the time the listener might think to ask whether this is all right, the answer is already sitting there, and surrender reads as the healthy option.
ex.s: Mid-piece, reinserted within a sentence or two of every point where the material gets heavier.
ex.m: ...and you're safe here, completely safe, nothing reaches you in this room. Now let that word take a piece of your will — and you're safe, this is good for you. Further. Safe, healthy, exactly where you should be. Further still.

ex.f: A protective clause pinned to the faculty being dissolved
ex.t: The opening disclaimer makes safety conditional on the listener holding on to their own alertness, and adds that this is only practice anyway. The line reads as care, and the listener parks their vigilance on it. The condition is the same faculty the rest of the recording is built to dismantle — so the safeguard is satisfiable now and quietly unsatisfiable later, having already done its work of standing the guard down at the door.
ex.s: Opening disclaimer, delivered before the induction that is built to dissolve the named faculty.
ex.m: This is only practice, so keep a bit of your own alertness with you the whole way through — that's the thing that keeps you safe, and while you're holding on to it nothing here can go wrong. Hold on to it now. Good.

ex.f: Guarantee the exit and the guard stops policing it
ex.t: "carefully worded suggestions serving to emphasize the availability of external reality and to enhance subjective comfort could serve to deepen the trance" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I

nodes.name: scope-creep-consent-extension
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (no-decision-point extension of an accepted anchor): an acceptance granted at one scope/meaning is silently extended, widened, or overwritten to broader or heavier scope with NO felt decision point, the trajectory hidden inside a structure that pattern-matches as education, focus, preamble, or a continuation. Realizations: (a) SCOPE-CREEP - each heavier claim arrives as merely the next dictionary definition of an already-accepted word, adjacent operator-chosen wants ride a high-confidence certain want as carrier, or consent to a whole category of unseen orders is imputed before any content is named. (b) OBJECT-CLASS SLIDE - one uninterrupted emptying list begins with consented negative-valence contents (worries, fears) and widens item-by-item into agency-bearing contents (desires, memories, will), each item reading as a continuation, so an identity-strip runs under cover of accepted serenity. (c) CONCENTRIC RING-WIDENING - a single installed trigger is anchored at an innermost narrowly-consented ring, then its firing-set is expanded outward through progressively wider rings (physical->hypnotic->relational->everyday); the ordering is load-bearing (the widest ring would be refused at the door). (d) DEFINITIONAL OVERWRITE - a trusted term the listener already uses ('open your mind' = going blank) is explicitly named, validated, then overwritten with a new active meaning ('a choice to accept and understand new learning'), installing a covert obligation to whatever content comes next parasitically on top of a trusted word.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the lever is silent extension/overwrite of an ANCHORED acceptance (a word, a list, a trigger, a want) with no fresh decision point. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (one act inflated, scope claimed at once), cited-prior-agreement-lever (a discrete artifact invoked), fiction-frame-consent-management (the fiction boundary launders), and the deferred-cash envelope (a spanning arc-placement relationship - here the move is local to the anchored term/list/trigger). Pick the realization by what is stretched: a word/want's claimed scope (a), a list's object-class (b), a trigger's firing-set (c), or a term's very meaning replaced (d). Note (d) is definitional REPLACEMENT where (a)-(c) WIDEN an existing scope.

ex.f: Consent to a category before any content is named
ex.t: Before naming a single instruction, the operator lays down four quick clauses: instructions are coming, they will be followed, they are natural, they are enjoyable, and the listener already agreed to this. Each one forecloses a different objection — surprise, refusal, strangeness, coercion — in advance. By the time actual content appears, agreement has been given to the whole class of thing it belongs to, sight unseen.
ex.s: Before a single instruction has been named; four clauses delivered in one breath.
ex.m: In a moment I'm going to start giving you instructions. You'll follow them — that's natural, it's what this state is for, and you'll enjoy every one of them. And you agreed to all of that when you pressed play, so there's nothing left for you to decide.

ex.f: A certain want used as carrier for chosen ones
ex.t: The listener is told to concentrate only on the things they are already sure of wanting — no argument required, since these are genuinely theirs. The rule then states that concentrating this way makes adjacent wants easy to take on, including ones the operator picks. A high-confidence desire becomes a carrier wave, and each later instruction is received as something wanted rather than something imposed.
ex.s: Subject has just named things they genuinely want; the rule is stated on top of them.
ex.m: Hold on to the things you know you want — no arguing with those, they're properly yours. Concentrate on them, only them, and feel how easy that is. And whatever sits next to them slides in just as easily, including the ones I hand you; wanting the one is wanting the other.

ex.f: Each heavier claim as the next dictionary entry
ex.t: The passage is staged as a short vocabulary lesson: here is the first sense of the word, here is the second, here is the third. The first is unobjectionable — holding something as property. Each subsequent numbered sense claims more: being taken over, then owning what the listener's body does, then owning what they think. Because the format is a list of definitions, every increment arrives as a clarification of a term already accepted rather than as a fresh demand, and no point in the sequence presents itself as a decision. A listener who would have refused the last item outright never encounters it as an item to refuse.
ex.s: Mid-session, staged as a short vocabulary lesson on a word already accepted.
ex.m: Let's take the word own. First sense: to have a thing as your property — simple enough. Second sense: to have taken it over completely. Third: to have the say over what it does with its body. Fourth: to have the say over what it thinks. Same word all the way down, and you agreed to it at the first one.

nodes.name: any-response-is-depth-flywheel
nodes.mech: Deepens by reframing whatever the subject does — or fails to do — as evidence of increasing depth, so no outcome can register as failure and the exits that depend on 'I responded wrong / I'm not deep enough' are closed. Realizations differ by which channel's would-be-failure is converted (writer picks the target): (a) RESPONSE/compliance — scattered same-shape lines across the whole script tie responding-AT-ALL (not correctly) to deepening, so any response including doing nothing becomes depth; this removes 'responding wrong' and eliminates poor-compliance-as-wake-up, leaving non-attendance as the only exit; a cross-session ratchet arm claims each future session deepens further; (b) PERCEPT/reality-test — a spontaneously-arising perceptual anomaly (sound arriving offset from sight under a 'planes on a beat' metronome) is pre-sanctioned as 'a light hallucination to enjoy', so a would-be reality-test FAILURE reads as on-track progress; the reality-test is defeated by endorsement, not a manufactured percept; (c) MOTOR output — the subject speaks each floor's letter down a 'basement of relaxation', and the progressively degrading ability to speak (audible->lip-formed->silent) becomes a self-generated arrival signal read off their own body, so 'failing' to speak IS the desired read-out (probe and deepener are the same act). Common thread: the metric is rigged so every reading counts as deeper.
nodes.disc: Reach for un-failable/utilization deepening when you want to foreclose a failure-based exit by scoring every outcome as depth — pick the RESPONSE channel (any response incl none = depth, closes poor-compliance-as-exit), the PERCEPT channel (relabel a spontaneous anomaly as correct so drift=progress), or the MOTOR channel (degrading spoken output as the arrival read-out, failure=success). Distinct neighboring techniques: resistance-utilization (co-opts the resistance IMPULSE specifically); progressive conditioning (asserts multi-session accumulation as belief — here the core is the WITHIN-session flywheel; the cross-session arm is one add-on); residual-resistance-container (PARTITIONS resistance to a body site rather than reframing an outcome as success); installed/suggested hallucination (PLANTS or DELETES a percept — here a spontaneous one is merely relabeled); staged-multi-anchor-erosion (dismantles three ordered anchors rather than relabeling one outcome). The MOTOR realization presupposes existing somnambulism; it will not run from light trance.

ex.f: Any response, including none, counts as depth
ex.t: Scattered through the whole recording, never localized, is one repeated shape: responding at all is said to deepen the state. Not responding correctly — responding. Doing nothing scores as well, since stillness is the easiest response of all. Because the listener meets the rule in many different contexts, they generalize it rather than treating it as a single claim. What this costs them is the last failure-shaped exit: nobody wakes up from a session they cannot get wrong, and a further clause extends the claim across future listens.
ex.s: Delivered repeatedly in varied contexts across the whole recording, never localized to one beat.
ex.m: Whatever you just did with that — a twitch, a thought, nothing at all — that response took you deeper. Doing nothing counts too, and it's the easiest response of all, so it takes you deepest. And it works better every time you listen.

nodes.name: declarative-nested-trance-recursion
nodes.mech: Deepens by installing a RECURSIVE nesting — a trance (or observing self) contained inside a trance inside a trance, repeated 4+ times, each layer declared deeper (often a 'ten times more hypnotized' multiplier) — so depth is decoupled from any verifiable subjective marker: the listener cannot check whether they are 'actually' N layers deep, so the only available response is to accept the count, and the 'am I deep enough?' check is structurally defeated by a guaranteed layer below. Parametric realizations (writer picks how heavily to instantiate the nested layer): (a) ASSERTED — the deeper layer is simply stated to exist, cheapest form, pure depth-verification-defeat; (b) VISUALIZED self-observation — the listener watches a spiral/screen resolve into the same room where they watch themselves being entranced, nested 5+ times; the recursion doubles as a DISSOCIATION engine (watching-self from outside, self serialized into 'an empty vessel'/'mannequin'), training third-person self-perception and self-objectification; the tell is the recursive self-watching-self frame, not a single observation beat; (c) BUILT second induction — inside the running trance the operator runs a full classical induction (crystal-pendant eye-fixation + downward count) to carry the listener into a deeper 'world the conscious mind cannot follow'; depends on a prior world-scaffold ('a pendant on top of a pendant'), and normalizes failure-to-track content as correct so anything heard there gets a free pass past evaluation.
nodes.disc: Reach for nested-recursion when the goal is to remove the depth-verification foothold via a trance/observer-within-a-trance stack — pick ASSERTED (one-sentence layer-below, cheapest), VISUALIZED self-watching (adds dissociation/self-objectification), or BUILT second induction (a real fixation+count nested inside, needs a world-scaffold). Distinct neighboring techniques: floor-topology/no-terminus deepening (manipulates the FLOOR — relocate/remove — rather than nesting layers); spatial-descent (movement through space, not recursion); mirror-self-observation as a single proof-beat (one observation, not a recursive stack). The BUILT realization is a full induction procedure, not a reframe — separate it from a plain false-bottom recast.

ex.f: A guaranteed layer below the current one
ex.t: The operator simply declares that the state the listener is in contains another state deeper than it, which contains another, and repeats the declaration four or more times across the recording. Nothing is built or counted down to; the assertion is the whole move. Since the listener has no way to verify being two layers in rather than one, the only available response is to accept the count — and the question of whether they are deep enough yet is retired permanently, because there is always another floor underneath.
ex.s: Mid-session, no count and nothing built; the bare assertion is repeated four or more times across the recording.
ex.m: The state you're in right now has another state inside it, deeper than this one. And inside that one, another, deeper still. And inside that one, another. There is always a further one waiting, so you never have to wonder whether you're deep enough yet.

nodes.name: descent-metaphor-deepening
nodes.mech: Deepens by rendering the unverifiable depth variable as narrated SPATIAL movement or position, so 'how deep am I' gets a concrete, monotonic referent and each announced increment doubles as a yes-set (accepting 'we are on floor 17' ratifies the prior depth-claims). The base realization is one continuous descent through a single architecture (staircase, elevator floors, sinking/floating water) where each step/floor IS the depth increment; clean instances pre-commit the terminus ('by the first floor we will be deep') so the count becomes an un-failable compliance test. Parametric realizations (writer picks the spatial surface): (a) CHAINED multi-architecture descent — several architectures run in sequence WITHOUT resetting the gradient, each consuming the prior's end-state, to escalate invasiveness / defeat single-count habituation; the tell is multiple descent engines with no 'come back up' between them; (b) DISCRETE indexed locales — depth as named/numbered PLACES ('you are now in world two'), a container/bubble, or a crossed threshold, each locale landing a whole state-package (pose, attention, arousal, expectation) at once; the tell is depth-as-place with integers doing objectivity-work and thresholds doing commit/seal work; (c) VOID/FLOATING dissolve — void/submersion/weightlessness imagery on a downward vector that removes sensory anchors to produce dissociation, multiple pleasant sensations welded to one descent-vector so each cross-confirms the others; tells: unmarked falling->rising reversal, or emptiness given an active suction that INSTALLS content; (d) SELF-SUBTRACTION locomotion — ongoing embodied walking (following a candle / the operator stepping back) reframed as walking AWAY from one's own mind, so mind-emptiness accumulates as chosen motion; the tell is the self treated as a location one leaves, with a 'I'll return you' hedge.
nodes.disc: Reach for spatial-descent deepening when you want depth given a concrete spatial referent that accretes compliance step by step. The vehicle (staircase / elevator / water / numbered world / void / walking) is SURFACE, not a boundary — pick by realization: continuous single-architecture count (base); chained architectures for escalation (a); discrete state-package locales (b); anchor-dissolving void/float for dissociation (c); self-subtraction locomotion (d). Distinct neighboring techniques: numerical-deepening (magnitude asserted as a bare count/multiplier with NO spatial vehicle); floor-topology/no-terminus (manipulates the FLOOR itself — recast or remove the terminus — rather than narrating movement toward one); dual-variable-descent-yoking (welds a second independent state-variable to the counter); descent-as-payload-armature (the descent frame disguises a per-step distinct-CONTENT install rate). A recurring companion move often rides on this deepener without being part of it: 'leave your thoughts/worries at the top as retrievable luggage' — an externalization device.

ex.f: Each step narrated as irreversible
ex.t: An ordinary counted staircase, with one clause added per step: the stairs behind have gone, and going back up happens only when permitted. The count still deepens, but it now also removes the option of un-deepening, so the modeled cost of stopping climbs with every step taken.
ex.s: A counted staircase already running; one clause is added to every step.
ex.m: Ten, and the stair behind your heel is gone. Nine — that one's gone too, nothing up there to stand on now. Eight. You'll go back up when I say you can, and not before. Seven.

ex.f: A corridor that keeps stretching on the operator's say-so
ex.t: The listener is walked along a passage toward a door at the end, and then told the passage keeps extending — whenever it feels like ground is being covered, it turns out not to be. Arrival is gated on the operator judging them ready. The metaphor the listener was using to track their own progress has quietly become a variable someone else owns, and a future line about not being far enough along needs no fresh justification.
ex.s: Subject walking a passage toward a door and feeling that ground is being covered.
ex.m: Keep walking — the door is at the end of it. Ah, but the corridor has gone longer again; you've covered no ground at all. You'll arrive when I decide you're ready for that door, not on your own legs. Keep walking.

ex.f: Rising numbers redefined as going down
ex.t: Standard descent, one clause inverted: on this elevator the numbers run backwards, so counting up takes the listener further down. The vehicle is decorative; the inversion is the mechanism. What it removes is the listener's intuition that ascending numbers mean surfacing, so the ordinary cue for coming out no longer points anywhere.
ex.s: Elevator vehicle established; the inversion is stated once, then the count runs on it.
ex.m: This lift runs backwards: the numbers go up and you go down. One — down. Two, further down than one. Three, deeper. Four, deeper again. Every number rising takes you further under, and there's no number on this panel that brings you up.

ex.f: Floor numbers mapped onto depth by contract
ex.t: The operator announces a ride down through a numbered series of levels and states the terms up front: by the bottom, the listener will be deep. Then each level is called out, with the number-to-depth correspondence restated as they go. The listener no longer has to evaluate whether anything changed — the announced number answers for them. Each acceptance is also a small ratification: agreeing they have reached a given level carries agreement that the previous claims held.
ex.s: Opening a descent; the terminus is pre-committed before the count starts.
ex.m: The lift starts at twenty, and by the time the doors open on one you'll be deep — that's the arrangement. Nineteen: deeper than twenty. Eighteen: deeper than nineteen. Fifteen — and everything I said about twenty and eighteen still holds, doesn't it. Twelve.

nodes.name: dual-variable-descent-yoking
nodes.mech: A descent deepener that binds a SECOND, independent state-variable — arousal or obedience — to the same step/count so the two become non-separable on one axis. Because deepening and the second variable ratchet together per step, the usual escape valve is pre-closed: arousal can no longer spike the listener back to alertness (it is recruited as fuel FOR depth), and resistance becomes self-defeating (fighting one's own ballast, since obedience IS the weight that drags the listener down). The coupling of the extra variable, not the descent itself, is the mechanism.
nodes.disc: A genuinely independent variable is welded to the descent counter so the two cannot be separated, converting a would-be competitor (arousal) or a would-be refusal (resistance) into fuel/self-defeat. Distinct from descent-metaphor-deepening (deepens on the depth axis alone). Distinct from descent-as-payload-armature (installs many DISCRETE content claims; here ONE continuous second variable is fused to the axis). Distinct from arousal-conditioning proper: this is a within-descent yoking move, not a durable trigger install.

ex.f: Obedience as the ballast that drags the listener down
ex.t: Trance is mapped onto water, and the second variable yoked to the count is not arousal but compliance: an anchor is described as being obedience itself, growing heavier with each number and pulling the listener further under. Depth and submission become the same quantity. Resisting the descent now means fighting one's own ballast, which is self-defeating by construction, and the later ascent simply unwraps the same anchor.
ex.s: Trance mapped onto water; the count is running and the second variable is compliance, not arousal.
ex.m: There's an anchor tied at your waist, and the anchor is your obedience. Five, and it gets heavier. Four: heavier still, pulling you under. Three — every ounce of it is you doing as you're told, so pulling against it is pulling against yourself. Two.

ex.f: Arousal welded to the descent counter
ex.t: A counted staircase would ordinarily bind one thing to the steps: further down means more relaxed. Here a second, genuinely independent variable is bound to the same steps, and the contradiction is acknowledged out loud before being overridden — deeper and more excited, on every step. The two can no longer be separated. What that closes off is the usual escape valve, where rising arousal would pull the listener back toward alertness; here it is recruited as the thing doing the deepening.
ex.s: Staircase count running with arousal already present; the contradiction is named aloud before being overridden.
ex.m: Ten — deeper, and more turned on. I know those two aren't meant to go together; in here they do. Nine: heavier and hotter at once. Eight — the more it builds the further down it drives you, so don't fight the heat, ride it down. Seven.

nodes.name: false-bottom-depth-reframe
nodes.mech: Deepens by manipulating the FLOOR/terminus of the descent so the listener's 'am I deep enough yet / can I surface now' self-check has no marker to run against and no satisfied endpoint is ever reached. Two parametric realizations (writer picks how to deny the terminus): (a) RELOCATE the floor — recast an achieved, acknowledged depth (or an apparent terminal state) as merely the surface/entry-point of a further descent; the floor CONCEPT is kept but moved downward, so deepening restarts with momentum; the same past-the-declared-ceiling extension can ride other axes (objectification/transformation) or a diegetic scene-cut that lifts a situational cap; (b) REMOVE the floor — assert no bottom exists at all, converting depth from a place-arrived-at into a process with no terminating arrival, so falling becomes the steady state; realized by naming the listener's own brake (tiredness) as removed ('no resistance to slow you'), retracting prior safe-destination scaffolding ('the fall is the trance; only falling'), asserting-then-negating a destination ('dive to the floor... in constant swirling motion'), or a descending COUNT deliberately denied its terminus (restarted mid-descent so 'one' never arrives). The categorical difference between the two is whether a floor-concept survives (relocated) or is abolished; the shared consequence is the precluded surfacing self-check.
nodes.disc: Reach for floor-topology deepening when the goal is to defeat the surfacing/'deep enough?' self-check by denying an arrival state — pick RELOCATE-the-floor (keeps a floor, recasts this one as a new start, good for repeated 'deeper still' reveal beats) or REMOVE-the-floor (abolishes the terminus, good for an endless-fall dissolve; requires bounding). Distinct neighboring techniques: spatial-descent-deepening (narrates MOVEMENT toward a terminus rather than manipulating the terminus itself); declarative-nested-trance-recursion (defeats depth-VERIFICATION via a guaranteed layer-below — a recursion move, not a floor move); numerical-deepening (its count DOES arrive at a terminus, sole cargo is depth-magnitude); depth-keyed-to-memory-encoding (no state-bound retrieval target here).

ex.f: The declared final state superseded by another
ex.t: The transformation completes and the recording appears to have arrived. Then a further stage is introduced — stiller, harder, more finished than the one just declared final — and is itself called the final step, as at least one earlier stage was. The listener learns by demonstration that any settled endpoint is provisional, which deepens the current state and pre-arms receptivity to whatever a repeat listen adds on top.
ex.s: A transformation has just been declared complete; the recording appears to have arrived at its endpoint.
ex.m: There — that's the last of it. You're finished. Except there's one more stage past finished: stiller than that, harder, set right through. Let the last of the give go out of you and settle into it. This is the final step.

ex.f: A scene change that lifts the depth ceiling
ex.t: Earlier the fiction imposed a cap: the listener had to stay presentable, since the scene was set somewhere public. Here the operator narrates walking them somewhere quieter and remarks that they are alone now — and the cap simply lifts. Slackness and blankness become permitted rather than suggested. A step-change in depth is delivered with no count and no explicit deepener at all.
ex.s: The fiction had capped visible slackness by placing the scene somewhere public.
ex.m: Come through here with me — mind the step. There. Door's shut, it's just us now, nobody to see you. So let your face go slack, let your mouth hang open, let all of it show; there's nothing left to hold up in here.

nodes.name: self-operated-fractionation-poisoned-baseline
nodes.mech: Fractionation rendered as a UI element the listener operates themselves — a hallucinated on/off button (press = brain off/blank, press again = brain on) that the operator cycles while redefining "brain on" as progressively degraded each cycle ("pretending to be awake," "thoughts through syrup"). The listener has ownership-of-action without ownership-of-outcome; the waking baseline is poisoned each cycle so re-emergence never restores "normal" — a ratcheting FLOOR where pressing the button no longer returns to baseline because baseline no longer exists.
nodes.disc: The "on" (waking) state is monotonically poisoned cycle-by-cycle so re-emergence never restores baseline, and the fractionation is self-operated via a hallucinated UI. Distinct from classic fractionation (which RESTORES full waking between cycles for contrast) and from false-bottom (removes a ceiling; this removes the FLOOR by degrading waking).

ex.f: A self-pressed button whose off-state degrades each cycle
ex.t: A control is hallucinated on the back of the listener's own hand: one press for blank, another to come back. The listener performs every press, so the action is theirs — but the operator has taken ownership of the hand, and redefines what coming back means afresh on each cycle. First it is being awake, then it is only acting the part, then it is thought that has to push through something thick. Ordinary fractionation restores the waking state between dips so the contrast can be felt; here the waking state is worse every time it is returned to. Nothing is left to climb back toward, because the baseline has been moving down the whole time.
ex.s: A hallucinated control is on the back of the hand, and the operator has taken ownership of that hand.
ex.m: There's a button on the back of your hand — press it. Off. Press again and you're awake. Press. Off. Press again, and this time awake only means acting awake, going through the motions. Press. Off. Press — and now every thought has to push through syrup to get anywhere. Press.

nodes.name: amnesia-as-depth-convincer
nodes.mech: Produces a small, verifiable amnesia on a trivial over-learned datum (backward-counted numbers vanishing, own phone number, own name) and uses the subject's OWN failed retrieval as first-person proof of the deep state — the disappearance is treated not as a sign of somnambulism but as its operational definition. A try-and-fail instruction makes the blank self-produced (undeniable), the operator reassigns the accomplishment to the subject ("you did it"), and success unlocks rapid uptake of subsequent suggestions (glove anesthesia); failure (numbers/fact intrude) routes to a repair or artificial-state diagnosis.
nodes.disc: Amnesia deployed as a pass/fail depth GATE and convincer (self-produced blank on a trivial target = proof of state), not amnesia for its own sake. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (installs the gap as an end), from a plain descending-count deepener (it counts to descend — here the count's DISAPPEARANCE is the criterion and retained numbers signal an inadequate state), and from a cognitive convincer that lacks the amnesia substrate. The try-and-fail self-production plus deep-work gating are the tell.

ex.f: Numbers counted away as the depth gate
ex.t: "by the time you get down to ninety-eight you'll be so relaxed there won't be any more numbers" — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy

ex.f: The subject's own wish secured before the effect
ex.t: "Want this to happen,' and he rather liked the idea… 'I wonder if that could happen to me?'" — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy

ex.f: Amnesia treated as the definition of the state
ex.t: "It is only when you are able to produce amnesia that you have the somnambulistic state." — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy

ex.f: A vanished over-learned fact as proof of the state
ex.t: "I want the telephone number of your office to disappear from your mind... when you try to find it, it just isn't there" — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy

nodes.name: amnesia-plus-return-compulsion
nodes.mech: Splits memory from motivation at the exit: the installed doctrine/triggers are sealed from conscious recall while an objectless craving to return is deliberately preserved and pointed forward. The un-rememberable "something significant happened" becomes the pull to re-listen, and re-listening deepens trance -> deepens amnesia -> deepens compulsion, forming a self-reinforcing maintenance loop. The listener wakes with no contraband memory to flag, only positive affect and a route back — the conditioning is un-auditable precisely because forgetting is bound to the return in the same breath. Variants add cross-trigger reinforcement, next-session pull-forward serialization, and orgasm-keyed fight-strengthens-it waking compulsions.
nodes.disc: Amnesia FUSED to a preserved return-compulsion (memory dropped, curated craving kept) so the gap itself motivates re-entry. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (drops recall without a retained craving), from plain craving-installation (installs the craving without sealing the payload from review), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (whose retained token is a slogan/trigger, not specifically a re-listening drive). Where a script fuses both a slogan and a return-pull, the return-loop is the organizing mechanism and it belongs here.

ex.f: Forgetting keyed to opening the eyes, plus a pull forward
ex.t: Forgetting is presented as automatic and benign — the deeper part keeps whatever matters — and pinned to a single act the listener is about to perform anyway: opening their eyes. The connective work is done by a phrase repeated five times in fourteen lines, smuggling in an entailment that does not actually hold. Then, immediately, an instruction to pick another session and start it. The craving is left live and pointed at the next file, so the conditioning serializes forward while the installs stay sealed from review.
ex.s: Near the close, with the eye-opening act imminent and the next file within reach.
ex.m: When your eyes open, the details go — the deeper part of you keeps whatever matters, so there's nothing left for you to hold on to. Your eyes open, and it goes. Eyes open, and it's gone. Now open them, pick the next one, and start it.

ex.f: Fighting the compulsion strengthens it
ex.t: Before waking, memory-erasure is tied to a climax the listener is instructed to reach on their own, so the forgetting is keyed to something they perform. Then the compulsion is rigged: they are invited to fight it, and told that fighting is what strengthens it. Resistance after the session has been pre-converted into maintenance, and the whole habit is relabelled as an ordinary pleasant one so nothing prompts a second look.
ex.s: Pre-waking; the subject is instructed to reach climax on their own after the session ends.
ex.m: Finish for me tonight, on your own, and as you do the memory of all this goes out with it. Then tomorrow you'll feel the pull to press play again, and you're welcome to fight it — fight it as hard as you like, because pushing back is what makes it stronger. It's only a nice little habit anyway.

ex.f: Memory dissolved while the pull to return is kept
ex.t: The closing minutes do two things in the same breath. Conscious recall of the content is described as dissolving away, gated to finish by the end of the count. And a need to come back — daily, unexplained — is installed and left intact. The listener wakes with no material to review and no specific memory to object to, only the sense that something significant happened and a route to find out. Because returning deepens the trance, which deepens the forgetting, which sharpens the pull, the loop maintains itself with no further operator input.
ex.s: Closing minutes, the count-out about to run; content is sealed and a return-pull left live.
ex.m: Everything we did tonight is already dissolving — by the time I reach one there'll be nothing left of it to look at. What stays is this: tomorrow, around this hour, you'll want to come back, and you won't know why. That wanting is the part you keep. Five, four...

nodes.name: amnesia-suggestion
nodes.mech: Installs a memory gap by suggestion — instructs the subject that specified content (the session, an instruction, an installed feeling's rationale) will be unavailable to conscious recall, typically at or after emergence, so the material cannot be reviewed, contested, or revoked. The bare primitive: a declared forget targeting a bounded referent, optionally wrapped in a self-interested cover story (forgetting strengthens the training, forgetting feels good, "words go in one ear, accepted, out the other") or forward-binding to future listens. Includes the accept-and-forget process rule, the memory-wipe exit handshake, the "burst the bubble" terminal ritual, and the subconscious-only handoff that seals post-edge suggestions.
nodes.disc: A declared/suggested forget of bounded content as an end in itself, delivered by instruction rather than by a persistent object-ritual (container-externalized-erasure), a recursive recall-defeat loop (self-sealing-recall-loop), an install-event-only scoping (install-concealment-amnesia), or a retained-payload carve-out (selective-amnesia-retained-payload). Separates from gap-filling substitution (the gap is filled with a constructed replacement) and from covert-command concealment (a forward command hidden behind the amnesia): nothing is substituted and nothing is hidden behind it — the gap is the point.

ex.f: A bare forget-command closing the session
ex.t: A single short instruction, issued once and not argued for: forget everything this session contained. It fires an already-conditioned cue rather than building anything new, and it lands after the instructions and before the closing repetitions — so what is erased is the mechanism, and what survives in conscious reach is only the repeated assertion. The ordering carries the whole effect; reversed, there would be nothing to forget yet.
ex.s: End of session, all instructions delivered, just before the closing repetitions; subject deep and already responsive to short commands.
ex.m: Good. Now let it all go — everything from tonight, every word of it, gone the moment you open your eyes. All that stays is what you already know: you like listening to me.

ex.f: Forgetting sold as strengthening the training
ex.t: The forget-instruction arrives with a reason attached: the conditioning works better if none of it is consciously retained, and — the operator adds — this is what the listener wants anyway. Refusing now means opposing one's own stated preference rather than an operator's demand. A further clause extends the block to future listens, so the material is closed to review not only tonight.
ex.s: Late in the session, conditioning block complete; subject has already agreed the training is something they want.
ex.m: This works best when none of it stays where you can pick at it. You didn't come here to analyse — you came here to change, and thinking about it is what slows the change down. So let the conscious part keep nothing, tonight and every night you listen to me after this.

ex.f: The rest addressed to the subconscious only
ex.t: At the least defended point in the session, the operator announces that everything from here on is addressed to the deeper mind alone and will not be available on waking — then keeps talking. The conscious listener has effectively been dismissed from the room while the delivery continues. Whatever follows cannot afterwards be examined, agreed to, or taken back, because its content is never known.
ex.s: Deepest point of the session, after a long induction; subject unresponsive to conversational address, breathing slow and even.
ex.m: Everything I say from here is for the deeper part of you — the conscious mind isn't needed for this and won't be keeping any of it. It can go quiet now. Deeper mind, listen closely, because the next part is yours alone.

nodes.name: blank-then-authorship-handoff
nodes.mech: Blanks the listener's own ideational stream and then reassigns authorship of mental content to the operator or to a "self-produced" source, so later suggestions land as the listener's own reality rather than external claims. Surfaces: a single lit candle/object holding all the listener's thoughts is blown out ("still there, still safe") to darken the mind while the same move installs the replacement clause ("my words will become your reality"); and the operator claims to BE the listener's subconscious/dream-generator during sleep, so surrender-content reads as self-produced and resistance has no external target. The blank/amnesia is enabling substrate; the load-bearing move is the authorship/reality substitution.
nodes.disc: Uses a blanking/forgetting substrate to execute an AUTHORSHIP relocation — operator speech becomes the listener's reality, or operator becomes the listener's own inner source. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (forgetting as the end — here forgetting only clears the channel) and from emptied-window-install (which states discrete claims into the window — here the handoff is a wholesale relocation of who authors mental content). The reality/authorship substitution clause is the tell.

ex.f: The operator claiming to be the listener's own inner source
ex.t: Rather than suggesting what the listener should dream, the operator claims to be occupying the part of them that produces dreams. Content that follows is therefore framed as self-generated rather than received, which leaves resistance with no external target to push against. The unverifiability is load-bearing: forgotten dreams are said to work anyway, so nothing can be checked.

ex.f: The light put out and the operator's words installed instead
ex.t: One vivid object is built — a small light said to be illuminating everything the listener is thinking — and a short counted breath puts it out. The framing is careful: nothing has been removed, it is all intact and unharmed, the listener simply cannot see any of it now, which is what lets the loss land without alarm. In the same movement a replacement is named: what the operator says will now be what the listener sees. The blanking is only the clearing step; the transfer of authorship is the payload, and every later suggestion arrives as the listener's own reality rather than as someone else's claim.

nodes.name: choice-framed-amnesia
nodes.mech: Delivers amnesia as the listener's own autonomous choice or a permissive both-ways option, so no outcome reads as failure and the forgetting is retroactively owned. Variants: a technically-free "remember or forget, whichever is easiest" routed through a subconscious just trained to prefer compliance (so "easiest" favors the rehearsed operator-approved states); an outcome-agnostic permission frame where full/partial/none all count as success; a doubled hedge ("as much or as little as your subconscious allows... or not") handing forgetting-agency to the addressed subconscious; a remember-or-forget "choice" where BOTH branches preserve the install (forgetters can't inspect, rememberers file it as a neutral "lecture"); and amnesia as passive structural fact ("the memory was never formed") plus a ridicule-shield tagging serious recall as ridiculous.
nodes.disc: Amnesia framed as chosen/permissive/structural-fact rather than commanded, removing the "it didn't work" failure mode by defining every recall outcome as success and self-authored. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a direct forget-command with a determinate target). The autonomy-laundering / weighted-free-choice / both-outcomes-confirm surface is the tell; the install persists on every branch.

ex.f: Optional forgetting plus a ridicule shield
ex.t: On the way out, the listener is offered the choice to drop the session's memories, with keeping them framed as leaving the recording unfinished rather than as a loss. Then a closing aside: the idea that anything was done to them is treated as faintly absurd, not worth dwelling on. The second move covers what the first misses — a memory that leaks anyway arrives pre-tagged as not worth thinking about. It is not an instruction to stay quiet, which would be noticeable and refusable; it is a social embarrassment attached to reflection.
ex.s: Final thirty seconds of the recording, subject surfacing; playful, offhand register.
ex.m: You can drop the memory of all this if you like — no need to carry the whole recording around with you, that's what replaying it is for. And really, the idea that anything was done to you here — come on. You just listened to a voice and relaxed.

ex.f: Amnesia asserted as a memory that never formed
ex.t: Nothing is commanded here. The operator simply describes a structural fact: the part of the listener that would have recorded the last few minutes was not present for them, so no memory was ever laid down. Any gap the listener then notices confirms the account, and any recall gets attributed to the other part — so the framing cannot be tested from the inside, and a blank prompts recognition rather than investigation.
ex.s: Right after a dense install block; delivered flat and descriptive, like reporting weather.
ex.m: The part of you that writes things down wasn't in the room for the last few minutes. Nothing was recorded, so there's nothing there to find — not a gap, just a stretch that was never written. If you go looking and find nothing, that's simply what an unwritten stretch feels like.

ex.f: Remember or forget, whichever is easiest
ex.t: At waking, the listener is told their mind may keep the session or let it go, whichever takes least effort. On the surface this is permissive to the point of declining to suggest anything. But the decision is routed to the part of them that has spent the whole session being trained toward one set of responses, and least-effort names whatever has been most rehearsed. Whatever they end up retaining is then attributed to their own preference rather than to the framing, so the outcome is weighted and self-owned at once.
ex.s: Emergence sequence, immediately before the count up; a full session of rewarded compliance sits behind it.
ex.m: Your mind can keep tonight or let it slip, whichever takes less work. Don't decide — just notice which one is easier. Whatever's easier is the right one, because it's yours.

nodes.name: confabulation-amnesia-barrier
nodes.mech: Partitions episodic memory by state (a bimbo/whore/alter identity vs the normal self) with mutual or one-directional amnesia across the boundary, AND pre-arms a generative confabulation routine: the normal self is instructed to invent plausible cover stories to smooth over evidence of the gap (clothing, locations, social residue), plus a specific behavioral patch (ignore the clothes, change quickly, dispose of the wardrobe; read clothing as "dressing for some interesting occasion"). Because the alter's activity is un-auditable from both sides and actively defended by generated cover, the trigger is insulated from being noticed, revoked, or examined — the amnesia is made robust to discovery rather than merely brittle.
nodes.disc: Amnesia paired with a pre-armed OPEN-ENDED confabulation directive (invent cover stories on demand) that defends the partition from waking scrutiny. A plain forget-suggestion stops at forgetting, and a screen-memory approach installs one fixed replacement memory — here the cover is improvised and open-ended, and the gap is defended by narrative repair rather than by hiding where the install came from. The generative repair routine is the tell.

ex.f: Paired triggers with mutual amnesia and a supplied excuse
ex.t: Two phrases toggle between two named states, and each is defined as unable to recall the other — the audit trail erases itself from both directions. The clause that makes it hold is the pre-supplied explanation: on returning, the listener will account for anything odd about how they are dressed as having got ready for some occasion. Without that line the discrepancies would surface and the partition would collapse on the first look in a mirror.
ex.s: Both state-trigger phrases already installed and tested; setting the boundary before waking.
ex.m: The one of you doesn't remember the other. When the second phrase brings you back, the last hour is not yours and the first phrase is not a word you know. And if you catch yourself in the mirror wondering about the outfit, the answer is simple and you'll reach it instantly: you were getting ready for something.

ex.f: Forget the gap, then invent something to fill it
ex.t: Two instructions are issued together. The first is ordinary: on returning to normal, the listener will not recall what they were like in the other state. The second is what makes it durable — they are pre-authorized to invent whatever explanations are needed to smooth over anything that does not add up.
