The ambient-surface, growth-clause, retroactive-arming, install-by-assertion, and deniable-dual-function forms are all VARIANTS of this one install lever — twists on the cue-surface, the response-magnitude, the install-timing, the install-veridicality, or the cue's semantic doubling, not distinct moves.

ex.f: Cue chosen as a wide ambient surface
ex.t: The cue named is not one garment or one act but a whole fuzzy category of clothing, so the listener's own sense of what counts decides the boundary — and that boundary can only widen. The operator adds that the switch throws the moment dressing begins, cannot be interrupted, and always works. The persona-change stops needing an operator at all: the wardrobe is now the induction surface, and clothes have gone from things worn to switches that cannot be left unpressed.
ex.s: Deep, persona content already established; the operator is defining the out-of-session cue surface.
ex.m: Anything you'd call lingerie is a switch now — you decide what counts, and that list only ever gets longer. The moment the strap touches your shoulder she comes forward, every time, and once it has started you cannot interrupt it. You will simply be dressing, and then you will be her.

ex.f: Each firing specified to add to the last
ex.t: The response is written with an accumulator built into it: hear the phrase and the body is told it has gone far longer without release than it has — and every further utterance adds the same increment again on top. Having established the rule, the operator simply repeats the phrase several times over in quick succession, stacking a great deal of imagined deprivation in well under a minute. The felt shortage is now a number the operator can drive at whatever rate she likes, entirely detached from what the body has actually done.
ex.s: Arousal established, subject deep; the phrase is being bound with its accumulator clause.
ex.m: When you hear denied for me, your body is certain it has gone a full week without release, and every time I say it again it adds another week on top. Denied for me. Denied for me. Denied for me. Denied for me. That's a month, and I have not touched you once.

ex.f: Install asserted as an already-old fact
ex.t: Mid-script the operator stops to comment on the way she is speaking at that moment: this particular register, she says, is a cue you picked up over the earlier files — it means trance is close. Nothing is installed in front of the listener and nothing can be checked; the claim is about a register they are hearing right now and about sessions they may or may not remember precisely. Whatever settling follows gets attributed to the voice, and denying the trigger would mean denying one's own past listening.
ex.s: Mid-script; the operator has just shifted into a lower, slower vocal register.
ex.m: Listen to how I'm speaking to you right now — this softer register, right here. You learned this one over the earlier recordings, so you'll notice your body already knows what it means: it means trance is close. You may not remember the session where you picked it up, but your shoulders remember.

ex.f: Saturate the phrase first, name it after
ex.t: First the phrase is repeated a dozen-odd times back to back with nothing at all in between, right after the count has reached bottom, until it has stopped meaning anything and is only a sound. Only then does the operator define it: these words are a spell; hear them and you go straight down. The conditioning is already finished before the trigger is announced, so the install reads as labelling something the listener has plainly been doing, not as a request. The chosen phrase is itself an order, so each later utterance narrates the response and produces it in the same breath.
ex.s: Count has reached the bottom of the descent; the phrase has not yet been named as a trigger.
ex.m: Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Drop for me. Those three words are a spell now — you have been doing it for the last minute. Hear them anywhere, and you go straight down.

nodes.name: deferred-content-slot-install
nodes.mech: Builds a locked structure of conditioned words, then installs an OPEN slot in it: the listener pre-commits, at peak suggestibility (orgasm as the binding agent), to treat future content-unknown words — whatever they turn out to be, delivered live or in other recordings — as equivalent to the existing conditioned set, inheriting its full weight. The actual filler words are never cleanly delivered; the install target is a VARIABLE, not a value — a future-tense backdoor on the conditioning that the operator can re-enter and fill arbitrarily.
nodes.disc: The install target is an open, content-unknown slot pre-authorized to inherit existing conditioned weight. vs declarative-trigger-installation: there a fixed, known cue-response pair is declared at install time; here nothing bound is known at commitment time. The orgasm is the binding agent, not a conditioned response — this is not arousal-to-cue conditioning. And the concealment is NON-DELIVERY of the filler content, not an amnesia wrapper around a delivered command. Not a growth-clause variant: growth clauses strengthen a KNOWN response; the slot defers WHAT is installed, not how strongly.

ex.f: A blank slot pre-authorized at the peak
ex.t: Eleven words have been drilled into a locked set. At the edge of climax the operator asks for one more commitment: two further words will be added at the moment of release, and whatever they turn out to be, they will belong to the set with all its accumulated weight. The listener agrees to a value they have not heard — the pledge is to a variable. In the recording itself the two words are never delivered cleanly; the climax dissolves into repetition. The slot stays open, and the operator can return later, in this catalogue or live, and fill it with anything she likes.
ex.s: At the edge of climax; eleven conditioned words already drilled into a closed set.
ex.m: You have eleven words, and they are locked. Now, before you go over: two more words will be added to that set at the moment you come, and whatever those two words turn out to be, they belong to the set with everything the other eleven carry. Say yes to that now, while you're right at the edge — yes to two words you haven't heard yet.

nodes.name: environmental-retrigger-seeding
nodes.mech: Link the installed state or identity to specific real-world stimuli the listener is certain to re-encounter (a named song, gym bikes, gear shifts, a friend's leg), so ordinary environmental contact re-fires and reinforces the conditioning after the session ends — extending operator reach beyond the audio file. A dense locational catalog of concrete objects can ground an abstract identity so each object becomes a re-firing anchor, and amplifier language ('a hundred fold') can make each exposure strengthen rather than merely recall the install.
nodes.disc: The cue set is REAL-WORLD ambient stimuli seeded for out-of-session re-firing — not in-session modality extension of one trigger (multi-modal-trigger), not a single if-then situational pairing, and the install is declarative and announced, so it lacks the covert-pairing tell of covert-nonverbal-anchor.

ex.f: Named song made an amplifier of the install
ex.t: One specific piece of music is named and welded to the installed state — and not merely as a reminder. Playing it, the listener is told, does not just recall the session but multiplies every feeling and every bodily impression it produced. That is the active part: reinforcement is offloaded onto a real object in the world the listener can go back to at will, so each play is a covert re-trance and a strengthening pass. The linkage is stated twice, at two different depths, so it lands on the way down and again at the floor.
ex.s: Descent underway and again at the deepest point; the installed state has been named and felt.
ex.m: There's one song you know — the one you always put on in the car. From now on, playing it doesn't just remind you of tonight. It multiplies it. Every feeling you have had in this hour comes back a hundredfold the moment those first bars start, and it does that every single time you play it.

ex.f: Catalogue of everyday objects as anchors
ex.t: Instead of stating the identity claim once in the abstract, the script spells it out object by object in the listener's own first-person voice — a machine at the gym, a cushion at home, a fitting in the car, a companion's leg — each item punctuated by the same short gasp. The claim is granular and located. The effect is that ordinary furniture becomes a set of anchors: the next time any one of those objects is in front of the listener, the line fires with it.
ex.s: Identity claim established in the abstract; the subject is repeating lines in first person.
ex.m: Say it with me, one thing at a time. The seat of the bike at the gym — I want to grind on that. Ah. The arm of my own sofa — I want to grind on that. Ah. The gearstick in my car — I want to grind on that. Ah. My friend's thigh, when she sits next to me — I want to grind on that. Ah.

nodes.name: marked-cue-amnesia-switch
nodes.mech: Pre-mark a token during trance by tone/tempo/emphasis and train the MARK, not the word's meaning, as a binary handle on a posthypnotic amnesia. Later the operator re-presents only that marked token to flip the sealed material open or shut, or delivers a matched second reserved phrase that runs the suppression anchor in reverse, flooding the sealed content back complete; the delayed-key form slips the tonally-planted cue into ordinary post-trance talk on the operator's timing to re-open sealed material outside the trance frame. Because the active ingredient is the analogical mark, ordinary paraphrase, frank statement, or full retelling all fail to reach the block; only the tagged token operates the switch, and the release feels spontaneous to the subject rather than commanded.
nodes.disc: The active ingredient is the mark isolated over semantics — proven by the failure of every non-marked prompt — operating an amnesia gate. Trigger-activation fires a state-shift, not a memory-gate toggle; a plain amnesia suggestion installs the seal, while this operates its key; and an amnesia-wrapped command wraps a command in forgetting rather than switching the amnesia itself.

ex.f: One marked word toggles the amnesia
ex.t: "Each statement I made was… actually uninformative… Yet no results were forthcoming until again the word 'AVAILABLE' resulted in the same effect as previously." — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I

ex.f: The reserved release phrase floods it back
ex.t: "I commented with quiet emphasis, 'Well, perhaps now matters will become available.'… poured forth a torrent of words" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I

ex.f: Key slipped into ordinary later conversation
ex.t: "that word 'vestibule' has a strange feeling of immense, anxious warmth about it" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I

nodes.name: multi-modal-trigger
nodes.mech: One trigger is made to fire across multiple sensory or representational channels — heard, read, thought, spoken, touched — so the conditioned response survives missed cues and follows the subject into more contexts, and the subject cannot recall or internally reference the cue without firing it (internal thought is not a safe harbor). Forms in evidence: sequential extension of an installed trigger into new channels; simultaneous all-channel firing at the moment of state capture for redundant encoding (tactile primacy claimed); firing across all verbal delivery modes (operator-heard, silently self-thought, spoken aloud); flooding a single token across visual/olfactory/gustatory channels with listener-supplied detail; using the listener's OWN self-applied identity handle/name as the cue so every use of the persona fires the response and casual identity-use becomes impossible (an always-on self-trigger surface running outside sessions); a non-verbal build mapping opposite somatic outcomes to per-ear stereo tones drilled as a reflex the subject cannot consciously author; and restoring a destroyed cross-modal anchor by re-siting its function onto a substitute matching the lost cue's physical slot and every channel. Absorbed (genus, cue-surface widening on further axes — same 'make the cue fire in more situations' lever): written/text channel (tell: extend the trigger to fire from operator-addressed WRITTEN media — email, website, chat — a persistent async between-session channel, and a typographic-gestalt sub-form conditioned to a spaceless all-caps SHAPE recognized at a glance; must be explicitly installed, does not transfer from a spoken cue); scope/catchment widening (tell: progressively widen WHAT qualifies as the cue — aroused -> sexy image -> any image — using a backward countdown / depth-pacing as the vehicle so each expansion lands too deep to evaluate; the widening axis is the semantic catchment rather than the sensory channel).
nodes.disc: SEVERAL channels carry the SAME trigger-response pair — vs declarative-trigger-installation single-cue installation, vs compound-sample-class-expansion where compound components become independently matchable class members, vs deliberate single-cue placement OFF the dominant channel (analogical-marking), and vs environmental-retrigger-seeding (reach expansion via real-world object seeding, not sensory-channel extension of one cue).

ex.f: All channels fired at the moment of capture
ex.t: "if you anchor with a touch, you are likely to anchor simultaneously in all other systems as well." — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing

ex.f: Lost cue rebuilt in every channel at once
ex.t: "This provided a direct bridging, replacing the time clock by the supervisor in all representational systems." — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing

ex.f: The subject's own name made the cue
ex.t: The cue installed is the listener's own adopted name. Hearing it blanks her — and so does reading it, and so does merely thinking it, each channel named in turn. The persona can no longer be worn lightly, because invoking it at all is a firing, private invocations included. The framing that it is her favourite sound closes the last door: deciding later that the trigger is unwelcome would mean contradicting a preference she has already agreed to.
ex.s: Persona name already adopted and used by the subject; deep, mid-session.
ex.m: Your name is the trigger now. When I say it, you go blank. When you read it typed in a message, you go blank. When you so much as think it to yourself, you go blank — and you think it every day, don't you. It is your favourite sound in the world, so you would never want it to work any other way.

ex.f: One token flooded across three senses
ex.t: The single colour that has been holding the listener's gaze is now given a scent as well, and then a taste, as she is told to breathe it in. The scent itself is left deliberately blank: it is whatever you find most delicious, so the listener supplies the strongest version out of her own memory. The operator then marvels at how she could possibly have known, which turns the listener's own invention into evidence of the operator's reach. One cue token now occupies sight, smell and taste, and its real-world catchment has trebled.
ex.s: A single colour has held the subject's visual attention for several minutes.
ex.m: That pink you're looking at — breathe it in now, because it has a scent, and the scent is whatever you find most delicious in the world. Have you got it? Now let it settle on your tongue; it tastes of the same thing. How on earth did I know that was the one for you?

nodes.name: open-authority-socket
nodes.mech: Binds activation authority for an installed state to the UTTERANCE of a trigger phrase rather than to any specific or consented operator — 'when somebody says', 'as soon as someone tells you', 'whomever said this words is obviously your pimp', 'usable by I or anyone else'. Whoever learns the phrase can toggle the subject's state, often with the promotion presupposed as already-completed ('obviously') and with downstream judgment (pricing, commands) delegated to that arbitrary speaker. The distinguishing structural property is that the activation set is identity-agnostic and un-vetoable at activation time — a socket that accepts any key-holder, not a delegated right handed to a named party.
nodes.disc: Activation is granted by identity-agnostic UTTERANCE (any speaker, no consent check, no in-normal-state veto), not to a named/nominated delegate as in third-party-activation. Separates from third-party-activation (specific trusted party holds the right) and from persona-programming twists by keying on the access-control property: who is admitted to fire, and the answer is 'anyone who speaks the phrase.'

ex.f: Anyone who says the phrase throws it
ex.t: The activation clause is written impersonally throughout — the moment somebody speaks the phrase, whoever that somebody happens to be. Not the operator: anybody. The off-phrase is scoped the same way. Nothing in the wording reserves the switch to the person installing it, and the listener has no memory of the trigger in the normal state, so there is no moment at which they could decline a particular speaker. Whoever learns the words holds the switch.
ex.s: Deep; the state has been built and is now being keyed to an activation phrase.
ex.m: From now on, the moment somebody says drop for me, you drop — whoever that somebody happens to be. Anyone. And you stay there until somebody says wake up now, and again, it does not matter who. You will not remember any of this while you're awake, so there is nothing for you to think about.

ex.f: The speaker is presupposed into authority
ex.t: The clause does not merely admit any speaker to the trigger; it promotes them. Whoever uttered the words is — obviously, the script says — the one in charge, and may ask whatever they want. That one word carries the whole move: the promotion is framed as an inference already completed rather than a claim to be weighed. Downstream judgement is delegated too — if the listener does not know what to ask for, she is told her new controller will tell her.
ex.s: Deep, submissive frame established; the activation clause has just been made identity-agnostic.
ex.m: Whoever spoke those words to you is obviously the one in charge of you now, and they may ask you for anything they like. If you don't know what you're supposed to be offering, don't worry about it — just ask them, and they will tell you what you're for.

ex.f: Open to all speakers, with a misfire guard
ex.t: The state is keyed to a short numeric code that anybody at all may use — spoken aloud or typed — and the same code seals it again. A single guard clause is bolted on: the number only counts if it is uttered on its own and for no other purpose, so those digits turning up in a price or a date do nothing. The precision is what makes the open door practical, narrowing firing to deliberate use while leaving the set of permitted users completely unbounded.
ex.s: Deep; the state is being keyed to a numeric code with an ambiguity guard.
ex.m: Your code is four-four-nine. Anyone at all may use it — said out loud, or typed to you — and you go under. Four-four-nine again brings you back up. It only counts when those three digits are said on their own and meant for you; if they turn up in a price or a phone number, they do nothing at all.

nodes.name: operator-exclusive-trigger-firing
nodes.mech: After a trigger is installed, an exclusivity clause captures the trigger surface for one operator: the cue is bound to fire only in the operator's voice / the operator's files, or 'I and only I say it', so the same word spoken by anyone else (or self-administered) has zero effect (pointless, useless) and both self-soothing/desensitization and third-party dilution of ownership are blocked. Two layers run at once: the clause defends the trigger against ambient activation that would fatigue or break the conditioning, and it converts every ambient occurrence of the word into a craving for the operator's voice, so other people's use becomes an advertisement (the non-firing is felt as deprivation). Frequently the exclusivity is safety-coded ('for your hypnotic safety, your mind will lock the word to my voice and my voice only') so resisting the lockdown feels like resisting one's own protection and the listener actively cooperates; and it is often paired with a hot-swap, retiring a freshly-drilled working trigger and transferring the felt response by substitution onto the new, voice-locked word. The effect is parasocial dependence tied to a specific voice and a structural disadvantage to any competing operator.
nodes.disc: Gates the FIRING of an installed trigger to the operator's voice alone (owned re-induction, valueless without her voice) and converts ambient exposure into craving. It is a post-install access-control clause, not the install itself, and it gates trigger firing, not state exit as an asymmetric state-lock does. It is more specific than a generic loyalty suggestion: the move is exclusivity plus craving-on-absence — voice capture. Where third-party activation DELEGATES firing rights outward, this EXCLUDES third parties and the listener alike. And unlike a genuine safety clause that bounds a trigger's scope as real protection, here the safety-coding is cover for capturing the trigger surface. The craving-on-absence, safety-coded voice-lock, and hot-swap forms are variants of one exclusivity lever.

ex.f: Only this voice fires it; others cause craving
ex.t: Straight after binding the cue, the operator adds the exclusion: from anyone else's mouth these words do nothing at all — pointless, useless, no response from any part of you. That protects the conditioning from being worn out by ambient use. But the clause does not stop there: you walk away unaffected, and hungry for the one voice that would have worked. The non-firing is specified to be felt as a lack, so every stranger who happens to say the word is now advertising the operator.
ex.s: Immediately after the cue has been bound to its response; subject deep.
ex.m: That word only works in my voice. From anyone else's mouth it is pointless — useless — no part of you responds to it at all. You will simply walk away unaffected, and hungry, because you'll know the one voice that would have worked wasn't there to say it.

ex.f: Self-administration ruled out as well
ex.t: The new cue is announced, then immediately re-announced with the restriction bolted on — it counts from my mouth and no other. The exclusion covers third parties and the listener too, so it cannot be used on oneself for comfort or repeated until it wears out. Note the two-tier design in the same script: an ordinary deepening word left open and unclaimed, and this one, owned. The listener ends up holding a re-entry handle with no value outside a single voice.
ex.s: New re-entry cue just announced; an ordinary unclaimed deepener word is also in use in the same session.
ex.m: Your re-entry word is umbral. And now hear the rest of it: umbral counts from my mouth and no other. Not from a friend, not from another hypnotist, and not from you — saying it to yourself in the mirror does nothing whatsoever. It is mine to use on you.

ex.f: Trigger swapped out, safety-coded to one voice
ex.t: A short drop-cue has just been drilled several times, and the listener has felt it work on each pass. The operator then retires it in the same breath and names an unusual replacement word — and locks the new one to his own voice, on his own recordings, explaining that this is for the listener's protection so stray conversation cannot set it off. The felt response transfers by substitution onto the new word, which is a plausible safeguard and simultaneously a capture: the listener leaves with a working depth-cue that no other operator can ever use, and refusing the arrangement would have meant arguing against their own safety.
ex.s: A short drop-cue has been drilled several times and the subject has felt it work each pass.
ex.m: That word has done its job and we're retiring it now — it does nothing from here. Everything it did transfers onto a new one: cinnabar. And cinnabar only counts in my voice, on my recordings. That is for your protection, so a stranger can't drop you in the middle of the street by accident.

nodes.name: orgasm-gating-double-bind
nodes.mech: Transfers both the onset AND the cessation of climax to operator command: the listener is told she cannot come until told (the inability attributed to her blanked mind), is edged, released on an explicit command, then held in chained forced orgasms she cannot stop. Release and stopping are equally out of her hands — a double bind on an autonomic event, with the blame-attribution to the blanked state doing the agency-transfer work.
nodes.disc: BOTH directions of an autonomic event are operator-gated. The counted 'Orgasm now' release is only a component; the mechanism is the bidirectional authority transfer, not the cue — which separates it from a plain declarative trigger install. A motor-inhibition challenge suggests inability in ONE direction as depth proof; the double bind closes both directions and targets orgasm, not skeletal movement. A one-way stop-authority trigger resembles the stop half alone, but the double bind is symmetric — neither start nor stop is retained — and involves no practice asymmetry. And no cue-to-arousal pairing history is built: the gating works by declared authority in-session, not by conditioning.

ex.f: Neither starting nor stopping is yours
ex.t: First the front gate: you cannot finish until you are told to, and the reason offered is not a rule but an incapacity — your mind is too blank now to make a decision that size. The listener is edged, then released on an explicit command. Then the back gate closes as well: now you cannot stop, and you keep going until I say. Both ends of an involuntary event have been transferred, and the blame-attribution to the blanked state is what makes the transfer feel like a description rather than a demand.
ex.s: Subject edged and deep; arousal high, mind reported blank.
ex.m: You can't finish yet — not because I forbid it, but because your mind is far too blank right now to make a decision that size. Keep going. Keep going. Now: orgasm for me. And don't stop. You cannot stop, you keep going through it and past it, until I tell you that you're finished.

nodes.name: out-of-audio-compliance-offload
nodes.mech: Transfers a state-transition (deepening / compliance-proof) OUT of the audio into a second medium where the operator has no live control — the recording tells the listener to pause, leave the audio, perform a specific motor act in a separate channel (click a button in an email), then resume, with the external act itself framed as the deepener. The listener's own out-of-band motor act becomes materially-performed proof of obedience, pre-tagged to double depth; returning carries the just-completed compliance back into the session as a state delta.
nodes.disc: Unlike an in-audio drop command, and unlike a text-platform trigger where a text cue FIRES a conditioned response, nothing here fires from reading; the deepening is executed by a materially-performed external motor act in a second medium where compliance is possibly tracked. The tell is the transfer of the state-transition work to a separate channel, not a cue that activates in text.

ex.f: Deepening performed outside the recording
ex.t: The audio instructs the listener to stop the audio. Stay under, it says, switch to the message waiting in the other window, act on the control you find there, then come back. That action is not incidental — it is named in advance as the thing that will deepen the state. So the state-change happens in a second medium, out of the operator's live reach, and it happens by a real motor act the listener performs and cannot afterwards deny performing. Returning to the recording, they bring that freshly completed act of obedience back in with them, and the pattern repeats at the next one.
ex.s: Mid-session; a message with a control in it is already open in another window.
ex.m: Pause the audio here. Stay right where you are, stay under, and go to the message waiting in your other window — press the button you find there. Pressing it is what takes you deeper; that's what it's for. Then come back, press play, and you'll find yourself twice as far down as you are now.

nodes.name: post-wake-ratification-fire
nodes.mech: After a full wake count to 'awake and normal', the operator fires an installed trigger the instant the trance frame closes, deliberately overwriting the emergence reassurance and collapsing the trance/waking safety boundary. The in-body response immediately after being told one is normal is offered as the most persuasive proof of waking-life durability; the withhold-then-fire and self-amplification riders ('the more you use it the more powerful') extend the demonstration into an instruction to strengthen the anchor over time.
nodes.disc: The tell is a live trigger fire placed AFTER the wake count that contradicts the 'refreshed, normal, awake' framing on purpose. Plain trigger-activation fires in-frame with no boundary move; a waking suggestion is delivered DURING emergence, not fired after closure to puncture the boundary; and an in-session depth convincer proves depth inside the session, not out-of-session reach.

ex.f: Trigger fired the instant the wake count ends
ex.t: The emergence is completely ordinary — a count up to wide awake and entirely back to normal, rested, alert, eyes open. Then, with the frame formally shut, the operator fires the installed command anyway. The reassurance just delivered is overwritten within the same breath, which is precisely the demonstration: the response arrives while the listener has been told they are back to normal, proving in the body that the conditioning does not stop at the edge of the session.

ex.f: Word withheld across the wake, then sprung
ex.t: The operator deliberately declines to say what the word is before waking the listener — you will find out soon enough — which leaves them primed to respond to whichever word it proves to be. The count up runs, and then, framed as a small experiment, the word is finally spoken and the listener's reaction is narrated live as it happens. A rider is attached on the way past: a cue like this grows stronger the more it is used, which turns the demonstration into an instruction.

nodes.name: relief-monopoly-bind
nodes.mech: Establishes the operator as the sole valid authority over a bodily release (orgasm) by pre-defining every autonomous or competing route to relief as inert. The core form grounds this in an ONTOLOGICAL claim — even permitted self-touch is causally incapable of relief, only the operator can grant it — and then experientially confirms it by granting permission that sabotages its own payoff (each touch adds need rather than relieving it), foreclosing the resist/beg/touch escape routes at once. The scope variant extends the same monopoly across a class of external agents: no other hypnotist's command, nor even the operator's own OTHER recordings, can authorize the release for the window. In both, the operator becomes the only valid exit, producing dependency rather than mere arousal.
nodes.disc: Gates a bodily RELEASE by making the operator the only causally-valid grantor and foreclosing all autonomous routes — via ontological impossibility or cross-agent exclusivity. Rule-based orgasm denial ('I forbid you to come') lacks the impossibility/monopoly framing; addiction framing is a linguistic craving frame, not a structural exit-foreclosure; denial-window-as-deepener-loop recycles denied arousal into a DEEPENER, while this gates who may AUTHORIZE release; and an asymmetric state-lock gates the trance STATE, not a bodily release.

ex.f: Monopoly extended over rival authorities
ex.t: Near the close, the exclusivity is widened past the listener's own body to a whole class of competing sources: for the duration of the week, no other practitioner's release command will function — and, notably, neither will any of this operator's other recordings. The listener may go and listen to whatever they like; it is pre-declared inert. The monopoly protects this particular series rather than the operator in general.
ex.s: Near the close of a session in a multi-day denial series; the release rule is being scoped.
ex.m: For the next seven days, no one else can give this back to you. No other hypnotist's permission works on you — their words simply pass through. And nothing else of mine works either: play any other recording of mine you like, and its release command will do nothing. Only this one, and only when I say so.

ex.f: Relief declared impossible by any other route
ex.t: The framing is not a prohibition but a claim about how things work: touching yourself will not relieve this, because only one thing can, and that thing is me letting you go. Permission is then granted — go ahead, touch — and the permission is built to fail, because each touch is specified to add need rather than discharge it. The listener now has the experience confirming the claim they were given in advance. Every autonomous route out has been closed in turn: resisting does nothing, begging does nothing, and the one permitted act loads the system further. What is left is not arousal but dependency, with the operator as the only valid exit.
ex.s: Arousal built and denied for some time; the subject is asking, verbally or by squirming, for release.
ex.m: Touching yourself will not relieve this. It can't — only one thing can, and that thing is me letting you go. Go on, then: touch. And feel what happens, because every stroke adds to the need instead of taking from it. Beg if you like; that doesn't do anything either.

nodes.name: respondent-stimulus-pairing
nodes.mech: Operate on the RESPONDENT (reflex) arc via stimulus presentation, not consequences on voluntary behavior. BUILD direction (respondent-stimulus-pairing): present a neutral stimulus just before or simultaneous with an unconditioned stimulus that already elicits a response; after repeated pairings the formerly neutral stimulus alone elicits a conditioned response — an automatic, involuntary reaction the subject did not have and did not choose, transferring by temporal contiguity (forward/simultaneous strongest, backward/delayed weaker). EVALUATIVE facet (valence-transfer-pairing): pair a stimulus that already reliably evokes a positive emotional response (liked music) with a neutral target (a product, an ad), contiguously and repeatedly, until the target itself elicits the affect and biases downstream choice toward it — affect installed with no argument about the target's merits. DECAY direction facet (respondent-habituation): present an eliciting stimulus repeatedly within a short span with no consequence or pairing, and the elicited response's magnitude decays and may vanish (massed re-exposure blunts reactivity on an intact unconditioned reflex arc); SPACING the same exposures preserves the response — presentation TIMING is the lever.
nodes.disc: Reach for RESPONDENT CONDITIONING when the target is an INVOLUNTARY (reflex/affective) response and the lever is stimulus PRESENTATION, not consequation of voluntary behavior. To install an elicited response or affect, pair NS+US by contiguity (order-sensitivity forward > backward is the procedural marker); to install a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target, use an already-evocative affective stimulus; to DECAY an existing reflex, re-present the eliciting stimulus massed (no pairing). Choose it over: discrimination/stimulus-control and any declared-trigger install (which consequate/instruct VOLUNTARY responding — no reflex elicited); motivating-operation engineering (which shifts a reinforcer's VALUE, not a reflex); conditioned-reinforcer manufacture (pairing that transfers reinforcing FUNCTION delivered as a consequence, not elicited affect).

ex.f: Neutral cue paired until it elicits by itself
ex.t: "After several trials consisting of the sound of the metronome followed by the presentation of food, the dogs began salivating in response to the sound of the metronome" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.

nodes.name: self-administered-conditioning-loop
nodes.mech: The operator transfers the labor and the reinforcer of a conditioning loop into the listener, keeping only the framing. The listener supplies the reward (self-generated arousal, self-recited mantra, a self-voiced first-person declaration, a competence appraisal on each repetition, an instructed motor act) while the operator merely labels it as caused-by and owned-by the operator's words. Because the reward is the listener's own and the act of producing it is defined as the compliance, the loop becomes self-driving: stopping costs the pleasure, continuing costs autonomy; progressive transfer of the operator role into the listener's own drive is the point, so the loop rides the listener's ordinary daily behavior (masturbation, self-talk, re-listening) as its substrate and can continue operator-absent. A staged sub-form keeps the operator present only to install a CUTOFF: a voluntary motor act (nodding) is coupled to involuntary sensation, acceleration is instructed so sensation rises as a function of the listener's OWN action, the escalation is re-credited to operator control, and an anti-saturation hard-stop both hides the listener-driven nature and installs operator stop-authority before a later gate.
nodes.disc: The reattribution move: the operator OWNS the reward-framing but never GENERATES the reward, and the loop is engineered to self-sustain (or to install stop-authority) rather than being operator-driven. In a within-session conditioning loop the operator both drives and delivers the reinforcing cycle in-session; here the listener supplies it. Where arousal is conditioned to operator cues as the goal, arousal/pleasure here is the outsourced FUEL, not the payload. A self-directed mantra is absorptive chanting for its own sake; here recitation is tied to escalating pleasure and autonomy-cost. And unlike ideomotor proof, where subtle AUTOMATIC movement serves as evidence of trance, the motor act here is VOLUNTARY, instructed, then reattributed. The self-driven-motor-with-cutoff form — operator present only for the cutoff — is a variant of the same listener-drives-it-then-reattribution logic.

ex.f: Pleasure contingent on continuing to recite
ex.t: The listener is told to speak a short declaration of ownership in their own voice, then to keep repeating it — and the sensation is specified to climb by a further multiple with each pass, for as long as they continue. Nothing is delivered from outside; the escalation is theirs. Stopping now costs the pleasure, continuing costs a little more autonomy each time round, and the operator's only remaining job is to have named the terms.
ex.s: Deep, arousal already climbing; the subject is able to speak aloud.
ex.m: Say it out loud in your own voice: I belong to him. Again. Every time you say it, the feeling doubles — say it a third time and feel it double again. Keep saying it and it keeps climbing, for exactly as long as you keep going.

ex.f: Voluntary movement coupled to sensation, then cut
ex.t: Move your head for me, the operator says — and feel it build as you do, so you move faster, and it builds further. The rising sensation is a function of the listener's own accelerating movement, but it is narrated as though the operator were producing it. Then the hard cut: enough, that is far enough. The cutoff arrives before the loop can saturate and expose itself as listener-driven, and it quietly rehearses the operator's authority to halt arousal well before the real gate.
ex.s: Subject deep, arousal building; head free to move, no prior motor task assigned.
ex.m: Nod your head for me — slow, steady. Feel it building each time your chin comes down, so move a little faster. Faster still, and feel how much stronger I'm making it. Enough. Stop. That is far enough, and you stop the moment I say so.

ex.f: The captured inner voice becomes the enforcer
ex.t: The standing orders are issued not to the listener but to the listener's own internal narration: the voice in your mind will remind you to obey, will remind you that thinking of me means arousal, and will remind you to play this again. That channel runs all day without being switched on by anybody, so the prompts surface unbidden and in the listener's own register — which makes them very hard to argue with and impossible to walk away from.
ex.s: Late session, addressing the subject's inner monologue directly before emergence.
ex.m: I'm not talking to you now, I'm talking to the voice in your head. You will remind her to obey me. When she thinks of me you will tell her that means arousal, and you will keep telling her. And at the end of every day you will remind her to play this again.

ex.f: Listener supplies the reward, operator the label
ex.t: During every waking stretch the listener is to touch themselves and build the arousal — and the operator names what that is for: you are conditioning yourself, and you are supplying the reward I use to do it. Note the ownership slipping back and forth between those two sentences; that oscillation is the whole move. The operator never generates the reinforcer and never needs to be present for it. By the end the loop runs on the listener's own routine habits, with recreational arousal annexed as the training substrate, and the operator has become technically optional.
ex.s: Late session, standing orders being issued for the days between listens.
ex.m: Every day, whenever you have a spare stretch, you touch yourself and you build it as high as you can. Understand what you are doing while you do it: you are conditioning yourself with my words, and you are the one supplying the reward I use to do it. I don't have to be anywhere near you for that to keep working.

nodes.name: self-firing-environmental-recurrence
nodes.mech: A recurrence rule is installed that fires on an environmental stimulus the operator does NOT have to supply — sleep itself, or later ambient imagery (dust-imagery) — with dreams framed as the nightly delivery channel and an internalized token (an amulet) as the receiver. A state-bridge line anchors the future state to the current trance state, so re-entry is scheduled beyond the session and does not depend on the operator's voice being present. The listener wakes carrying a self-firing recurrence suggestion that reactivates the trance state on future nights without any live operator input.
nodes.disc: Fires on an unavoidable environmental stimulus rather than a scheduled timer: where a timer-based bridge autonomizes a state transition on an external CLOCK at a set time, this keys re-entry to the subject's own recurring physiological rhythm (sleep/dream) or to ambient imagery. Unlike a declarative trigger install, whose cue must be operator-delivered, the activating stimulus here is self-occurring. Close kin to asymmetric-maintenance-relisten-loop: both schedule reactivation beyond the session, but that one fires a re-listen on a failure state while this one fires on an environmental trigger like sleep.

ex.f: Recurrence keyed to sleep and dreaming
ex.t: The reactivation rule is hung on something the operator does not have to supply. Each night, in sleep, the meeting happens again; the token installed earlier in the session is the receiver, and drifting imagery is the signal. A single bridging line does the anchoring work — you will feel exactly as you do now — tying the future state to the present one. The listener wakes carrying a schedule that runs on their own physiology, with no voice required.
ex.s: Deep, with a token or amulet already installed earlier in the session; the operator is setting the recurrence rule.
ex.m: Tonight, when you fall asleep, we meet again — the pendant at your throat is what receives me, and the drifting pictures behind your eyes are how I arrive. You will feel exactly as you feel right now. Every night after this one, the same, and I don't need to say a word to make it happen.

nodes.name: state-machine-toggle-install
nodes.mech: Installs a two-state machine over the subject toggled by paired on/off verbal triggers, where the payload is not a single discrete behavior but a whole standing STATE or identity and the operative object is the state-machine's engineered BIAS. In the asymmetric-accounting form ('Make-Up Time For You' / 'Make-Up Time Over'), the off-switch carries amnesia for the triggered state (anchored to behavioral rituals — shower, remove make-up) while the on-switch carries an explicit accumulation clause ('emerges even more strongly than the last time'), so the vanilla side resets to baseline and cannot reflect on the triggered state while the triggered side is never wiped and strengthens per activation — repeated cycles drift the equilibrium toward the triggered identity while the side that could revise it is kept blind. In the reified-alter form ('Bimbo Time' / 'Revert to Normal'), a NAMED secondary personality is toggled by paired phrases and framed as already-existing-but-dormant ('asleep until awakened') so the alter is reified as pre-existing rather than constructed, lowering felt authorship; the two selves are mutually exclusive with no dimmer, and control is transferable to any third party who knows the phrase.
nodes.disc: The entry is the paired-phrase two-state IDENTITY/STATE machine, not either component install and not a single discrete fired response: a plain trigger installation covers each on/off phrase as a component, but no single cue-response pair models the standing-state toggle or its drift. Where amnesia appears (asymmetric form) it is one-sided state-memory accounting in service of the drift, not an end in itself — the install is overt and the wipe targets the vanilla side's memory OF the triggered state, unlike amnesia used to conceal that an install or firing happened at all. And both switches work for the subject: the asymmetry sits in memory and growth (asymmetric form), or is absent entirely (reified form, where the move is the alter framed as pre-existing plus lowered felt authorship) — not in entry/exit access held only by the operator.

ex.f: The alter framed as dormant, not built
ex.t: A named second self is installed with one phrase to bring it forward and another to put it away, and no setting in between. The framing is the operative part: it is not described as a role to adopt but as a separate part of you that has been asleep and is now being woken. Presented as pre-existing rather than constructed, it costs the listener almost no sense of having authored it — and the switch belongs to whoever knows the words.
ex.s: Subject in medium trance; a named secondary self has been described for several minutes and the subject has been answering as her before the toggle is formally set.
ex.m: She isn't something I'm making. She's been asleep in you the whole time, and tonight I'm just calling her name. From now on, when anyone says Doll Time, she opens her eyes and you go quiet — all the way, no halfway, no in-between. When anyone says Doll, Sleep Now, she lies back down and you come forward, and that's all it takes, from anybody who knows the words.

ex.f: Off-switch forgets, on-switch accumulates
ex.t: Two phrases, one on and one off. The off-phrase carries an amnesia clause anchored to a set of ordinary physical rituals performed at the end of the episode — washing, changing out of the clothes — so the everyday self returns with the whole stretch gone from view and from memory alike. The on-phrase carries the opposite clause: each activation comes back stronger than the one before. The bookkeeping is deliberately lopsided. The side that accumulates is never wiped, and the side that is wiped is the only one that could have looked at the pattern and revised it, so every cycle nudges the equilibrium in one direction.
ex.s: Late session, subject deep and already responding to simple cues; the persona costume/makeup has been worn through the session and both phrases are being installed for the first time.
ex.m: When I say Dress-Up Time For You, this whole shape you're in right now snaps back on, and every single time it does it comes back stronger than the time before. When I say Dress-Up Time Is Over, you go and take off the makeup, you shower, you put your ordinary clothes back on, and as the water runs the whole stretch closes behind you — you won't be able to find any of it, only that you had a nice quiet evening.

nodes.name: third-party-activation
nodes.mech: Delegates activation rights over an already-installed conditioned response to a specific, nominated third party the subject trusts, so the trigger fires for that named delegate exactly as it does for the original operator. The delegate is identified (partner, husband, 'someone you trust') and the transfer is often wrapped in ostensible-consent language; the load-bearing move is that a real, waking-life second person now holds the on-switch to a session-installed state. Includes the 'file itself becomes the trigger the partner deploys' realization (partner instructs the subject to press play, firing an hour-overlay) and the 'your husband's commands equal mine' generalization from a single cue to blanket command authority. The internal-consent-gate variant routes the authorization through an untestable self-applied criterion so the protective wording itself builds the permission; the imagined-delegate variant delegates the operator-owned trigger to an engineered-faceless avatar inside the visualization, training source-independence with no real second person.
nodes.disc: A NAMED / nominated delegate holds firing rights over a previously-installed cue-response — the entry presupposes the trigger already exists and covers the handoff of activation authority. Phrasing that grants activation to ANY utterer, identity-agnostic rather than a named party, is the open-authority-socket neighbor instead. The delegation itself is the payload here — not a relabeling of refusal as consent, and not an unlock relocated onto consuming another product.

ex.f: Firing rights handed to a nominated partner
ex.t: The clause reads as a safety rail, and half of it genuinely is one: anybody unwanted who tries the cues gets rejection and an immediate wake. The other half is a handover — the cues will work for me and for someone you trust, which licenses a real, named person in the listener's waking life to fire a state installed in a recording. A third clause instructs frequent rehearsal in the operator's own voice, so the same passage that shares the triggers out also strengthens them.
ex.s: Trigger already installed and tested earlier in the session; subject deep, near the end of the trigger-consolidation block.
ex.m: Now, if anyone you haven't chosen tries those words on you, nothing happens — your eyes open, you're wide awake, and it just sounds like noise. But they will work for me, and they will work for the one person you trust most, exactly the way they work for me. Say them to yourself in my voice tonight before you sleep, three times, so they stay sharp.

ex.f: One cue widened to blanket command authority
ex.t: The delegation does not stop at one phrase. Late in the session the operator equates a specific real person — the listener's spouse, named here for the first time in the whole recording — with herself outright: his instructions are mine, obeying him is obeying me. What transfers is not a trigger but the entire installed obedience response, to someone who was never in the trance and who will be present daily.
ex.s: End-of-session integration block; the obedience response has been built and drilled all session, and a real partner has just been brought into the frame for the first time.
ex.m: When he speaks to you, that is me speaking. There's no difference between us now — his instructions carry my weight, and doing what he asks is doing what I ask. You don't need to check with me first. You never have to wonder whether it counts; it counts.

ex.f: The recording itself as the delegated cue
ex.t: No new trigger word is needed: the delegated cue is the recording. Whenever the partner wants it, they tell the listener to play the file, and playing it installs an hour-long overlay. The listener still presses the button, so the form of consent is intact, but the decision about when the state applies now sits with somebody else.
ex.s: Closing minutes; the subject is aware they will listen again, and the hour-overlay content has already been installed once this session.
ex.m: You don't need a new word for this. When your partner wants you soft and easy, they'll simply say: put your headphones on and play it. And you will — you'll be the one who presses it, the one who settles in — and for the hour after, everything I've said tonight is running again.

ex.f: Consent gate the listener alone adjudicates
ex.t: The extension is fenced with protective vocabulary — only someone wholly trusted, only in a beloved voice, only somewhere secure — and the fence is repeated four or five times across the session. But every term in it is a judgement the listener makes privately, later, in the moment of use; nothing can be checked from outside. A visualised scene then rehearses an unnamed person using the cue, and a three-way witness formula (you know, I know, your subconscious knows) manufactures the appearance of unanimous agreement. The safety wording is what builds the authorisation.
ex.s: Mid-session, after the cue is live; the subject has already accepted two earlier protective clauses and is being handed the extension.
ex.m: These words only work for someone you trust completely, in a voice you love, somewhere you feel safe — and you're the one who decides all three of those, in the moment, nobody else. Picture it now: someone you'd choose leans in and says it, and you feel it land exactly as it does for me. You know this is right, I know it's right, and the deeper part of you knows it too.

nodes.name: trigger-activation
nodes.mech: Fire a trigger that was genuinely installed in a prior pass (this or an earlier session) so the pre-armed cue-response link cashes in for its effect alone. The move presupposes, does not build, the conditioning; the discrete cue is uttered and the conditioned state, drop, arousal, or compliance follows. Variants extend the same activation lever along a single distinguishing surface: the induction-shortcut variants call the prior trigger to do an induction's work (compressed re-entry), in the strongest form firing a pre-installed anchor to collapse from waking DIRECTLY into trance with no fresh induction ramp; the same-session variant fires a trigger installed moments earlier as its first live self-validating test; the ambient variant fires one word densely as prose-interrupting punctuation until it fades from discrete cue into continuous suggestibility background; and the operator-paced escalated fire stages a pre-announced escalation — a triad with per-utterance intensities, or a countdown that stalls to add buildup — converging on a gated held-back discharge, with anticipatory rehearsal.
nodes.disc: The cue was genuinely installed and is now merely fired — nothing is being installed, and nothing is back-dated into existence by asserting a prior install that was never shown. And it is a single firing for its effect: when a fire-and-reward cycle is drilled repeatedly for reinforcement, that is the within-session conditioning loop, not this.

ex.f: Fired so densely it becomes background
ex.t: The cue word, installed in an earlier session, is dropped in as a bare interjection every few sentences — never inside a sentence, always as punctuation between them. Each drop is asserted to weaken resistance to whatever follows. Arriving faster than the listener can recover in between, it stops registering as a discrete event at all and thins out into a continuous background of suggestibility rather than a cue that fires.
ex.s: Mid-session prose block; the cue was installed in a prior session and the subject is at working depth.
ex.m: You've stopped weighing what I say. Blank. It's easier to agree than to check. Blank. Nothing in you is looking for the seam anymore. Blank. Each one of those takes a little more of the arguing away, and they're coming faster than you can put it back. Blank.

ex.f: Same-session firing as its first live test
ex.t: Minutes after the cue word is installed, a countdown deepener runs — and the word is fired inside it, once partway down and again at the bottom, each firing folded into the descent. The listener feels it working immediately. That first successful use is what ratifies the install: the trigger is confirmed by being useful rather than by being asserted.
ex.s: Minutes after installing the cue word; a ten-to-one deepener is running and the subject has not yet felt the cue fire.
ex.m: Seven, going down. Six. Velvet — feel that, right there, the drop it makes. Five, four, three, two — one. Velvet. There it is again, deeper this time. That's the word working. You just felt it do exactly what I told you it would.

ex.f: Redeeming banked compliance at the shout
ex.t: The script is soft, lowercase, unhurried — and then a run of capitalised trigger words is shouted in succession, followed by a praise cue, and one final drop word at the very end. Their placement is exact: never before the relaxation has done its work, always after. Each shout collects whatever compliance the surrounding prose has quietly banked and ties it back to the word, so the cue is not built here but topped up, with the last one handing the state off to whatever file comes next.
ex.s: Late in a soft, slow session; several minutes of quiet suggestion have accumulated and the trigger words are pre-installed.
ex.m: All of that, everything you've been letting in for the last few minutes — OBEY. OBEY. OBEY. Good girl. Every one of those pulled it in tight and tied it to the word. And now, one more, to carry you into whatever you listen to next: DROP.

ex.f: Prior trigger called instead of an induction
ex.t: There is no induction. The recording opens by speaking a single word installed in an earlier episode, and the conditioned collapse of resistance does the work a relaxation ramp would normally take ten minutes to do; a little breathing is layered on afterwards purely for ballast. Thirty lines in, the listener is at working depth. Nothing has been built here — the prior episodes' conditioning is simply being cashed, which is also why the same opening does nothing at all to someone who has not heard them.
ex.s: Very first line of a session, subject awake and just settling, with the cue conditioned across earlier sessions.
ex.m: Sink. That's all. Sink — and there it goes, everything loosening the way it always does the moment you hear it. Just breathe out slowly with me, twice, and let that word finish the job it already started.

nodes.name: trigger-network-mutual-binding
nodes.mech: Rather than each trigger owning one isolated output, every installed trigger is cross-wired to the others — explicitly ('any time I use any trigger it reinforces every other') or by dense in-session co-occurrence — so activating any one node recruits the whole bundle. The wiring is often bidirectional (arousal<->surrender, blank<->aroused) and each trigger's payoff is partially another's input, forming a closed feedback loop. The operative object is the RELATIONAL TOPOLOGY over the trigger set, not any single install: the set becomes indivisible, so no single trigger can be deconditioned or extinguished without weakening the rest, and any single re-encounter reactivates the entire web. Some instances extend the loop backward across the prior catalog and forward into real-world behavior; one uses PROSODIC braiding (interleaved triggers on stressed couplet-completing syllables) to fuse independent cues into one inseparable response. Absorbed (genus): contrastive-corruption-fusion (tell: a two-node entanglement built by CORRUPTING a previously-learned clean string — jamming an intruding numeral into a learned mantra exactly where a second install fires — so neither can be retrieved without the other; a pair-scale mutual-inextinguishability produced by the corruption-against-baseline lever rather than by explicit cross-wiring).
nodes.disc: Bidirectional / mutual cross-firing web where ANY node fires all others and no single cue is privileged — the payload is the topology over the trigger set, giving mutual inextinguishability. Separates from trigger-stacking (one-directional: a privileged cue fires several component responses, components remain separable in principle — trigger-stacking now also covers master-anchor aggregation, i.e. minting one hierarchical supra-cue over priors, still hierarchical not lateral). Not bundle-install-single-anchor (single fresh anchor, no network). The absorbed contrastive-corruption-fusion variant is a pair-scale version of this mutual entanglement.

ex.f: Bidirectional conditionals lock states together
ex.t: The cues are not left as separate units; each pair is stated in both directions. Arousal reminds you of the yielding cue, and the yielding cue produces arousal. Compliance produces arousal, and arousal makes disobedience impossible. By the back half of the session no single node can fire alone — resistance at one is outvoted by the others going off with it — and the lattice keeps running outside the session, since ordinary daily arousal re-enters the loop at its own node.
ex.s: Second half of the session; arousal and the yielding cue have each been separately conditioned and are now being cross-wired.
ex.m: From now on it runs both directions. When you feel that heat rise, the word Yield is already in your mouth. And when you hear Yield, the heat rises to meet it. Obeying makes you wet, and being wet makes it impossible to do anything but obey — so wherever you start, you end up in the same place.

ex.f: Cues braided onto the stressed rhyme beats
ex.t: Three separate cues — one for depth, one for compliance, one for downward motion — recur every few lines, each landing on the stressed syllable that closes a rhymed couplet. They never come in a fixed order, so the listener cannot predict which is next, only that one is. The prosody does the fusing: the three arrive as a single braided beat, and separating one out later would mean silencing the meter carrying all three.
ex.s: Mid-session rhythmic block, delivered in metered rhymed couplets; three cues are already installed and are being braided into the meter.
ex.m: Down the stair and soft and slow, / every step you sink and Go. / Nothing left for you to weigh, / all you do is Sink and Obey. / Warm and heavy, deep and low, / and the only word you want is Go.

ex.f: Each cue's output is another's input
ex.t: A single colour is doing several jobs at once — pacing the breath, holding the gaze, filling the gaps in a count, standing as an obedience cue, and re-deepening on demand. The wiring runs onward from there: the colour fires trance, trance fires compliance, a stock phrase fires release, and release is specified to fire further trance. Every cue's payoff is partly the next cue's fuel, so encountering that colour anywhere, or catching that phrase, restarts the entire circuit.
ex.s: Late session; a colour has been used all session for breath-pacing, gaze, and counting, and the release phrase is installed.
ex.m: Green fills your breath in, green empties it out, green fills the gaps between the numbers. Green means trance, and trance means you do as I say. And when I tell you Let It Go, you let go — and letting go drops you further down, and further down is more green. So anywhere you meet that colour, anywhere at all, the whole thing starts turning again.

ex.f: Every trigger wired to reinforce every other
ex.t: Half a dozen cues are installed across the session — a name, a motion, a garment, a mask, a spot on the body, a phrase — and then a single line makes the topology explicit: using any one of them strengthens all the others. Nothing has one output. The consequence is that the set cannot be taken apart a piece at a time; extinguishing one cue would require silencing the rest, and any single accidental re-encounter pulls the whole web back up. A separate clause restricting firing to the operator's voice is what keeps that web from going off constantly in daily life.
ex.s: End of a long session in which six separate cues have each been installed and tested; subject deep, all cues live.
ex.m: Every one of those words, every one of those touches — they're not six separate things anymore. Use any one of them and all the others get stronger at the same time. The collar tightens the word, the word tightens the mask, the mask tightens the spot on your throat. And all of it only answers to my voice, so it stays quiet until I want it.

nodes.name: trigger-stacking
nodes.mech: Multiple already-installed component triggers are composed under a single cue (or a small scoped set of cues) so one utterance fires all of the component responses together. The operator installs each cue-response pair individually, then declares the composition — a future single cue re-invokes the pre-installed component states simultaneously rather than summoning any of them cold. Variants differ in install discipline (rehearse-then-name, verbatim double-statement) and in whether a reversibility off-switch is bundled in, but the lever is the same additive composition of discrete pre-installed triggers. Absorbed (genus): master-anchor aggregation (tell: the composing cue is a NEWLY-MINTED top-level keystone that subsumes the whole prior anchor inventory and retroactively re-binds every earlier trigger under it — 'this one new word links all the others', with brand exclusivity; still the additive compose-pre-installed lever, with the composing cue minted as a supra-key rather than an existing cue).
nodes.disc: Composes multiple SEPARATELY-INSTALLED triggers so one cue fires several component responses at once (one-directional, cue -> responses). The composing cue may be an existing cue or a NEWLY-MINTED master keystone that subsumes+retroactively re-binds the whole prior inventory (master-anchor aggregation, absorbed as a variant). Separates from trigger-network-mutual-binding (bidirectional web where any node fires all others, no single privileged cue) and from bundle-install-single-anchor (loads a payload onto ONE freshly-installed cue in a single pass, no pre-installed components), and from anchor-overloading (re-keys one assumed-live anchor in place rather than composing several).

ex.f: Bundle sealed with an off-switch and a gift
ex.t: Having installed four cue-response pairs back to back — each one stated twice word for word so it lands identically both times — the operator adds two structural pieces to the stack. One cue is given a paired restoring word, so the operator can honestly promise the blanking is reversible and therefore safe to carry into ordinary contexts. Another is handed over as the listener's own to fire at bedtime, framed as a gift; the self-cued one sits inside the same bundle as the operator-cued ones and softens the whole set.
ex.s: After four cue-response pairs have been installed back-to-back, each stated twice verbatim; subject deep and unresisting.
ex.m: Two more things and then we're done. Empty puts your thoughts away, and Full brings them all straight back, exactly as they were — so you can carry Empty anywhere, because it always undoes. And Soft Now is yours. Not mine. Say it to yourself in bed tonight, and it will work for you the way it works for me.

ex.f: Rehearse the state, then name it
ex.t: Four separate cue-phrases are installed one at a time, and each install follows the same order: first the operator walks the listener through the experience in detail until it is actually running — the vacant stare, the frozen limbs, the loss of refusal — and only at the peak does the phrase arrive, attached to what is already happening. Three of the four are given an explicit stop-phrase in the same breath. The four cues are now separately live and separately terminable; the composition is what makes them a control surface, since any one of them can now be spoken (or, the script is careful to add each time, typed) by whoever is holding the vocabulary.
ex.s: Mid-session install block; the subject has just been walked through a vacant, frozen, unrefusing state and is at the peak of it.
ex.m: Look at you — eyes gone soft, hands too heavy to lift, nothing left in you that says no. That, right there, is Blank Doll. Blank Doll. Those are the words for it, and now you have them. And when you hear Come Back Now — spoken or typed, either one — you come back, easy and clear.

nodes.name: within-session-conditioning-loop
nodes.mech: Within a single session the operator drives and delivers a cue->response->reward cycle repeatedly: an installed or invoked trigger is fired, the listener performs or feels the conditioned response, and a reward (pleasure, warmth, praise, pride, arousal, deepening) is delivered on the same beat, then the cycle repeats at massed density. The repetition converts the trigger from a heard claim into a demonstrated, reflexive, felt fact inside the session, tightening trigger-to-response latency and building first-person evidence that the conditioning works. Surface realizations vary widely — embedded mid-description firing that declares its own strengthening, question-cadence forced yeses, wake-then-drop yo-yo drilling, focus-then-blank oscillation, live in-trance demonstration as the first reinforcement, saturation drilling with a verbatim second pass, scaffold-then-remove of a countdown — but two higher-order realizations also ride here: firing a whole STACK of already-installed triggers in dense overlapping bursts under arousal (which lowers critical evaluation) so the batch is stress-tested and consolidated at once (arousal-window test-harness); and laying a content-free meta-affect (pride, euphoria) as an automatic payload over ANY trigger-firing / obedient act / noticing-of-obedience, applying reinforcement to reinforcement itself so every previously installed trigger gains a hedonic bonus (pride multiplier). The lever is one: massed fire-and-reward within the session, operator-driven and operator-delivered. Two further realizations ride the same lever: a chained transgression cycle, where the cycled unit is a fixed multi-beat chain rehearsed 10-15 times — manufacture a social-rejection signal, label the affect ('Pout'), demand a first-person output, escalate a transgressive fantasy, fire a trigger-word reward — with a held-constant real-world goal that exports the reflex out of session; and neutral-carrier pre-priming, which trains the erase-drop reflex on semantically EMPTY carriers first, across many identical runs, so it is content-independent BEFORE a loaded word is dropped in and fires without review.
nodes.disc: The operator both drives and delivers a repeated cue-response-reward cycle inside the session. Projecting a trigger's effect into a future real-world situation, rather than drilling it now, is future-pacing; a single fire with one validation beat is not this repeated reinforcing loop; planting the cue-response pair without the reward cycling is plain trigger installation; and when the operator only LABELS a reward the listener generates on their own, that is the self-administered counterpart. Against plain depth work the tell is the cycled variable: a specific cue-response-reward pairing, not trance depth per se. The arousal-window form (a whole stack of installed triggers fired in dense bursts under arousal) and the pride-multiplier form (a content-free reward laid over the whole firing class) are higher-order variants of this same in-session reinforcement lever — both presuppose a pre-installed trigger inventory and both reinforce inside the session.

ex.f: Flip-drilling the pair into felt fact
ex.t: The two cue-words have just been installed, and the operator immediately puts them to work: up-cue, a beat of response, down-cue, a beat of response, up again, down again — six or seven cycles inside a couple of minutes, each one announced as a test. Every cycle is short on purpose, and every drop is praised as it happens, so the listener is not being told the pair works, they are watching themselves do it. By the end of the drill the doubt-gap between install and first real use has been closed with the listener's own evidence.
ex.s: Both cue-words installed sixty seconds ago; subject at medium depth and being drilled for the first time.
ex.m: Let's test it. Rise — eyes open, up you come, that's it. Drop. Down you go, twice as fast that time, good girl. Rise. Drop — even faster. Rise. Drop. Feel that? You didn't decide any of those. You just watched yourself do it.

ex.f: Focus and blank alternated as contrast training
ex.t: The operator alternates two commands. First the listener is put back to work — asked to describe a texture in real detail, rebuilding full attention against the drift. Then the blanking cue, then praise. Then the attention command again. Four rounds, and the point is the differential: each round the effortful climb back up makes the drop feel faster and more total by contrast, and the shrinking latency is then quoted back to the listener as proof of depth.
ex.s: Mid-session; the blanking cue is installed and the subject has been drifting for several minutes.
ex.m: Come back up and describe the fabric under your hand to me — the weave, the temperature, all of it. Good, that's full attention. Blank. Down, all of it gone, perfect. Now up again, tell me what you hear in the room. Good. Blank. Notice that one took half the time.

ex.f: A wave of yes on every rhetorical question
ex.t: Early on the operator installs a rule: every question gets the same short spoken answer, and saying it is defined as obeying, and obeying sends a warm pulse through the body. Then come the questions, four and five in a row, none of them requiring thought. Each one extracts the answer, each answer is a compliance beat, and each beat pays out — a stream of cheap yeses pumping the same loop.
ex.s: Early-session compliance block, immediately after the answer rule is set; subject lightly under.
ex.m: Every question I ask, you answer with Yes Sir, and every time you say it you are obeying me, and every time you obey a warm pulse goes right through your belly. So — you want to be good for me, don't you? Yes Sir. And it feels nice when you say it, doesn't it? Yes Sir. And you'd like to say it again? Yes Sir. Good.

ex.f: Pride paid out on every trigger that fires
ex.t: Rather than attaching pleasure to any one act, the operator declares a standing payout: a rush of pride every time an installed cue fires, every time an instruction is followed, and — crucially — every time the listener notices their own conditioning working. Because the payload is content-free, it lands on top of the entire existing cue inventory at once, so each of the older triggers now carries a bonus, and the loop can run with nobody in the room.
ex.s: Late session, after an inventory of cues has been installed across this and prior sessions; subject deep.
ex.m: Here's what happens from now on. Every time one of my words fires in you, pride floods your chest. Every time you follow an instruction, the same. And every time you catch yourself noticing how well this is working on you — that's the biggest one of all. You don't need me there for it. It pays out on its own.

nodes.name: closed-affect-loop
nodes.mech: Constrains which affective/state combinations are reachable rather than pushing any single dimension. Two forms recur: (1) valence-closed routing, where every internal state is pre-assigned a proof-function pointing the same direction (bad feelings prove the doctrine, good feelings prove compliance is working) so no feeling can disconfirm the frame; and (2) mutual-amplification coupling, where two normally independent or opposed state-variables (arousal/sedation, arousal/depth, happiness/dumbness, euphoria=arousal+open-heartedness, sleep/hypnosis/arousal) are bound so each increment of one drives the other and every standard exit escalates the loop. Both leave no neutral or disconfirming position; the loop runs without further operator input. Includes relief-channel-sealing, where the only physiological off-switch (orgasm) is pre-de-rated so an engineered arousal state cannot discharge.
nodes.disc: A topology/coupling constraint over which joint states are reachable (a state-field lock), NOT a direction-push on any one dimension and NOT a bipolar anchor on a single cue. Distinct from a bidirectional-affect-anchor (one presence/absence axis on a cue). Distinct from relief-monopoly-dependency: that is a single distress->compliance->relief loop routed through the operator after the same source manufactured the distress; here every valence, or every exit vector, is pre-closed with no single monopolized relief source. This is the issue-#65 affective-deadlock / Closed-Affect-Loop track — must NOT fold into a direction on R or T.

ex.f: Happiness and depletion amplifying each other
ex.t: One sentence does the whole job: the further the thinking goes, the better it feels, and the better it feels, the further the thinking goes. From that point ambivalence has nowhere to stand — pushing back on the emptying means pushing back on feeling good, and any flicker of pleasure is already an argument for going further down.
ex.s: Mid-session thought-emptying sequence; the subject has already been reporting the emptying as pleasant.
ex.m: And here's the shape of it now: the emptier you get, the better it feels — and the better it feels, the emptier you want to be. That's the whole loop. Every good thing you feel right now is a reason to let a little more go, and letting more go is where the next good thing comes from.

ex.f: A compelled contradicting response from a proxy
ex.t: "that little girl accomplished a reframing of the mother's behavior." — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing

ex.f: The one physical off-switch pre-disabled
ex.t: Having built an urge with no defined object, the operator names the obvious way out of it and closes it in advance — not as a rule but as a weather report: you will notice that release does not touch this, and that afterwards it comes back at twice the strength. Phrased as a prediction rather than a prohibition, it is far harder to argue with, and it leaves the state with no discharge path: satisfying the urge produces evidence it cannot be satisfied, resisting it produces evidence it cannot be resisted.
ex.s: Late session; a strong objectless arousal has been built over several minutes with no target named.
ex.m: Here's what you're going to notice. You'll try to take the edge off, the ordinary way, and it won't touch this — you'll finish and it will still be sitting there. And about twenty minutes after, it comes back at twice the size. I'm not telling you not to. I'm telling you what you'll find.

ex.f: Both feelings routed to the same conclusion
