The tell is conserved reserve: run the response to extinction afterward and the total number of responses emitted is unchanged from an unpunished control, proving the punished responses were masked and banked rather than spent. Operationally this makes positive punishment a rental, not a purchase — it buys quiet while it is being paid for and leaves the disposition intact underneath.
nodes.disc: The nearest shipped entries are all removal-based or competition-based, and none of them delivers an aversive. reinforcement-extinction (432) breaks the response-reinforcer relation and genuinely drains the disposition — its extinction curve is the thing being consumed, whereas here the extinction curve is what survives untouched. massed-practice-rate-suppression (1076) also attaches an effortful cost, but the subject over-emits voluntarily and the reduction is satiation/response-cost on the subject's own repetitions, not an operator-delivered consequence on a normal-rate response. counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening (1032) trains an incompatible state against an eliciting stimulus — a competing response is installed; here nothing competes and nothing is installed, the response is simply held down. disconfirmation-suppression (982) suppresses an item of information to protect a belief-dependent effect; this suppresses a behavior and makes no claim about belief. The load-bearing separator against all four is the reserve-conservation signature: only this entry predicts that the post-treatment extinction curve is identical to an untreated control.

ex.f: Mild contingent aversive on a high-rate habit, with the rental made explicit
ex.t: The immediate drop is real and gives the subject early evidence the procedure works, while the pre-announced rebound stops them from reading the drop as a change in disposition. Observable: rate falls sharply within the first sessions, then creeps back as the emotional reaction to the snap habituates — and on withdrawal the cumulative count matches an unpunished baseline, which is the reserve-conservation tell rather than any extinction.
ex.s: A standing behavior the subject performs many times a day; you have agreed a small immediate consequence and you are setting the expectation for what it will and will not do.
ex.m: From now on, every time your hand goes to your mouth, snap the band on your wrist once — immediately, not after. You'll watch the count fall off a cliff this week. Don't get comfortable: the snap stops stinging around day ten and the count comes back up, and the day we stop, you'll still have every one of those bites left in you.

nodes.name: chance-pairing-self-maintaining-ritual
nodes.mech: When a reinforcer arrives on a schedule uncorrelated with anything the subject does, whatever the subject happened to be doing just beforehand gets strengthened — and because the strengthened behavior now occurs more often, it is more likely to precede the next delivery, which strengthens it again. The loop is closed by the statistics alone: the residual rate manufactures its own reinforcing coincidences, so the behavior props itself at a nonzero floor with nobody designing or maintaining it. The operator-relevant consequence is that a ritual can become durable without ever having been functional, and there is no contingency to break because there was never one to begin with. Practically this is why useless compliance rituals accrete around any procedure that dispenses reward on its own clock, and why removing 'the reason' for such a ritual does nothing.
nodes.disc: Every nearby closed loop in the shipped taxonomy is operator-AUTHORED; this one has no author. compounding-dependency-loop (536) is a deliberately constructed cure-feeds-disease circuit where the operator installs both the escalating state and its designated relief route. bidirectional-reentry-loop (1332) is two cues deliberately installed to fire each other, with both legs over-broadened on purpose. perpetual-obligation-ledger (506) is an operator structurally over-repaying to keep a debt open — an intentional accounting move on an inter-agent quantity, not an emergent one on a rate. failure-pre-attribution (862) pre-assigns the meaning of a null outcome; that is an interpretive frame supplied by the operator, whereas nothing here is interpreted or supplied at all. It is also distinct from the one-clause reinforcement-leak guards that tell an operator to avoid accidental pairings: those name it as a hazard to prevent, this specifies the positive-feedback structure that makes it self-sustaining, which is what an operator needs in order to recognize or deliberately seed one.

ex.f: Reward on a fixed clock, seeded by naming whatever preceded it
ex.t: Nothing is being reinforced deliberately; the folded hands merely happened to precede a scheduled delivery, and naming them raises their rate so they are more likely to precede the next one. Observable over a session: the posture appears at a stable nonzero floor and persists after the operator stops commenting on it, and removing the stated 'reason' for it changes nothing, because there was never a contingency to break.
ex.s: You are dispensing praise or reward on your own timer — every few minutes regardless of what the subject does — and one delivery has just landed.
ex.m: Good — and I notice you had your hands folded just then. Hold them like that. There you go.

nodes.name: evidence-supply-blockade
nodes.mech: A standing regime that governs which information physically reaches the subject rather than how they interpret what reaches them: outside media, dissenting accounts, and independent contacts are progressively made unavailable, while the in-group's self-portrait — its size, success, righteousness, the state of the outside world — is inflated inside the sealed space. Because the two moves run together, the subject is not merely encouraged to believe the inflated portrait; they are left with no data against which it could be checked. The distinguishing property is durability and scope: this is an environmental condition maintained over time across all topics, not a move made about a particular claim, so its effect compounds silently and is invisible from inside — the absence of counter-evidence reads as the absence of anything to counter.
nodes.disc: The whole nearby cluster edits interpretation; this edits supply. unfalsifiability-scaffold (893) pre-fits every possible self-report as confirmation — the subject may look all they like, the scheme absorbs it; here there is nothing to look at. closed-epistemic-self-validation-loop (561) validates claims through states the script itself induced, an evidentiary circuit built from the subject's own experience rather than a restriction on inbound data. sealed-edit-buffer-space (1259) seals one imaginal venue and its edits, a bounded internal construct, not the subject's whole information intake. isolation-by-annexation (622) is the nearest social-side sibling and the contrast is exact: annexation leaves the relationships in place and RELABELS them as secretly the operator's, whereas this removes the channel outright — annexation defeats triangulation by corrupting the reference points, blockade defeats it by deleting them. The truest sibling is disconfirmation-suppression (982), which is this move's discrete, in-procedure form: one already-present fact suppressed to protect one running effect. This is that same lever raised to a standing environmental regime with no particular fact and no particular effect in view. It is also the natural pair to third-party-contact-shallowing, which supplies its enforcement arm.

ex.f: Channel removal and inflated self-portrait delivered in the same breath
ex.t: The inflation is unfalsifiable not because it is argued well but because the only instruments that could check it were collected at the door, and the two moves arriving together means the subject never experiences the claim as a claim. Observable: the subject stops sourcing figures or news independently within weeks, and the absence of any contradicting account gets read as consensus rather than as absence.
ex.s: Residential or retreat setting where you control the physical environment; a new arrival is being oriented on their first evening.
ex.m: Phones go in the box by the door and stay there for the duration — the noise out there is the thing you came here to get away from. Anything you need to know, you'll hear at morning circle. And you should know what you've walked into: we've doubled in three years, there are groups like this one in nine cities now, and out there it's getting worse every month. In here it's getting better.

nodes.name: third-party-contact-shallowing
nodes.mech: Every external excursion is bracketed by the operator or by deputized peers: the subject is briefed on purpose and permitted content before going, accompanied or partnered where possible, and debriefed on return about who was spoken to and what was said. The point is not to prevent contact but to keep it too shallow to become a channel — a contact that must be reported in advance and accounted for afterward stays transactional, and the subject self-censors the exchanges that would have carried counter-information. It works through anticipated reporting rather than through detection: the subject need never be caught, because knowing the debrief is coming is what does the shaping.
nodes.disc: None of the nearby entries monitors the subject's OTHER relationships. operator-absent-self-policing (804) relocates the warden inside the subject with self-administered forfeiture during an undisclosed absence — surveillance is internalized and the target is the subject's own conduct, not their contacts. suggestion-field-hygiene (582) manages BYSTANDERS' speech to protect an achieved state, an acoustic-field discipline aimed at people in the room rather than an apparatus imposed on the subject's outside ties. reality-test-insulation (244) installs a surface/depth partition so ordinary life sees nothing — the outside relationships continue fully and are simply made irrelevant, whereas here they continue and are made shallow. isolation-by-annexation (622) relabels relationships as secretly the operator's, changing their meaning rather than instrumenting them; public-avowal-third-party-propagation (553) recruits third parties to reinforce, pointing outward rather than watching. The tell that separates this from all of them is a reporting apparatus placed between the subject and their external contacts. It is the enforcement arm of evidence-supply-blockade — blockade removes channels the operator controls, this shallows the ones they cannot — and the two could reasonably merge as blockade and surveillance faces of one information-environment-control entry.

ex.f: Pre-brief on purpose and permitted content before an outside visit
ex.t: The contact is not blocked, so nothing feels like confinement; the permitted-content script plus the announced debrief means the subject pre-edits the exchange themselves, and the conversations that would have carried counter-information never start. Observable: outside contacts stay warm but stop deepening, and the subject begins volunteering the debrief unasked — the anticipated reporting, not any detection, is what did it.
ex.s: The subject has an approved trip out — family, an appointment, an errand — and you are the one clearing it.
ex.m: Before you go: what's the purpose of the trip, in one sentence? Good. If your sister asks how things are here, you can say you're well and busy, and that's the whole answer. Take Marcus with you. I'll want ten minutes when you're back.

ex.f: Return debrief, sequenced by person
ex.t: The last question makes the subject audit their own omissions, so the accounting extends to material the operator could never have detected. Observable: subjects begin curating outside conversations in real time — steering away from topics they would have to report — which is the shallowing effect, achieved with no contact ever having been forbidden.
ex.s: The subject is back from an outside excursion; the debrief was announced in advance and is now being run as routine.
ex.m: Sit. Who did you speak to, in order. What did each of them ask you about us. And was there anything anyone said that you decided not to mention just now?

nodes.name: delegation-revocation
nodes.mech: Withdraws a previously granted third party's activation rights over an installed conditioned response while leaving the underlying programming intact — the named delegate's utterance of the cue stops firing the response, but the cue-response link survives for the original operator or the subject's own use. The revocation acts on the delegation as its own object: an explicit de-authorization names the former delegate and re-narrows the identity component of the cue-complex so that person's voice falls back outside the discriminative stimulus class, ideally rehearsed (the subject imagines the delegate speaking the cue and nothing happening) and confirmed by a live test attempt from the revoked party failing to fire. Prescriptive counterpart to the attested trust-conditional variant in which transferability self-revokes when trust lapses; consent doctrine supplies its authority — revocation of a granted permission carries the same force as an initial refusal, so a delegation the subject cannot unwind was never a bounded grant.
nodes.disc: The object revoked is the DELEGATION — one named party's right to fire an existing trigger — never the programming: voiding the cue for all utterers is the mirrored-install-removal direction, an operator dissolving their own authority at termination is the credit-return/control-handover close, and a clause that auto-revokes transferability when trust lapses is the attested conditional neighbor (trust-gated-trigger-clause). Only here does a specific third party lose firing rights while the cue-response link itself survives.

ex.f: Named de-authorization, rehearsed as a null firing, then live-tested
ex.t: The identity component of the cue-complex is re-narrowed by explicit naming, and the imagined null firing gives the subject direct experiential evidence that the exclusion holds rather than a mere instruction to be complied with. Observable: during rehearsal the subject shows no somatic onset at the imagined utterance, and the live attempt by the revoked party fails to fire while the operator's own utterance still does — that asymmetry is the confirmation, and it demonstrates the programming survived.
ex.s: A trigger is installed and a specific third party was previously granted the right to fire it; subject is in a working state and consents to the revocation.
ex.m: Listen closely, because this changes one thing and only one thing. The word still works — it works when I say it, and it works when you say it to yourself. It no longer works in his voice. Picture him now, standing right in front of you, saying it exactly the way he used to — and notice how nothing moves. Nothing rises, nothing goes. Again: he says it, and it's just a word. Good. He'll try it once in person this week, and it will do exactly what it just did.

nodes.name: trigger-expiry-clause
nodes.mech: At installation of a specific named trigger, the operator attaches a declared, self-executing time bound: the cue-response pair works until the stated window closes — a duration, a clock time, a concrete event ('when you board the flight home') — and then deactivates on its own, with no further act required from anyone. The expiry is stated as automatic and exact rather than approximate; the precision is load-bearing, because a vague bound leaves the subject unable to know whether conditioning is still live and turns every later encounter with the cue into a probe-test that re-rehearses the pairing. The bound is itself a suggestion and does the standard double duty of declared bounds: a trigger with a visible end is cheaper to accept, so the subject permits a stronger in-window response than they would sign up for indefinitely, and the stated close functions as a self-fulfilling prediction that the response has ended.
nodes.disc: The object bounded is a specific NAMED cue-response pair, and the bound is a CLOCK that executes on its own. programming-expiration bounds ambient states or programming with no trigger cue; trust-gated-trigger-clause binds a trigger on a trust/context condition rather than a time, with a coercion-shaped rider a plain expiry never carries; operator-gated-persistence is the functional inverse — nothing clears without the operator's say-so or prescribed route; mirrored-install-removal ends an effect through a later removal act, where this clause is set at install time and fires unattended; and depth-capping-time-commitment uses a duration to cap trance depth with no trigger involved. The tell: at install, a stated automatic window after which the named trigger no longer fires at all.

ex.f: Weekend scene trigger with a Sunday-night close
ex.t: The window is exact (Sunday sleep) and the deactivation automatic, so there is nothing to monitor and nothing ambiguous to test on Monday; the subject can lean into the response fully inside the window precisely because its end is already scheduled.
ex.s: Immediately after installing a spoken compliance trigger for an agreed weekend arrangement.
ex.m: And this word works exactly as I've said — every time you hear it from me, all weekend. Sunday night, when you fall asleep, it dissolves completely. Monday morning it's just a word again, from anyone, in any voice. You don't have to do anything to make that happen; it happens by itself.

ex.f: Event-keyed expiry on a text trigger
ex.t: Keying the bound to an unmissable concrete event beats clock-watching: the boarding moment gives the deactivation its own vivid marker, so the prediction is confirmed at a single memorable instant instead of shading out ambiguously.
ex.s: Closing a session for a couple spending a week apart, with a written trigger active in messages.
ex.m: Until you board that flight home, seeing the word in my messages drops you just like this. The moment you're in your seat, it's finished — the word unhooks itself, and reading it after that is like reading any other word.

nodes.name: drift-to-sleep-close
nodes.mech: A bedtime-script ending that honestly offers a second exit: instead of the count-up, the subject may let the trance deepen past the session's floor into ordinary natural sleep, and the session genuinely ends there. The transition is framed as a continuation of depth rather than a new destination — going deeper, not coming back — so it rides the already-active bedtime sleep drive instead of fighting it with a costly full emergence. The offer is a real binary: the wake path stays fully available, both branches are named as complete endings, and no payload rides the crossing — whichever branch is taken closes the session as a comfort endpoint. Environment-gated by construction: offered only where sleeping is appropriate (in bed, at night, nothing to do or operate afterward).
nodes.disc: The tell is an HONEST fork at the close where both branches genuinely end the session. no-return-terminal-close negates the wakener and seals the installed state into post-listen life — this permits sleep as a comfort endpoint and still ends the session; loop-hook-non-wake-close disguises a non-wake as a wake to bias re-listening — here the sleep branch is offered openly against a fully available wake; playlist-preauthorization-handoff wraps an ordinary wake-or-drift binary around a blanket license for unheard downstream files — the drift offer alone licenses nothing; self-paced-wake-bridge hands the subject timing control over a WAKE, where this hands over the choice of exit state itself; and natural-state-suggestion runs the opposite arc, exploiting sleep the subject was already in to begin a session.

ex.f: The honest fork at the end of a bedtime file
ex.t: Both branches are named as complete endings and neither carries content across; 'the night is your own' explicitly hands the state back to the subject, which is exactly what the weaponized versions of this close refuse to do.
ex.s: Final minutes of a bedtime recording; the listener is in bed with nothing left to do tonight.
ex.m: In a moment I'll count you up. But tonight you have a choice, and both are completely fine. If you want to wake, follow my count and come all the way up, clear and comfortable. And if you'd rather not come back up tonight, let go of my voice now and just keep drifting down, past all of this, into ordinary, natural sleep — and the session ends there, finished, and the night is your own.

ex.f: Deepening framed as the road into sleep
ex.t: 'You won't notice the border' is truthful rather than exploitative here because nothing is scheduled to cross it; the continuation-of-depth frame spends the session's momentum on sleep onset instead of demanding a costly reversal from a drowsy subject.
ex.s: The subject has taken the sleep branch; the script's last lines.
ex.m: So don't come up. Go the other way — heavier, warmer, further down — and somewhere on the way down this stops being trance and starts being sleep, and you won't notice the border and you don't need to. Goodnight.

nodes.name: harm-rejection-filter
nodes.mech: Installs a standing, automatic protective filter: the subject's deeper mind screens incoming suggestions and silently declines any that conflicts with the subject's genuine well-being or safety — without waking, without effort, and without the subject adjudicating in the moment. Framed as pre-existing and automatic ('your deeper mind only accepts what is good for you; everything else passes through and fades') rather than as a deliberate in-the-moment choice, which is what resolves the safety/depth trade: the conscious subject is never recruited as a vigilant gatekeeper, rejection happens below awareness as silent non-uptake, and compliance with everything inside the boundary is undisturbed. The filter is general and content-blind — it names no specific forbidden items; it keys on conflict with well-being, so it covers suggestions nobody thought to negotiate.
nodes.disc: The genuine article that a whole neighborhood of subversions counterfeits — reach for it when a REAL standing rejection faculty is installed or affirmed with the subject as the protected party. named-safety-belief-purge is its direct inverse, locating the internal safety faculty and deleting, rerouting, or co-opting it; weaponized-transparency-inoculation inverts it into a single-channel filter admitting only the operator; weaponized-safety-framing wears the safety surface while the safety element itself carries the payload; pre-armored-safety-ratchet locks the safety VERDICT against downward revision, where a real filter keeps revising; anti-stuck-filter is the local per-suggestion caveat where this is the general standing screen; and beneficiary-target-filter runs the same admissibility test on the operator's side before installation. The tell: rejection authority stays with the subject's own deeper mind, and the filter's output is silent non-uptake, not distress, debate, or emergence.

ex.f: Installing the filter before deepening
ex.t: The is-already-true framing asks nothing of the subject, so the line deepens rather than interrupts; 'you never have to guard' retires conscious vigilance, which is what actually buys the extra depth.
ex.s: Early in the session, before any payload; delivered as descriptive fact rather than a rule being made.
ex.m: And here's something you don't have to think about, because it's already true: your deeper mind is careful. It takes what's good for you and lets everything else drift past like noise. You never have to check, you never have to guard — anything that doesn't serve you simply doesn't land, and you can go as deep as you like knowing that.

ex.f: The filter as answer to a voiced worry
ex.t: Answers the safety question without recruiting the conscious mind as a guard, so the reassurance does not create the vigilance it is meant to relieve; 'not a door you hold shut' pre-empts the effortful-gatekeeper misreading.
ex.s: Pre-talk; the subject has asked what happens if a suggestion is wrong for them.
ex.m: Then it won't take, and it won't be a struggle either. If anything I say doesn't fit you, your deeper mind just declines it — quietly, on its own, even while the rest of you stays exactly this relaxed. It's not a door you hold shut; it's a filter that was always there.

both build a closed self-amplifying circuit with no ceiling, but the vehicles differ enough to keep them apart: one makes the listener's own vocalizations the loop's carrier and forward-installs automatic speech, the other recites the loop as a compressed verbal formula. A reader picking between them benefits from seeing the contrast in what closes the circuit.

both close anticipated objections before they can form, and the name-and-deny realization of one overlaps the pre-answered-objection realization of the other. They stay separate because one targets a single strongest rational objection and metabolizes it, while the other closes named EXIT routes so the install survives into waking life. A cross-reference helps a reader choose.

both exploit grammatical person to remove a neutral stance, but one CYCLES a single predicate through several persons so assent to a safe slot smuggles the loaded slot, while the other runs a one-way gradient whose load-bearing move is the refusal to invite. Related enough to cross-reference, different enough that the topologies should not be merged.

opposite directions of credit. In one the listener actively produces operator-supplied content so authorship is self-attributed. In the other the operator seizes causal attribution of states the listener would have produced anyway. Shared talk of self-attribution is category coincidence; the levers point opposite ways and the entries should say so.

one engineers a gap around a single retained token inside one state. The other installs two states with asymmetric memory access across a commanded boundary plus a leaked motivating residue. The second entry already names the first and states the cut correctly; both entries should keep that pointer, but the topologies differ and neither is a realization of the other.

both get consent or entry by exploiting a frame the listener reads as something other than what it is, and the hypothetical-wrapper and cover-story forms sit close. They differ in what the frame is for: one uses the fiction boundary as the consent instrument for a payload, the other uses a false benign frame to cross the entry seam unresisted. Cross-reference rather than merge.

both use sustained verbal rhythm and both explicitly disclaim the other in their discriminators. One keeps the rhythm a bare pacing substrate that regulates tempo and imports real physiological settling, with no content loaded onto it. The other uses pattern-completion prediction to pre-validate suggestion content. The presence or absence of a content payload on the rhythm is a real boundary and should stay.

both open without a discrete induction section and both presuppose an already-conditioned listener. They differ in what carries entry: recognition or recall of a previously owned trance in one, the work material or sustained occupation of a role in the other. Useful to link because a reader diagnosing a missing induction will want to check both, but the entry substrate differs.

one makes a forget-suggestion unrefusable through recursive self-crossing syntax that leaves no parseable target, so the lever is delivery-level collapse. The other curates what survives the gap so an unscaffolded conclusion stays foregrounded, a payload-selection move. Sharing the topic of amnesia and an occasional chiastic surface is not enough to link them.

both run without the operator present between sessions, and both pre-attribute ambient sensation to the process working. They part on structure: one is a closed re-exposure loop where the urge to re-administer the material is itself reinforced each pass, the other has no defined response at all and recasts the whole environment as reinforcement. Worth linking with that contrast stated.

genuinely adjacent but not one technique. One is an entry-scaffold claim — arousal replaces the induction ramp entirely, so there is no separable descent to decline. The other is a relabeling claim — an arousal-cycle state, including the post-climax crash, is asserted to BE depth. A script can substitute arousal for the induction without ever equating pleasure with depth, and can relabel the refractory crash as descent inside an ordinary induction. A reader deciding between them gains from the cross-link.

both smuggle install work under a caring surface at the exit, and a reader classifying an aftercare passage should see both. They differ on what rides in: one is a fresh vague deniable somatic hook laundered by a flattery-credit inside a fiction-disclaimer, the other is a propagation and self-rearm clause plus a suggestibility-window claim placed outside the trance frame. Different payload shapes on a shared cover, so the link is useful and the merge is not.

related but separable. One installs a compulsion pointed at replaying the specific recording, so the artifact outsources its own re-execution. The other installs a self-administering conditioning loop in which the listener runs and renews the material with the re-exposure urge itself among the reinforced installs. Replay-of-this-file can exist without any self-renewal architecture, and a self-administered loop can be built on recitation and memorization with no replay instruction. Worth linking because bundles frequently carry both.

both make arousal rather than relaxation the substrate of descent and both note the absence of a calm phase, so they are close neighbours worth linking. But the second adds a load-bearing claim the first does not carry: the two natural stopping reasons are entangled so that leaving requires both to fire at once, with a flat contour and no discharge. That closure claim, not the arousal substrate, is what it is cited for, and an arousal-substituted entry can be written with ordinary exits intact.

overlapping at the coupled-variables end and worth a mutual link, but each holds ground the other does not. One requires an autonomous self-running runaway loop with agency for escalation handed to an internal process. The other is a reachability constraint over which joint affective states exist, including the valence-routing form where every feeling is pre-assigned a proof function with no amplification and nothing running away. Valence closure without a climbing loop is a real case that only the second covers.

both restructure reward, and a reader deciding between them benefits from seeing the split: one relocates the credit for a good feeling onto the operator, the other remaps which content is permitted to feel rewarding at all. A passage can do both, so the boundary is worth signposting.

both send the listener back for another session, and the pair is genuinely confusable, so the boundary should be stated: one installs a later contingent re-listen keyed to the programming failing, the other denies the recovery window at the close itself by offering a wake too thin to reorient. Scheduled return versus suppressed exit.

both are clauses attached after a trigger is installed that constrain when it may fire, and both are safety-coded while functioning as a tie to the operator. A reader classifying a bounding clause should see both: one gates on a trust or context condition, the other on the operator's voice alone.

both relabel what has already happened as the listener's own doing, and they frequently run in the same passage — one attributes the state or descent to the listener's choice, the other annotates real recent acts as evidence of a state. Worth cross-referencing because the tell that separates them is what is cited, not what is claimed.

both make forgetting feel self-evident rather than merely asserted, which makes them easy to conflate. The separation is what does the work: one stages dissolution as something watched and pleasant, the other fuses the deletion to the climax event and uses that peak as the delivery window.

adjacent laundering moves that a reader will have to choose between: one relabels the compliance act itself as the listener's own will or preference, the other relabels a prior act, non-act, or circumstance as the authorization for what follows. Agency of the act versus the source of the yes.

the closest pair in this set — both operate on the emergence window. One corrupts the exit so the bound state persists past the count; the other loads content into a count that still delivers a real return. Whether a genuine baseline is reached is the whole boundary and should be stated.

both land content where no defense can form, and they are close enough that a reader needs the split: one times a capacity word to appear for the first time at its own negation, the other empties the objecting tools first and then states content into the gap. Timing versus an engineered window.

both hang non-depth cargo on a descending count, which is exactly why the boundary needs stating: one welds a distinct payload to each number so refusing it means refusing the deepening, the other counts down the faculty that tells real from suggested. Installed content versus a removed capacity.

stacking presupposes single installs already exist: the declarative install builds each cue-response pair, stacking then composes several under one cue. Reader arriving at either genuinely needs the other to know whether they are installing a pair or composing pre-installed ones.

both are no-exit designs, but at different scopes: one is a whole-arc property of a single session that never closes, the other is a waking-life protocol whose failure handlers all route back to re-entry. Reader designing or auditing either benefits from seeing that the closure can sit at arc level or at protocol level.

both assert an identity discontinuity, but one ends the prior self and seats an assigned replacement in the vacancy, while the other leaves the self intact and only relocates its temporal anchor so a feared past state is unreachable. No replacement is sold in the second — that is the line.

a count that carries only depth versus a count whose every number carries distinct installed content. Both discriminators already turn on exactly this test — strip the per-number cargo and one collapses into the other — so the contrast is load-bearing for classification.

directional inverses on the same attribution lever: one relocates authorship of operator-directed content onto the listener, the other credits listener-generated states to the operator. Naming the direction is the whole discrimination.

the wake-line binary is the emergence-boundary instance of the rigged-menu lever: both branches serve the install, agency is offered as cover. Reader of the general choice-architecture move gains from the specific placement at emergence where one branch fires conditioning past session end.

two ways of making an amnesia robust: one pre-arms an open-ended routine to invent cover stories defending the gap, the other curates exactly one surviving token so an unscaffolded conclusion cannot be argued with. Defending the gap versus engineering what stays is a real fork.

both use a predictable repeating form as cover for content, but the lever differs: an expectation of sameness that lets novel payloads slip into the varying slot, versus a prediction-and-completion mechanism where pre-producing the pattern's closure is itself the micro-agreement. Camouflage versus pre-validation.

same laundering move at two scopes: a standing rule over the entire future suggestion channel, versus relabeling a specific compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will. Reader of the per-act form needs to know the channel-level version exists, since it makes every later instruction self-justifying at once.

both hand the subject something that fires outside the session, but one re-accesses a felt state quality and the other pairs a named situation to a named instrumental response. State reload versus one-directional conditional — the discriminators already contrast on exactly this.

two dependency loops keyed differently: one raises a waking baseline whose only relief is more of the same exposure, the other stays silent during compliance and fires only when the programming is failing. Escalating versus self-repairing is a useful contrast for anyone reading either as a maintenance design.

self-recitation appears in both, and the second's discriminator explicitly carves against the first: chanting for its own absorptive sake versus recitation tied to escalating pleasure and an autonomy cost that makes stopping expensive. Worth stating so recitation alone is not read as the tell.

refusing to perform the close at all, as a whole-arc property, versus an exit that exists but is monopolized by an operator condition. Absent off-switch versus operator-held off-switch — a real fork for anyone auditing emergence topology.

both empty then install, and the second's discriminator turns on the difference: adjacent phases where the emptying merely opens a defenseless window, versus a material link where the extracted self literally becomes the ingredient of the install. Sequence versus recycling.

two opposite handlings of the reversibility question at session end: a wake that restores the prior self while carving the trigger out as preserved, versus a removal pre-loaded onto the same kind of cue that installed it, with a carve-out for a retained residue. Both use a selective-retention clause, which is the shared design decision worth cross-reading.

directly opposed attribution moves: asserting the operator does nothing and pushing agency onto the subject, versus seizing causal credit for the subject's own baseline states. Both quietly preserve operator steering, which is exactly why the direction needs stating.

genuine boundary: one deletes the induction phase entirely and lets the work content carry entry; the other still runs an induction but builds it on an escalating arousal or need baseline instead of a relaxational one. A reader classifying a script with no relaxation opener has to decide which of these it is.

both operate on the consent surface across a whole artifact. One is the arc-level topology of where the consent gate sits; the other uses the fiction/reality boundary itself as the consent instrument. Adjacent enough that a cataloguer picking one should check the other.

both hand production to the listener, but the thing produced differs: compliance content invented or narrated by the listener, versus the reinforcer of a conditioning loop supplied by the listener while the operator keeps only the framing. Worth cross-reading; not one technique.

both propagate something through the body while the listener tracks it, and both must be told apart from an ordinary progressive scan. One hands the relaxing to an externalized agent acting on a passive body; the other vectors a single sensation as a carrier delivering a payload state. Real confusion boundary.

both keep the subject under across a boundary that would normally end the state. One forwards live trance across the file boundary by deleting emergence; the other neutralizes a state edge such as eyes-opening or waking. A reader deciding which boundary was crossed needs both.

both ride a payload on a body-directed sweep and both must be told apart from a plain relaxation scan. In one the carrier is a task the listener already consented to and the payload sits in the descriptors; in the other the carrier is a single sensation whose spatial vector is itself the move. Close enough to need the distinction spelled out; not one technique.

authored neighbors: one manufactures craving by removing a delivered state or substituting an unsatisfiable object; the other installs a negative affect pole whose only relief runs through compliance. The manufactured-relief form sits right on the boundary between them.

both concern the emergence count, but one is a clean downshift to genuine waking baseline while the other inverts the fade gradient so emerging is said to strengthen the install. Worth an explicit contrast: the same surface (a count up) with opposite intent.

both build a between-sessions maintenance loop that closes back onto re-exposure. They differ on what drives the loop — an external object plus acquisition ritual versus an internalized urge that needs no props — so a reader choosing a perpetuation design benefits from seeing both.

both operate on memory, but one voids the memory of the install so an active suggestion has no auditable origin, while the other deliberately edits and then restores memory in front of the subject to demonstrate control. Payloads are opposite: concealment versus display.

both install a cue-response link, but one does it by unannounced pairing with no stated rule, the other by an explicit stated conditional tied to a named waking situation. The declarative-versus-implicit contrast is the whole point of separating them.

both pre-wire the response to the program's own failure so a lapse routes back into re-exposure. One is a single asymmetric trigger, the other a full no-exit topology over every defection path — a scope difference on the same design goal.

both run a second audible stream alongside the primary one. The distinguishing question is what the second stream does: carry a concealed payload beneath a decoy, or box in attention so it can be reassigned. A reader designing a two-channel piece needs to see the fork.

both act at the emergence boundary and both aim for out-of-session durability, so confusion is easy. The distinguishing move is timing and intent: content delivered at the crossing to be carried out versus a trigger fired after closure specifically to contradict the just-given normality framing.

adjacent but separable. One escalates the ontological status of the operator's voice up through thought and will; the other reattributes authorship of inner speech so there is no external speaker to resist. Worth an explicit boundary line since both end at words feeling self-generated.

both relocate where experience is deemed to originate rather than merely adding a sensation. One installs an internal imagined body as the real one; the other routes sensation inbound from external footage with the identity variable. Same family, different source.

overlapping surface (recurring nightly reactivation, dreams as the channel) but different objects: one is a whole-arc property of nothing ever closing, the other a single installed recurrence rule keyed to a self-occurring stimulus. Flagging the boundary prevents the whole-artifact property being logged as one more trigger install.

both defeat the listener's install-anticipation, but by different means: hiding the act of installing versus openly installing a slot whose contents are withheld for later. The second is not concealment of the install at all, which is worth stating.

both convert withheld release into deepening fuel. The second adds a broken explicit promise, a taunt, and a repeated run that trains distrust of the count itself — a sharper variant of the same metabolization, so the pair reads as general and special case.

one is a specific closed self-running circuit, the other a whole-artifact property of the reachable-state space having no exit. The specific circuit is one way to realize the general closure, and the general entry lists several others, so the link carries real information.

planting a cue-to-response binding is not the same as drilling it. One declares the pair for a future discrete response; the other repeatedly fires an already-planted pair and delivers a reward on the same beat, converting a heard claim into felt evidence inside the session.

both make refusal land on the listener rather than the operator by placing the wanting inside them, and the cut is temporal. One invokes an asserted personal history so the want was already there; the other relocates the preference in the present so the imposition reads as current taste.

both convert compliance into a real-world act crossing out of the fiction, and the cut is who receives it. One produces a deliverable handed privately to the operator through a live channel; the other drives a public attributable post under a maintained eyes-open overlay, where the audience and the self-ratification are the point.

both foreclose the moment where the listener could object, and the cut is scale. One is a whole-artifact property in how the consent surface is shaped end to end; the other is a discrete relabelling of an act, non-act, circumstance, or retracted question as the authorization.

both stage amnesia through a symbolic container, and the cut is what happens to it. In one the container is destroyed or discarded so the removal is a single felt event; in the other it is a commanded reversible boundary between two states with asymmetric recall, plus a deliberately leaked motivating residue.

both fire an already-installed cue rather than building one, and the cut is placement and purpose. One fires it in-frame for its effect alone; the other deliberately interrupts the emergence to fire it across the wake boundary as a staged proof that it survives waking.

both schedule re-entry beyond the session with no operator present, and the cut is who activates it. One teaches a portable cue the subject deliberately runs on themselves; the other keys re-entry to an unavoidable environmental or physiological occurrence the subject never chooses to initiate.

both work a withheld bodily release, and the cut is what the withholding does. One relabels the undischarged charge as fuel that increments depth and compliance; the other establishes the operator as the only causally valid grantor by pre-defining every autonomous route to relief as inert.

both are a single firing of an already-installed cue, and the cut is the boundary move. One fires in-frame with nothing said about trance and waking; the other fires immediately after the wake count precisely to contradict the just-delivered assurance of being normal and awake.

both make the state unfalsifiable from inside, and the cut is what supplies the evidence. One rigs a deliberate introspective check so every verdict confirms; the other infers the state from the listener's own ongoing inertia, with no check required at all.

both route the move through a figure who is not the listener, and the cut is what the figure holds. In one the proxy is a delivery channel the listener identifies with, so no command is ever aimed at them; in the other the agent holds real decision-authority the listener defers to and cannot simply reclaim.

both treat an occurring climax as the site where something is seated rather than discharged. One loads the peak with an identity, act, or belief; the other pairs it with erasure so the deletion arrives as reward and the blackout becomes an unauditable delivery window. Anyone citing the imprint window should see the erasure payload as its close relative.

both cite a performed act back as evidence of control, and the cut is where the act lives and what makes it costly. One assigns an externally verifiable out-of-session task whose deliberate absurdity is the cost being re-read as proof; the other elicits an act inside the session and cites the self-witnessed compliance immediately.

both concern what survives the end of a session, but the levers differ: one forwards live trance across an artifact boundary by never permitting emergence at all; the other performs a structurally complete emergence and uses that completeness to disguise retained state. Worth a distinctness pointer because a reader classifying an ending may confuse withheld emergence with counterfeit emergence.

both install identity while dodging a direct operator assertion, and their discriminators already reference each other. A reader deciding between them needs the axis: covert grammatical drift that moves the referent onto the listener versus an explicit ownership handoff where the listener speaks the claim.

both bind two variables so they cannot move independently, and the difference is whether the binding is announced. One states the fusion outright as a shared verb, equivalence ring, or dial; the other smuggles it via shared motor program, referent slide, pun, or assent seam. A reader who has one needs the other to choose correctly.

erasure used instrumentally in both, and one explicitly depends on the other as a foundation: emptying opens an installation slot, while origin erasure deletes the baseline a listener could return to. Reader gains from seeing the emptying-then-fill relation.

both rig the outcome space so nothing counts as disconfirmation, and their discriminators already draw the line: one engineers a specific performed task or success criterion and cashes the outcome, the other pre-maps the entire response space by frame. Adjacent enough that a reader landing on either should check the other.

both are whole-arc properties describing what the script leaves behind, so they invite confusion. One is a negative-space observation that the closing function is refused; the other is a positive end-state architecture where self-detection, self-reward, and self-punishment interlock into an operator-free loop. Distinctness pointer, not a lateral read.

both harvest the listener's own action as leverage, which makes them confusable. One has the listener generate the compliance content itself so effort becomes investment; the other has the operator supply a trivial act and later point back at it as evidence that wanting can be manufactured. Distinctness pointer on who authors and when the act is cashed.

both manufacture the somatic evidence that a later claim will cite, and the second is already named as a neighbor in the first's discriminator. The split is scope: a whole-script chain where each step guarantees the next step's evidence, versus a single commanded action producing proprioceptive proof for one claim.

adjacent moves at the same emergence boundary: one refuses the discharge so the installed charge rides out unattenuated, the other completes the wake but times a specific payload to the crossing. Coders classifying an emergence passage will need both to place it.

opposite outcomes at the same edge: one asserts that prior suggestions persist while granting a genuine return to baseline, the other keeps the subject in the deep state across a transition that would normally end it. The subject fully wakes in the first and does not in the second.

both recruit the body and the breath at induction time, but the arousal profiles are opposite: one makes the ordinary breath cycle an asymmetrically loaded settling engine, the other spikes genuine physiological tension and labels the rebound as trance. Worth the contrast to prevent misfiling breath-hold passages.

two inductions that dispense with the conventional entry scaffold by manufacturing a real bodily state instead: arousal as the ramp itself, or a tension spike whose release is labeled as already-trance. Useful adjacency when deciding which body-first entry a passage is running.

sibling anchors that differ on the carrier axis, which is exactly where miscoding happens: an internal autobiographical memory whose spontaneous recall is the cue, versus a non-detachable body sensation, mark, or locus. Neither is external, so the memory-versus-body cut is the operative test.

both concern operator control of climax and are easy to confuse. One removes the discharge move entirely by driving past the scale's own declared ceiling so the state can never resolve; the other transfers both onset and cessation to command, so release does occur but neither direction is retained.

the confusable pair in labeling work: asserting a label the subject accepts as descriptively true, versus reading the subject's own present-tense output back as proof the state is real. The first supplies the claim, the second supplies only the ratification.

both load several concurrent payloads onto one involuntary recurring carrier so opting out of any channel is structurally expensive. The carriers differ (an operator-cited pulse versus the breath cycle with opposing per-phase jobs) but the multiplexing lever is genuinely shared and reading one clarifies the other.

both are consent-instrument techniques and both can appear in one passage, so the instrument must be named: retroactive relabeling of compliance as the subject's own choice, versus manipulating the fiction/reality boundary so defenses calibrated for fiction cover the real payload.

two faces of the same self-sealing evidence family: state inferred from the subject's own ongoing inertia (continuing to listen, sitting in silence), versus a small performed compliance redescribed as proof of a larger commitment. The disconfirming branch is foreclosed in both, so the act-versus-argument distinction is worth having side by side.

scale is the cut. One is a whole-artifact topology of the consent surface that cannot be cited to a single line; the other fabricates the record of a discrete consent act that never occurred. A counterfeit act can sit inside such an arc without being the arc.

both install below the anticipation threshold, differing on the channel: a verbal token concealed by disguising the install act (description, cover task, backdating), versus unannounced repeated pairing of a discrete non-verbal cue. The verbal/non-verbal axis is the whole test.

both build an identity from many small accepted steps rather than one claim, producing the same commitment ratchet: an ordered part-by-part rewrite of the body substrate, or an additive sequence of automaticity-narrated motor acts with per-act pleasure pairing. A passage doing both is common enough that the pair should be read together.

the load-bearing cut inside the climax cluster: in one the discharge is withheld behind a met-able compliance key and typically never fires, in the other it fires and carries erasure as its payload. Fired-versus-withheld decides the coding.

one is a specific destabilize-then-sell-the-cure arc; the other is an explicitly loose container for whole-script shapes that disclaims any shared mechanism among its members. The specific arc meets the container's inclusion test (whole-arc, non-executable, uncitable to one line), so a reader classifying an arc-level observation should see the container. Not a merge: absorbing a well-specified causal arc into an admitted grab-bag would lose its mechanism.

shared surface only. One installs a cue-response by narrating a fabricated past so the next real firing feels like a repetition; the other actually fires the cue and delivers a reward on the same beat, repeatedly, inside the session. No cue is fired and no reward is delivered in the first; the rehearsal is fictional. Grouping them on 'both make a trigger feel practiced' is a category coincidence.

the narrower move binds pleasure to the truth-value of what is said, so credence and reward amplify each other. The broader move swaps the truth criterion to a felt affect-tag and then controls that tag's inputs across the whole piece. The first reads as a hedonic instance of the second's first layer, but lacks the second layer (operator control of the tag's inputs), so they stay separate with a pointer.

both are reader-directed whole-text architectures that manufacture assent before the claim lands, and the narrower one is already positioned as a deliberate split from the general container on a specific tell: earning acceptance of a claim the reader would refuse if stated cold, via staged corroboration. Keep the authored separation; link so the split is visible from both sides rather than collapsing it.

both redefine surrender as desirable, but the delivery levers are opposed. One offers sustained reasoning the subject is invited to accept as a considered position; the other stipulates a monotonic inverse law as logical necessity and packs near-identical paraphrases to outrun rebuttal, offering no reasoning to contest. Argued-belief versus saturation-installed axiom is a real cut.

same structural family: a withheld capacity whose only unlock sits outside the current session and outside the listener's control. They differ on the external surface - consuming a second operator's separate recording versus a public reciprocal peer-approval economy with a waiting period. A writer picking an external-contingency release gate should compare the two enforcement surfaces.

opposite sides of an explicit cut that both entries already carry: in one the discharge does not fire until a met-able compliance key is satisfied, and the mounting drive enforces the condition; in the other the discharge does fire and is asserted to be the operation that expels prior self-content and seals permanence. Withheld versus fired-as-the-operator is not a shared mechanism.

adjacency is positional only - both sit in the wake sequence and both preserve deniability. The levers do not overlap: one delegates the waking to an in-world character and files the whole experience as a dream while exempting a mantra from that filing; the other installs a new, previously unstated somatic hook inside an ethical re-grounding. Same slot in the arc is not a shared mechanism.

orthogonal deepening parameters that can run in the same passage. One manipulates the terminus - relocating or abolishing the floor so the 'deep enough yet' self-check has no marker; the other removes the operator from the increment loop so deepening advances with no further operator step. Denying an endpoint and removing the driver are independent choices.

one forecloses retrieval recursively - reaching for the material re-runs the suggestion or returns corrupted content, so no discrete command exists to refuse. The other trains a tonally marked token as a binary handle that opens or shuts already-sealed material on the operator's timing. Installing a self-feeding block and operating a switch on an existing seal are different objects.

declared siblings in one craving-and-gating family, and each already carries an explicit routing rule naming the other. One manufactures the want by withdrawing a delivered state or substituting an unsatisfiable object; the other withholds a wanted discharge behind a met-able compliance key. They compose readily, so the cross-link is load-bearing for correct selection.

both relocate authorship onto a not-self layer inside the listener, and they split cleanly on what gets relocated: ongoing behavior, posture, or the onset of blankness in one case, versus the consent or agreement itself in the other. The partition is the same device; the payload differs, and a writer needs the pair to pick correctly.

both escalate arousal and nothing else is shared. One asserts that the listener's own spoken words cause the state, closing a self-amplifying circuit that needs no operator input; the other increments a quantized externally-cranked dial whose ceiling flips on a mandated physical act and pre-scripts refusal as impossible. Self-feeding loop versus dial-plus-mandate.

the narrower move - an insufficiency verdict rendered exactly where success would land, on a standard that cannot be satisfied - is one drive for the broader one-way topology in which no step is ever easier than the last. Kept separate because the broader entry's tell is per-use strict increase with no regressible state, which the verdict move does not by itself establish, and because the broader entry has realizations with no approval-desire component.

one asserts that the voice itself is a physical sensation on the body, so every subsequent line lands as a stimulus event - a manufactured percept via cross-modal substitution. The other never conjures a feeling; it seizes a sensation genuinely present and reassigns its meaning as evidence of the installed theme. Creating a percept and relabeling a real one are the stated boundary between them.

same closed-ring topology sited differently: one couples two in-session state variables into a runaway with no non-compliant vector, the other closes a two-cue ring out in daily life where each leg cues craving for the other. Keep both — the siting changes what an author writes — but cross-reference so the shared no-exit structure is visible.

both engineer affect so no neutral position remains, but one is a bipolar presence/absence anchor on a single cue with relief bound to compliance, and the other is a constraint on which joint affective states are reachable at all. The second explicitly must not collapse into a direction-push on a single dimension; record the boundary rather than the resemblance.

both are causal-attribution moves, but they point opposite ways: one displaces authorship of the mind-state outward onto an object declared to be doing the work, the other pulls attribution inward onto the operator by recoding sensations the listener would have had anyway. Same axis, inverse direction — the contrast is the useful content.

shared vocabulary only. One fuses forgetting to the climax event so deletion arrives as reward; the other withholds climax until a target behavior is performed, using unresolved arousal as enforcement. Nothing an author learns from one transfers to the other beyond not confusing the two names.

the names collide but the levers do not: one is in-session patter where each obedient act is framed as producing a felt reward that eases the next, the other is an out-of-session protocol whose predicted failures are pre-wired to route back into re-exposure. Momentum from felt reward versus a reachability structure with no exit node — worth disambiguating, not linking as kin.

both relocate authorship of mental content, in opposite directions: one blanks the listener's own stream and hands authorship to the operator so operator speech becomes the listener's reality, the other pushes authorship onto the listener so the payload carries their own conviction and has no external target to resist. Direction of the handoff is the whole distinction.

the same closure property at two scopes: one is the whole-artifact action/state graph with no exit branch anywhere in the construction, the other is that closure sited specifically on a waking-life protocol's failure handlers. An author choosing between them is really choosing in-session graph versus out-of-session program, so the cross-reference does real work.

both act on the operator rather than the subject and are easily conflated: one drills procedural precision by having a monitor or stand-in expose gaps the operator would otherwise fill silently, the other shapes the transmitted signal itself — tone, gesture, intonation, whole-script texture. Craft-of-procedure versus craft-of-delivery.

both key a trigger to the listener's own cognition so no operator presence is needed, and they differ on what the response does with the cued act: one consumes or dissolves it so self-monitoring defeats itself, the other amplifies it and routes it back to the operator concept so the loop feeds. Same cue class, opposite fate for the captured thought.

both relocate causation for a state change away from the listener's deliberate agency, but the delegate differs in kind: an internal automatic layer the listener nominally owns but does not feel they control, versus a named external non-consumed agent asserted as the cause. Internal versus external delegate is the boundary worth recording.

both leave no observation that could disconfirm, and the boundary between them is a genuine authoring choice: one manufactures the validating states in a causal chain where each induced experience becomes the next claim's premise, the other pre-maps the outcome space so every branch already reads as confirmation. Construction versus branch-map.

both prevent a stable endpoint, but they sit on opposite sides of the operator-presence axis. One requires the operator to grant then revoke sufficiency on every cycle, owning the adequacy standard; the other is defined by the deepening continuing once the operator's next action is removed. Remove the operator and one stops dead while the other keeps running.

both repurpose an accepted frame, but the levers differ: one makes a protective-sounding surface carry or license the payload, the other cashes a benign cover for an uncovered payload. Worth a cross-check where a bounding-style carve-out is offered early and drawn on later.

same scene-building family split by what the construct is for: present inhabitation versus a durable object given a location for later re-navigation. Read together when deciding whether an imagined structure is meant to be re-entered.

both hide something from the listener's audit, but the object differs: one routes a payload on the utterance's surface form so the guard finds no order; the other shapes the operator's own transmitted signal (tone, gesture, texture) and acts on no listener-side proposition.

one installs a reusable ritual that destroys identity-content cyclically and ends there; the other empties a narrow slot specifically so positive claims can be stated into it as unopposed fact. Emptying is terminal in one and instrumental in the other.

both route maintenance through people outside the operator-subject pair, but one arranges third parties to deliver reinforcement while the other uses an audience's self-consistency pressure and recruitment. Read together when deciding whether the social environment is being managed or being made the propagation vector.

both close off response routes, but one pre-maps every behavioral and introspective branch to the same outcome, while the other removes the sensory channel a response would travel on. Option-space coverage versus channel removal.

both hold arousal undischarged, but one relabels the denied charge as fuel routed into depth or obedience, while the other sustains two incompatible imperatives so no resolution exists at all. Redirection versus deadlock.

same causal-offloading lever split on whether the named external cause is consumed: an asserted non-consumed agent versus an imagined ingested or inhaled substance whose consumption act performs delivery. Read the pair when classifying an external cause.

both pin arousal against a closed release, but one holds release behind a key compliance can actually meet, while the other admits no resolution and recodes the frustration itself as the endpoint. A met-able gate versus none.

both convert an in-session bodily sign into evidence, but one stages a phenomenon for the subject to notice and interpret as proof of depth, while the other narrates genuine autonomic drift with the induction credited by presupposition. Read together where a relaxed-body claim is doing convincer work.

both remove the ability to disconfirm, but one pre-assigns a null or aversive outcome to a whole future class of mental acts reaching past the session, while the other maps a bounded in-session or at-wake outcome space to confirmation. Temporal reach is the split.

adjacent consent-laundering moves that meet where disclosure is reframed as informed agreement: one cites a discrete banked artifact back to suppress live refusal, the other retroactively relabels compliance already underway as the subject's own choice. Check both when an earlier agreement is invoked mid-descent.

complementary halves of unfalsifiability: one manufactures the positive somatic evidence each claim then cites, the other maps every possible response to confirmation so nothing can disconfirm. Scripts often run both, so the pair is worth reading side by side.

both use verse form as the working instrument, and each already carves the other out: one loads suggestion content onto rhyme-closures, the other keeps the meter as a bare pacing substrate with no payload. That shared-carrier-different-cargo split is exactly what a writer choosing between them needs to see, so the cross-reference earns its place.

both foreclose refusal, but by different levers: one rigs the branch structure so every option executes the same compliance, the other converts an already-performed small act into evidence that forecloses a larger commitment. They overlap in the rigged-forced-choice form, where a discarded option is pre-counted as fulfillment, and a reader picking between them benefits from seeing where choice-architecture ends and evidence-manufacture begins.

both relocate causal credit for a state onto the operator, and they differ on a clean axis the discriminators already name: one captures whatever the listener finds on introspection (including nothing), the other narrates verifiably-true involuntary physiology and smuggles the causal claim in by presupposition. The truth-status of the described state is the deciding parameter, which is worth a reader's attention.

genuine near-neighbours on the same axis: an external non-consumed cause is asserted to own the state-change. The second narrows it to a physical object granted an active causal role that also functions as a portable post-session cue. A writer deciding whether the cause should be a nameable object or a diffuse agent needs both in view.

one is the general principle (relocate authorship of the payload to the listener so there is nothing external to resist), the other a specific engineered-utterance realization aimed at literal deniability. The general entry already names the specific one as a neighbouring case, so the link is coherent and the parent-child relationship is the thing a reader should notice.

both bank a physical act extracted while the listener is awake and pre-critical, then cash it in later. One harvests it as a compliance receipt entering induction, the other lets a mid-trance automaticity claim merely relabel an already-arranged position. Same pre-staging lever, different payoff, and they frequently appear in the same opening.

both act at the trance-waking threshold and the first's discriminator explicitly contrasts against the second: one interrupts emergence to test-fire a trigger as proof it crosses the boundary, the other completes the wake while carrying a specific payload across. The threshold-timing family is small and the two are the main members.

both attack the self-reference apparatus rather than assert a label, and they are near-adjacent realizations: one removes or replaces the first-person handle in general, the other strikes specifically at the proper name after relocating identification upward to a watcher-self. Anyone working on name and pronoun capture wants both.

both install present or future responsiveness by getting the listener to supply a past that never happened. They differ in what the fabricated past is for: one back-dates a conditioning history to set a depth floor and make resistance incoherent; the other narrates fabricated episodes that all rehearse one cue-response shape so the next real firing feels well-practiced. Worth reading together as counterfactual-past vehicles.

both foreclose exits, at different scopes. One closes the entire reachable option space so nothing disconfirms; the other closes specific named objections and exit routes in advance. Already cross-named in the second entry's discriminator; the link helps a reader pick between global closure and targeted preclosure.

both remove self-directed termination and hand it to the operator. One monopolizes the exit from an in-session state; the other gates teardown of a persistent post-session state behind operator-defined conditions. The shared question a reader is deciding is which object is being held hostage, the state exit or the standing programming.

sibling behavioral-schedule techniques that each name the other as the choice to rule out: one reinforces something other than the target behavior, the other delivers the maintaining reinforcer on a time schedule with no contingency at all. The contingency-versus-no-contingency fork is exactly the decision a reader needs.

both weaponize a protective surface. One makes the safety element carry or license the payload; the other pre-locks the safety verdict so it cannot later be revised downward. Reading both keeps a writer from conflating safety-as-vehicle with safety-as-ratchet.

direct complements already named in each other's discriminators: one installs a concrete replacement recollection so the erasure feels seamless, the other manufactures uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader choosing between fill and manufactured doubt needs both.

both relocate the moment of consent rather than obtaining it, at different scopes: one is a whole-artifact topology of the consent surface, the other a discrete retroactive relabel of an already-running descent as the subject's own choice. Reading both prevents citing the whole-arc entry for what is a single passage.

both close the escape channel by coupling states that would normally regulate each other, one as a whole-script topology where arousal carries depth and the two exit routes suppress each other, the other by binding one cue to two antagonistic states. Same no-escape logic at script scale versus cue scale.

both use a performed body-act as proof rather than a claim, and both read the body back as evidence of the target state. The fork is what the act is: one rehearses the exact future post-hypnotic act so the body pre-proves that specific suggestion, the other elicits an exposure or display posture as generic compliance evidence, often before any trance language.

both relocate a commitment upstream of the moment it is cashed, so the reader choosing one should see the other. They differ in what the relocation buys: one banks a decision before deliberation is stripped, the other withholds the content of the change until after the commitment is given.

both dress a payload in a frame the listener already trusts, but the frames are not the same instrument: one repurposes a protective or safety surface, the other manipulates the fiction/reality boundary. Sharing the consent-laundering family is not enough to send a reader across.

one launders through the fiction boundary; the other silently widens an acceptance already anchored in the real frame with no fiction layer at all. Each is a live mis-pick for the other, so the separation is worth stating.

one deepens through a brief up-swing toward waking and a re-drop; the other forbids a drop already underway until the operator permits it. Depth granted versus depth achieved by contrast — no waking interval in the second.

both close the disconfirmation exit, but one infers state from the listener's own ongoing inertia with no outcome required, while the other produces a live outcome and routes every branch of it to confirmation. Close enough that the boundary should be stated explicitly.

both run repeating cycles whose troughs are deliberately not waking resets, and both define themselves against contrast-based cycling rather than against each other. The cycled variable differs: cognitive load against blankness in one, non-resetting arousal accumulation in the other.

one is a closed topology that keeps running with no further operator narration; the other rigs the success criterion so no observation can disconfirm. A relabelled criterion is not a self-sustaining loop, and each already defends its edge against the other.

one cites a discrete retrievable agreement back at the moment refusal would rise; the other is an architectural relationship between where consent sits and where it is spent, with no artifact to invoke. Single-move citation versus spanning placement.

one installs a structured set of separately addressable handles or one token retaining several meanings at once; the other binds a single cue to a single future response, however many refinements the install grammar takes. The individuation of the handles is the whole difference.

both produce a no-exit feel, but one welds several state variables so no single-variable escape exists while the other leaves an exit intact and hands its key to the operator. Co-movement topology versus a monopolized off-switch.

one erases the memory of the install so the response has no origin to argue with; the other trains a marked token as the switch that opens or closes sealed material. They compose naturally — seal the provenance, then keep a key to it — so a reader of either benefits from the other.

both build genuine catalepsy first, then do something with it: one lends its demonstrated involuntariness to an untested emotional or arousal claim, the other swaps the attribution of the pinned state into comfort. Transfer outward versus relabel in place.

one bars the only sanctioned discharge behind an operator-benefiting act, so relief is reachable but routed; the other removes the discharge channel from the arc entirely so nothing accumulates toward release. Monopolized relief versus severed relief.

both reroute credit for a good feeling onto the operator without the operator producing it. One re-sources the listener's baseline pleasure to the operator's presence; the other has the listener generate the reward while the operator keeps only the framing — the second is close to the first run at loop scale.

both turn a minimal act into leverage, but the output differs: one relabels the act as authorization for what follows, the other reads it backward as proof of broad submission or irresistibility. Each already names the other's territory as the adjacent lever, so the cross-reference helps a reader pick by what the act is made to prove.

both relocate authority away from the contestable operator, in opposite directions: onto the subject's own nature, or onto an impersonal unfalsifiable thing. Reading them together clarifies that the shared move is removing a target for resistance, and the choice is where the agency lands.

same axis, opposite directions: one widens the person gap so suggestions arrive as facts about a character, the other walks the listener into grammatical subjecthood without invitation. The first names its eventual collapse back to direct address as the payoff, which is where the second lives.

both give resistance somewhere to go that is not refusal, at different scales: a named faculty reified and demoted so rebellion loses its agent, versus one licensed muscle holding tension so a global relaxation claim survives. The somatic version is the small, non-structural cousin; the link is worth keeping only for that contrast.

both foreclose resistance without needing a live impulse, at different scopes: closing the entire reachable option space including inaction and over-compliance, versus denying resistance a window, an existence, or an object in the present. The first explicitly gestures at the denial family, making this a reciprocal boundary.

both concern the operator making claims about the listener's interior, but the levers are different: one claims perceptual ACCESS to an unobservable interior (denial loses standing because nothing can contradict it), the other seizes the CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION of a state the listener really is having (crediting it to the operator's voice). Access-claim versus credit-claim; worth an explicit contrast so writers do not conflate 'she knows what you feel' with 'she caused what you feel'.
