both turn on where consent sits versus where it is spent, and each discriminator already names the other as adjacent. One is a placement trick on a scope-widening line, the other a spanning structural envelope — an explicit cross-reference keeps them from collapsing.

both hang an asymmetry on a breath-paced structure — one loads the eyelid cycle so closing is easy and opening hard, the other silently drops one half of a breath-coupled word pair. Adjacent enough that a breath-paced asymmetric passage could plausibly be filed under either.

both attack the emergence boundary — one installs a self-fired reflex that corrects felt surfacing, the other defers or corrupts the exit itself. Genuinely confusable on a passage where the listener stays under after the count.

both swap the compliance criterion by relocating the session into a non-hypnotic frame the listener already knows how to perform — an invented mundane role versus a pre-existing cultural ritual slot. The in-fiction vs real-world-carrier line is the distinguishing test.

both are closure end-states rather than single lines: one seals against competing external input, the other closes the loop internally so no operator is needed. Adjacent halves of the same 'nothing can open this' design space.

both convert a suggestion into apparent evidence the listener gathers themselves, one via a hallucinated reflection and one via a genuinely present body sensation re-narrated. The hallucinated-versus-real substrate is exactly the discrimination a reader needs.

both flip the listener into petitioner and make depth something granted rather than done to them; one is a withhold-then-grant gate, the other prices each increment in a fixed request phrase that also forecloses all other speech. Real overlap in the petition stance.

both lend a body event's undeniability to an abstract claim the listener never tested, differing in whether the proof is a demonstrated motor incapacity transferred afterward or a real stimulus licensed as the delivery channel. Easy to conflate without the cross-reference.

complementary whole-artifact moves: one deletes the entry threshold, the other withholds the exit. A writer working on either boundary benefits from seeing the other end of the same arc treated as deletable.

both route content through the body-map, but one manufactures a new fictional proprioceptive channel as reusable infrastructure while the other smuggles descriptors through an ordinary body sweep. Same terrain, different levers.
two directions of the same attribution-relocation family: credit for effects versus credit for pleasure, both routed onto the operator. A writer choosing an attribution move should see both.
both calibrate the operator's own output to a surface the subject supplies — symptomatic idiom versus sensory-modality vocabulary. Adjacent members of the match-the-subject's-code family.

both bind the subject through an act whose force outlives the session, but one pre-authorizes arbitrary future commitments while the other converts a completed irreversible deed into autobiographical evidence. Opposite temporal directions.

both are design-time filters on the target list before anything is enacted, but one supplies selection criteria and the other an admissibility test keyed to whose benefit the change serves. Read together when deciding what an intervention should aim at.

the visible-body-signal variant of the first requires an audience to read the signal; the second installs behaviors that are deliberately plausibly-invisible under a secrecy frame. The reinforcing party differs, so they are not substitutes.
both make a required submissive utterance the price of a state transition — one gates the exit, the other gates each increment of descent. Close neighbors worth reading against each other.

both defend against later review, but one pre-codes recognition of the manipulation as further capture while the other withholds the script's own declared subject until commitment is banked. Immunization versus concealment.

both close off a response, but one rigs the evidence channel so no observation can disconfirm, while the other removes the sensory channel a response would be routed through. The first entry's discriminator already draws this line.

both withhold or threaten to withhold a wanted trance state to flip the listener into petitioner, but one goes on to extract self-voiced commitment while the other only restructures the who-asks-whom stance. Near neighbors, not the same move.

complementary halves of the same differential-reinforcement engine, and the boundary is easy to get wrong: one differentiates the ANTECEDENT (a cue gains control through reinforce-in-presence / withhold-in-absence), the other differentiates the RESPONSE (a moving reinforced window builds a behavior that does not yet exist). A reader reaching for either should confirm which side of that line their case falls on.

exact inversion at the same slot. Both modify the exit rather than emerging plainly, so surface shape can look alike, but one fills the emergence slot with a protective directive to pre-empt self-installed harm, while the other engineers the wake so the subject leaves without a clean return to baseline. Same structural position, opposite direction of governance — worth stating so the shared shape is not read as kinship.

genuinely adjacent choices at the same moment: the general restorative close that returns the subject to baseline, versus the narrower move of occupying the emergence slot with a benign directive so no spontaneous negative self-suggestion can fill it. Someone designing a session close will want both on the table, and the difference is what the exit slot is FOR — reintegration versus harm pre-emption.

directional inversion worth flagging because both end in a re-pressable handle onto a state. One binds an in-session state to an owned everyday object and exports it as a self-administered re-trigger with no operator present. The other reaches backward, catching an already-firing spontaneous reaction the operator did not author and tying an anchor to it so it can be re-presented for inspection. Install-forward versus capture-backward.

the genuine article and its counterfeit, at the same structural slot. One is a real pre-entry agreement on a single exclusive ending signal that survives amnesia and actually terminates the state. The other supplies safety or exit assurance whose ACCEPTANCE stands the subject's guard down, with the assurance never operationalized as a constraint on the operator. The who-is-constrained test is the whole discrimination, and pairing them makes it legible.

frequently co-occurring and easy to confuse, since a stripping ladder often runs its rungs through externalized objects. The load-bearing difference is what carries the work: an ordered sequence with a per-stage latch, where ORDER is the lever, versus a discrete narrated destruction of an externalized faculty, where the irreversibility marker is the lever. A ladder can run with or without a destructible object, so the reader needs both entries to place a given case.

two positive-governance gates that both leave the operator as the constrained party, differing in what they gate. One is an authorization check with a real waitable response beat whose failure blocks the action. The other screens whether to proceed with this person at all, on fitness or contraindication grounds. Anyone selecting a genuine gate should see both and pick by object — this moment versus this person.

two standing pre-authorizations with the same blast-radius concern, separated by what is left unspecified. One makes future suggestion CONTENT irrelevant — accept regardless of what is asked. The other makes arbitrary future COMMITMENTS binding when extracted under a named overwhelm condition, handing operational control to whoever extracts one. A reader assessing scope on either should check the other, because the unbounded dimension is different.

the classic install-versus-fire confusion, and worth pinning because both present as a discrete cue producing a state. One is implicit pairing with no declarative instruction, building the link below awareness so the response feels spontaneous. The other presupposes rather than builds the conditioning and merely cashes an already-armed cue. Nothing is installed in the second; nothing is fired for effect in the first.

both are cue-and-response procedures that a reader can easily mis-select between. One builds a cue's evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through reinforcement history. The other tears down a stimulus's control over an aversive or interfering response by pairing an incompatible state against it or severing the link. Building antecedent control and dismantling it are the two directions of the same axis, and the entries' own boundary notes lean on each other.

both manufacture a consent record the listener never gave; they differ only in substrate. One banks an installed near-involuntary body motion as standing affirmative consent, the other fabricates or forecloses the verbal exchange itself. A reader working either one should see the other as the same forgery run on the other channel.

third-person clinical exposition is one of the concealment covers in the broader hidden-install family, so the two genuinely overlap on one surface. Kept as a cross-reference rather than a merge because one is a whole-artifact register (zero second-person address across the entire piece, describe-don't-command) while the other is a family of install-act disguises that mostly still address the listener directly.

the saturate-then-withhold move can look like ordinary lead-in patter because both steer attention with a stream of accepted statements. The separation: paced-then-led delivery banks statements verifiably true in the moment and bolts an unverified target onto them, while the withheld-completion move drops the completion so the subject leans in and inverts who directs attention. Remove the withheld beat and only ordinary attention-steering remains.

both recruit a peer group, which makes them the most common mix-up in this area. The separation is whether reward is yoked: one turns co-present peers into enforcers by gating their reward on the target behavior, the other offers membership in an already-converted happier cohort so surrender reads as joining with no contingency at all.

both leave the listener wanting to come back, so they are genuinely confusable at the wake boundary. One prescribes post-wake relief, reframes the presenting distress as solved, and binds that relief to the operator and a pending compliance ask; the other conditions the alert cue itself as a deprivation event that manufactures craving for the down-state. Relief-as-coping versus manufactured craving.

both are whole-arc ordering properties invisible from inside any single passage, which is exactly why they get conflated. One orders trance-state phases so an earlier phase supplies the belief or agreement a later costly move depends on; the other orders affect, placing wanting just ahead of each threatening image so alarm never gets to drive. Phase dependency versus valence routing.

near inversions acting on the same object, a load-bearing internal safety belief. One withholds the change until the downstream consequences can be foreseen, constraining the operator even against an explicit request to proceed; the other names that belief as an obstacle and removes, reroutes, or co-opts it so the internal stop no longer protects. Reading them together is the clearest way to see which side of the line a move sits on.

both turn the listener's own behavior into evidence, so the boundary matters. One requires an enacted failure at a task chosen to be the trait being installed, converted into proof of a degraded identity; the other infers state from mere inertia, where continuing to listen or sitting in silence is itself the accumulating proof and no performance is needed.

both run several distinct phrases across a piece and both must be told apart from repeating one idea in varied phrasings, so they belong in the same reading pass. One uses a fixed frame as camouflage so novel payloads land in the varying slot unbraced; the other makes the relative repetition counts across phrases encode a hierarchy. Camouflage versus weighting.

both pin arousal at an unrelieved threshold and recode the frustration as the point, so they read alike in the moment. One is a compound reframe treating denial as proof the install is true and casting the defeat of the will as the desired outcome, with future self-questioning pre-answered; the other is a closed alternation between incompatible imperatives where any attempt at resolution feeds the loop. Reframe versus no-exit bind.

they frequently co-occur on the same depletion claim and both refuse to reset, so a reader will meet them together. Kept separate because the levers come apart cleanly: a one-way ratchet can be carried by external posture markers with nothing counted, and a countable self-generated depletion inventory can run without any repeated cycle to ratchet against.

both weaponize the subject's own valuation of the state by threatening or enacting its loss, and both require diagnosing that the state is genuinely wanted. They diverge on the goal: one withdraws the stimulus mid-experience to extract self-voiced begging and convert the experience into an owned commitment; the other threatens permanent forfeiture to get an otherwise unresponsive subject to exit.

both relocate authorship of a running state away from the listener-operator pair, but to different destinations: one supplies a benign natural cause, the other installs an external object as the active causal agent. An object declared causal of the mind-state is a special case worth cross-reading when deciding which authorship-relocation is in play.

both manufacture evidence that a state or role is already true before the doctrine is stated, and both work by the listener reading the proof as their own. They differ on whether the cited acts are real behavior openly annotated or a fabricated mirror loop, which is the call a reader has to make.

each entry already names the other as the neighbor to reach for instead, and the discriminating question is live: is the exit path punished, or is the success criterion rigged so nothing counts as failure. Keep the mutual cross-reference.

both are arc-topology deceptions where a structurally complete-looking restoration conceals retained content. One nests the payload inside symmetric countdowns, the other mirrors the induction vector at emergence. Same family of concealment, different position in the arc.

both manufacture a yes the listener never gave and bank it as standing authorization for later escalation. The split is what supplies the token - a real act, non-act, or circumstance relabeled versus an installed near-involuntary body movement harvested as admission - which is the call a reader must make when a nod is cited as agreement.

adjacent behavior-reduction procedures that each name the other as the alternative to choose against - removing the reinforcer that maintains an operant versus pairing an incompatible state against an eliciting cue. Practitioner-facing selection depends on reading both.

both work on perceptual-channel selection, but from opposite sides: one brings a dormant channel online by riding a shared feature of an already-vivid channel, the other reads which channel the listener is already using and covertly phrases suggestions inside it. Useful adjacency when classifying modality-aware delivery.

both fabricate a container that holds identity or memory content out of ordinary access; the live distinction is authorship and custody (operator-supplied deposit-only custodian versus a container the listener builds or keeps the key to). Genuine disambiguation risk, so the cross-reference earns its place.

consequence-side versus antecedent-side of the same behavioral economy: one gives a stimulus reinforcing function so it can select behavior after the fact, the other changes how much a consequence is worth before the response is evoked without delivering anything. Frequently confused in practice.

both are end-of-effect moves reached for at the same decision point: a targeted removal that mirrors the install structure and carves out a retained residue, versus a clean graded return to baseline carrying no payload. Choosing between them is a real fork.

both manufacture ongoing self-proof of an identity out of the listener's own behavior; the fork is whether the acts already happened and are merely annotated, or are newly installed as plausibly-invisible public behaviors under a secrecy frame. Close enough that a passage can read as either.

the same clear-then-fill topology applied at two layers: mass invalidation of prior beliefs followed by operator-supplied replacement, versus structurally ending the prior self-model and seating an assigned replacement in the vacancy. Real near-miss risk when a passage clears beliefs and identity together.

both are operator-side governance gates that narrow the operator's own license rather than acting on the subject, and both hold independently of the subject's consent or request. One gates on design coherence, the other on foreseen downstream fallout; a reader classifying a self-imposed hold needs the pair.

both involve memory being withheld, but the target differs. Concealing the installation event hides that any install happened, protecting an active suggestion from audit. The two-state toggle is overt: the subject knows both phrases, and the one-sided forgetting only blocks the untriggered side from reflecting on the triggered state, serving equilibrium drift rather than concealment.

both build an imagined venue. In the base case the scene exists for present absorption and is routinely parameterized. In the sealed form the declared properties of the venue do the work: exclusive access, exclusion from memory, edits that surface later feeling native. The seal, not the scene-building, is the mechanism.

both use a paired on/off phrase, so state the boundary. One swaps in a whole labeled alternate personality with a behavior bundle and delegates firing rights outward. The other trains a tonal mark rather than a word's meaning as the key to an existing memory seal, proven by the failure of paraphrase or frank statement to reach it. Persona driver versus memory-gate key.

the standard confusion in behavior-analytic contingencies, worth pinning. One increases a response because the response terminates or prevents an aversive that is already present, and the reinforcer is the relief. The other decreases a behavior by withholding access to reinforcement for a contingent period. Something removed to strengthen versus something withheld to suppress.

both recruit material the listener already has, so mark the boundary. One treats the listener's own ongoing act, continuing to attend or sitting in silence, as accumulating proof that the state is underway, with quitting pre-framed as already-failed. The other concedes an experience the listener already owns and disputes only its name, so a familiar state gets relabeled. Inertia as evidence versus a state-word downshift.

both put an operator in charge of a trajectory, but the levers differ: one transfers ownership of a private variable onto a manipulable instrument the operator turns, the other keys a response to the presence, tempo, or cessation of a sustained rhythm. The overlap is narrow - the tempo variant outsources arousal pacing to the operator's cadence - so the boundary is worth stating: instrument-ownership of the variable versus a response keyed to rhythm dynamics.

contradiction appears in both, but one feeds the resolving faculty content it cannot reconcile so analysis backlogs and shuts down, while the other sustains two incompatible appetitive drives to pin arousal at threshold with no resolution available. The tell is whether the payload is a stalled parser or a pinned drive state.

a denied-terminus count sits close to both, so the boundary needs saying: one breaks the tracking device so position cannot be followed at all, the other manipulates where the floor is so the deep-enough self-check never resolves. Broken sequence versus manipulated endpoint.

both keep trance content out of conscious reach, but one splits memory so the mechanism is occluded while a self-justifying rationale is preserved, and the other builds a personified custodian that only ever stores, with a retrieval promise never honored. Selective split versus deposit-only construct.

both foreclose a return to normal, in opposite time directions: one rewrites the past so no prior self exists to return to, the other asserts forward durability of what was installed. Deleted baseline versus claimed endurance.

both pre-own the interpretation of a bodily event so no outcome can read as failure or non-compliance - one covers arousal generally as an unfalsifiable readout of obedience, the other overwrites the meaning of a single uncontrollable release event by naming its shame first. Same interpretive-foreclosure family, different scope.

both protect an effect by managing what the subject knows: one hides or denies that an operation is running at all, the other blocks exposure to a specific fact that would collapse a belief already doing work. Concealing the operation versus guarding a running belief - adjacent enough that a writer choosing one should see the other.

both delete something to close an exit, but the object differs: one empties the conceptual tools for objecting to open a narrow slot for positive content, the other removes ordinary functioning from the inventory of reachable states. Cleared window for an install versus an edited state map.

both store value now to draw against later rather than spending it in the moment - accumulated reward or a pre-signed lever in one, manufactured proof of trustworthiness in the other. The banking topology is the same and the two stack naturally, so the cross-reference earns its place.

both put a group in the loop, at different points: one yokes reward delivery so peers gate each other, the other hands peers authorship of the target list with no self-veto. Who gates the reward versus who writes the agenda.

both bank commitment before the induction proper, and they stack in sequence: framing set at selection time, then physical acts extracted while the listener is still eyes-open. A builder choosing a pre-induction lever benefits from seeing both binding times. Distinct entries — one completes on a reader before any audio, the other on a listener performing acts in the waking state.

both defeat targeted objection by making the payload hard to isolate rather than by arguing for it. One scatters payload fragments through a carrier the listener must process whole; the other rides the parse-the-denial channel. A reader choosing a covert-delivery channel should compare the two concealment levers. Not a merge: hiding by low salience in a carrier is not the same as installing through negation.

these co-occur and reinforce: an embedded aesthetic object carries dense payload while the surrounding calendar ritual supplies the annual slot the melody collides with. A reader working either move should see how the recognition cue and the borrowed ritual compound into a yearly re-trigger. Distinct mechanisms — one is an aesthetic cover for payload density, the other a substitution into a slot the listener already practices.

twin authorship relocations that answer different questions. One relocates agency for the act to the listener as their own will or preference; the other relocates the cause of an already-running state onto a benign source and away from the operator. Adjacent enough to be miscoded for each other, so a mutual pointer is the useful guard.

adjacency-transfer of credibility is one of the borrowed-legitimacy variants, and the motor-convincer transfer is its sharpest single-source case: an already-demonstrated involuntary effect lends its authority to an untested claim. Worth cross-linking so the specific one-shot somatic transfer is not filed as a generic borrowing, and vice versa.

both price or foreclose leaving, at different layers: one makes exit cost the self, the other structurally removes the subject's autonomous off-switch and hands release to an operator condition. Since scripts commonly stack the identity cost on top of the structural monopoly, a reader auditing exit routes should see both. Not one technique — a contingency structure is not a monopolized off-switch.

both work by plurality rather than depth: the same removal applied across several independent targets so no single repair restores the lost footing. One erases boundaries across independent axes, the other dismantles ordered cognitive anchors in sequence through a single perceptual stream. Useful contrast on whether the multiplicity is simultaneous or staged.

both use an in-fiction scene role to relocate where the listener stands relative to the hypnotic content — one boxes attention onto an unavoidable second audible voice, the other dresses the listener as a non-participant. They occupy the same design slot as scene-premise wrappers, so a builder choosing a fictional wrapper wants both. Different levers: an audible second channel versus a costume of non-participation.

both quietly rewrite how the whole later suggestion stream is processed rather than delivering one payload: one installs a standing rule reattributing all future content to the listener, the other captures a scope-broadening authorization in a slot read as housekeeping. A reader auditing for channel-level clauses should check for both. Distinct — authorship reattribution versus scope widening, and the second turns on placement.

both are escalation architectures, but the units differ: one holds a single proposition fixed and hardens only its modal weight so no new claim is ever contested; the other enumerates successive identity tiers and spends prior uptake as warrant for the next. Same genus (escalation without a rejectable new claim), different grain and different payload class. Worth a distinctness note, not a reader hand-off.

both remove standing to deny, but by opposite routes: one asserts operator perceptual access to the interior, the other relocates authorship of the want onto the subject's own past. Neither reader needs the other to apply their entry correctly.

both pre-authorize content that does not exist at commitment time, which is a real boundary: one binds arbitrary future verbal commitments extracted under a stated condition, the other installs an open slot that future unspecified words inherit weight through. A reader classifying an open-ended pre-authorization needs both to pick correctly.

direct sibling boundary: multi-channel enrichment of one constructed scene belongs to the scene-building entry, whereas bringing a new channel online via a shared-feature carry-over is the bridge. Without the cross-reference these get conflated whenever more than one sense is addressed.

both relocate authority toward the subject, but one honors a narrow checkable contract to dissolve fear of coercion within a session, and the other applies a gradual fading schedule to who authors the contingency until the subject is both parties. Different timescales and different resistance being addressed.

both are whole-arc gradient properties cited to the absence of any announcing line rather than to a passage, so they compete for the same evidence shape. They differ in the variable being driven and its direction, which is exactly why a reader coding a monotone arc should see both.

same lever at two scales: supplying a false benign cause for one running state, versus a whole-arc design in which every outcome is severed from any locatable cause. A reader coding a single misattribution should know whether the surrounding artifact makes it the through-line.

both concern where evidence for a claim comes from, but one asserts operator access to the interior with no observable to contradict it, and the other points at a phenomenon the subject notices so the subject co-authors the belief. Opposite direction of attribution; a brief distinctness note suffices.

both concern the subject re-entering a state on their own, but one is an induction that offloads the state-shift onto recall of a prior trance, and the other is a forward-directed capability claim about future re-access. Adjacent in vocabulary, separate in function.

both suppress access to something, but one is retrospective and curates a single surviving token out of an erased scaffold, while the other prospectively removes a concept's comprehension during the active state so no rule remains to violate. Directionality of time is the clean separator.

both are design levers on the same arranged contingency and are explicitly disjoint: one closes off every path by which reinforcement can arrive outside the arrangement, the other sets how detectable the arrangement is to the subject. Readers arranging a contingency routinely need to place a move on the correct axis.

both reuse the subject's own words back at them and both aim at suggestions registering as self-originated. The split is what surface is harvested and to what end: exact intention-terms reused to keep a reframe from flipping, versus sensory-modality vocabulary read as a channel index and matched covertly. Easy to conflate without the link.

adjacent levers for making compliance feel self-chosen: relocating agency onto the subject versus welding the ask to a self-image the listener already prizes. One entry already names the other as a boundary case, so the pointer is earned rather than a category coincidence.

both are pre-work language moves that align the subject's terms with the operator's before a payload depends on them: one reconciles what the target state means, the other harvests the subject's own phrasing and reuses it for the new behaviour. Genuinely useful as a pair; the difference is aligning a referent versus preventing a later polarity flip.

one is the general graduated-assent ladder; the other pre-charges the word 'yes' with abstract positive value and only then runs a rapid yes-set. The second's discriminator explicitly says a bare ladder lacks the prior valence-loading, so the pointer helps a reader place a yes-set correctly.

both make handing over agency feel chosen or pleasant. One builds a precedent by resolving small real decisions for the listener and cashing each as comfort; the other relocates authorship of a fixed path onto the subject. Close enough that a writer could pick the wrong one, so the cross-reference does work.

both erect an interior venue the listener will return to, and one discriminator already contrasts a durable internal construct against a venue whose declared properties are sealed access and native-feeling edits. The pointer helps a reader tell an addressable rehearsal object from a concealment-sealed workspace.

directly contrastive: taking the evaluating faculty offline as a temporary delivery window versus claiming the faculty excised as a standing organ. Both discriminators already reference the same neighbouring gate-standdown and evaluator-relocation moves, so a reader needs the pair to choose correctly.

both hand the listener a verbal rule in advance so later experience is governed by the stated description rather than by what actually happens. One is the general verbal-governance lever, the other a specific portable asymmetric-oscillation template; the specific case reads as an application of the general one, so the pointer is load-bearing.

both produce amnesia, and both define themselves against a plain forget-command, so the boundary is worth stating: one frames forgetting as the listener's own permissive choice so no outcome reads as failure; the other drills a conditioned non-answer by repeatedly asking then dismissing. Choice-framing vs interrogative conditioning.

both bank compliance capital before it is spent: one extracts physical acts in the waking state pre-induction, the other manufactures a foreclosed-answer verification of past trustworthiness. A reader choosing between them needs the axis — physical act banked pre-trance vs verbal trust ledger banked in-session — so the pointer earns its place.

direction is the whole boundary and is easy to confuse: capturing an already-firing spontaneous state onto a re-pressable handle for later inspection versus installing a forward-running if-X-then-Y that fires an authored response outside the session. Intake vs install.

recalling a pre-owned prior trance to skip induction work is arguably a case of recruiting something the listener already has rather than building it. The narrower entry is worth reaching from the broader borrowed-legitimacy family, but the levers differ enough (retrieval of a stored trance vs transferring an external source's credibility) that they stay separate entries.

both run saturation repetition of a phrase the listener holds, and the second entry already names the first as its nearest confusion. The line: self-chanting a coherent phrase to encode its content versus collapsing the listener's own presenting word across incompatible senses until evaluating the session is defined as failure.

both escalate across repetitions and both define against yes-set chaining, so the shared boundary needs marking: one holds the sentence fixed and hardens a single operative word so no new claim appears, the other narrates a multiplying quantity on an already-present response. Syntactic substitution vs asserted compounding.

both open an empty slot and then fill it: one manufactures identity not-knowing with the operator as sole resolver, the other disables the tools for objecting and states content into the gap. Reader gains from seeing gap-by-uncertainty against gap-by-erasure.

genuinely confusable: both attach a handle that later re-presents a felt state. The separator is authorship and purpose — one installs a carried cue that reloads an operator-installed state out of session, the other captures a spontaneous reaction the operator did not author so it can be re-fired for inspection.

both harden an identity label past easy repudiation and both define against plain operator-delivered labelling. The axis is what does the hardening: a self-firing affect or categorical-incapacity modal welded to the category, versus routing the claim through the listener's own voice so there is no external author to reject.

both attach a non-verbal handle without a declarative when-X-then-Y, so the confusion is real. Separator: one captures a spontaneous already-firing state as an inspection object, the other builds a conditioned link by repeated unannounced pairing so a future response feels spontaneous.

both are welfare-facing reassurance and both risk being read as governance. The line: one affirms the standing license to choose and to stop, constraining the operator; the other pre-authorizes bodily and emotional noise so it reads as compliance rather than failure, constraining nothing.

two ways of making an identity label defend itself. One welds the label to a self-firing affect so membership is intrinsically rewarding; the other leaves the self-model fixed and prices exit as self-betrayal. Frequently co-occurring and easy to confuse, so the contrast is worth carrying.

same self-demolition family, different halves of the operation: the ordered stripping ladder is one route to the vacancy that clear-and-replace then occupies with an assigned replacement. A reader planning either needs to know whether a replacement is being seated.

the anchor-collapse move is a concrete instance of the abstract precondition: it manufactures simultaneity between two states the subject has never held at once so the existing integration procedure becomes runnable. Genus and worked case, not a merge - one is a topology operation stated generally, the other a specific anchoring procedure with its own disorganization signature.

the whole-arc consent topology explicitly contrasts itself with discrete single-relabel consent moves, and the term-redefinition smuggle is the clearest such discrete move. Useful to a reader deciding whether what they are looking at is one line or the shape of the entire artifact.

same lever on different events: an involuntary bodily signal the subject cannot switch off is re-tagged so it reads back as evidence for the operator's frame. One relabels ongoing arousal as an obedience readout; the other names a shame-coded uncontrollable release and overwrites it as success. The second additionally requires latent shame, which is the discriminating precondition.

process and end-state: the gradual handover of task, standard, monitoring and delivery from operator to subject terminates in exactly the self-run contingency loop the other entry describes. Not a merge - one names the fading schedule applied to authorship, the other the standing arrangement once the handover is complete.

both guarantee the subject cannot reach a passing outcome, and both spend competitive or approval-seeking effort as fuel. The distinguishing property is worth stating in both: one is a closed game where every reachable branch delivers the payload, the other a standard reset upward at the moment success would land.

disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency: one decides that nothing outside the contingency pays, the other decides which other behaviour earns reinforcement. Both are commonly needed together and each entry already gestures at the other's territory.

both are whole-form carriers rather than passage-local moves, sustaining the state without requiring per-line attention. The useful contrast is where the rhythm lives: the listener's own body motion in one, the engineered prosody of the delivery in the other, which is exactly the operator-independence question a reader is deciding.

both occupy the exit slot as positive governance and a writer designing a safe ending weighs them together. One fills the emergence window with a benign directive so no spontaneous negative self-suggestion can form there; the other fixes a single exclusive termination cue before entry that survives the state's lack of event memory. Timing and purpose differ, the design question is shared.

tight and genuinely confusable. Both take a felt bodily state the subject already owns and re-deploy it by declaration alone with no fresh elicitation. One moves the effect to a new body region; the other keeps the signal and inverts its signed valence, deleting the source affect as a category. Same credit being spent, different thing done with it.

very close but not one technique twice. Both derive a claim from an act the subject has already performed so refusal means denying an observable fact. One is a single labeling move at identity scale that additionally welds a morphological trigger so name and behavior validate each other; the other is the cross-phase scheduling relationship between a manufacture phase and a later naming phase. Keep separate, link strongly.

adjacent operator-side design moves that are easy to conflate. One decides which behavior the intervention should aim at, using selection criteria; the other is the hand-off that fixes the agreed operational definition and the watch-list before observation begins. Choosing a target and pinning down how it will be recorded are consecutive steps, and each entry's boundary is clearer next to the other.

genuine neighbors: both reassign authorship of a change off the listener so there is nothing for the volitional muscle to push against. They differ in what they operate on -- one relocates agency onto an already-accepted trigger so a non-collapse cannot read as personal failure, the other frames a descent or dissolution as happening-to rather than done-by. A reader picking between them benefits from seeing both.

both engineer contradiction-proofing rather than content, so they read usefully together. One names the influence-channel, flips its valence to protection, and pre-classifies outside checking as the threat; the other welds an explicit immunity clause onto an ownership claim so contradiction from a higher layer cannot reach it. Same defensive goal, different structure -- valence flip plus critic-as-enemy versus a layered partition with a sealed lower level.

both smuggle a dense payload past evaluation by riding a carrier the listener has already accepted, which makes the contrast instructive. One uses a distinct aesthetic object embedded in the script so the passage parses as an interlude; the other threads the payload through a low-resistance move already consented to, where stripping the payload leaves an ordinary version of that move. Cover-object versus cover-procedure is the useful distinction.

worth linking: the token pair that toggles between an operable substate and deep helplessness is one concrete way to achieve what the other entry describes topologically -- keeping the subject in the deep state across a boundary that would normally end it. A reader working the eyes-open-but-still-under problem wants both the general boundary-neutralizing options and this specific reversible-toggle solution.

both enroll the listener into a category without an operator-assigned label, and the pair reads well together because the difference is who performs the assignment. One slides the referent onto the listener by grammatical drift or forced per-occurrence self-translation; the other states a category and leaves it unassigned so the listener supplies the silent yes. Covert grammatical enrollment versus voluntary self-slotting.

one phrase versus several, and the difference is load-bearing rather than incidental. Self-chanting a single meaning-bearing phrase installs its content as self-asserted; rotating several fixed phrases at deliberately lopsided frequencies makes the ratio across phrases the encoding of a hierarchy. The frequency entry already excludes single-phrase moves by name, so the contrast is real but no craft transfers -- record it as distinct rather than as a reading recommendation.

strong overlap without being one entry. The arousal-substrate topology satisfies the no-reversal shape -- no calm down-phase, no discharge, no relief beat -- so it reads as a realized instance of the broader contour. It adds something the contour does not cover: two exit routes entangled so leaving requires both to fire at once. Link them, but do not merge; the contour is a family of shapes and the exit-entanglement is a separate structural claim.

same setup, opposite harvest -- an unusually instructive pairing. Both install a near-involuntary nod with a wide acceptance window and accrue visible evidence of the listener performing it. One then banks that motion as standing affirmative consent so later denial would mean repudiating one's own body; the other declares the behavior can no longer be performed unaided and hands it to operator control, staging the loss. Reading both shows what an installed nod can be cashed for.

both are operator-side anchor craft, which is why the contrast should be recorded rather than left to a reader to infer. One fires two reliable anchors for mutually exclusive states simultaneously to destroy the exclusivity between them, accepting overt disorganization as the price. The other cuts a spontaneous already-firing reaction off mid-flight and ties a re-pressable handle to it so the state can be re-summoned for inspection. Jamming two authored anchors versus capturing one unauthored state -- opposite directions on the same tool.

both build an obligation the target feels bound by, but the ledger is stocked differently: one seeds a fictional prior bargain before anything happens, converting a future extraction into a present desirable identity; the other annotates the listener's genuine, already-performed acts as evidence of a state. Fabricated-deal-in-advance versus real-behavior-annotated-as-it-accrues is the boundary a reader needs.

both hand the subject a reassurance that lowers guard, and both leave the operator unconstrained, so they are easy to confuse. The separator is what the assurance neutralizes: one stands down a protective check about safety or exit, the other dissolves a timing gate on a payload response so failure becomes impossible. Guard-disarm versus pass/fail-removal.

both route a new effect along an existing perceptual event rather than summoning it head-on, which makes them genuinely confusable. The separator is the destination: one licenses a real bodily event as the carrier for an abstract cognitive claim, the other uses a shared feature of a vivid channel to bring a second perceptual channel online. Cognitive edit versus perceptual activation.

both install a rule rather than a content item, and they compose: one pre-maps every future outcome to confirmation, the other pre-resolves every future ambiguity toward the operator. A reader designing an operator-absent persistence layer benefits from seeing the evidence-side rule and the action-side rule together.

both arrange the listener's framing before the session can be resisted, but they run on different surfaces and different truth conditions. One completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface before any playback and may be perfectly truthful; the other is a load-bearing lie about what is happening, told during entry. Pre-playback framing versus in-session decoy.

both make a single word carry unusual weight and both precede or feed a trigger install, so they are easy to conflate. The separator is scale and operation: one promotes a word across grammatical roles until it names a felt entity, the other builds an entire script so one token is topic, content, trigger, and delivery key at once. A local role-shift versus a whole-script architecture.

both drive escalating want-to-return and both can name no ceiling, so the surfaces look alike. The separator is the engine: one labels the appetite semantically with craving and dose vocabulary, the other recites a closed causal cycle as a formula that feeds its output back in. Affective labeling versus a stated loop topology.

both manufacture meaning for a word or frame through repeated use rather than by asserting a proposition, which is the confusable part. The separator is where the content comes from: one leaves a slot deliberately vacant so the listener supplies the completion, the other walks a word up the grammatical ladder until the operator's role-shift has produced the referent. Listener-completed versus operator-promoted.

both turn on reading a sign of depth, and both can involve amnesia or catalepsy as the sign, so they are genuinely mistakable. The separator is who the reading is for and what it licenses: one stages a phenomenon for the subject to notice as their own proof, the other refuses to infer depth from a look-alike sign and blocks the operator until independently verified. Subject-facing convincer versus operator-side gate.

both install through paced repetition and both can run without a formal induction frame, so a reader will hesitate. The separator is who produces the phrase and whether the frame is hidden: one has the listener speak meaning-bearing content as self-asserted belief, the other hides operator cadence inside real physical motion so the activity itself becomes the trigger. Self-chanted content versus masked cadence.

both extend a suggestion past the session with no fixed clock, which is the confusable surface. The separator is what the vagueness or contingency does: one refuses to state a decay time so checking re-refreshes the residue, the other fires a re-listen only when an emotion inconsistent with the programming shows up. Unbounded fade versus failure-keyed reactivation.

both relocate control of behavior away from a live operator prompt and both use fading, so the pair is genuinely confusable in a behavioral frame. The separator is which term is relocated: one gives a stimulus reinforcing function so it fires as a consequence, the other has the subject supply their own antecedent cue. Consequence-side versus antecedent-side.

two consecutive steps of one measurement protocol: the unconditional logging protocol produces exactly the behavior-present and behavior-absent counts that the contingency computation consumes. A reader implementing either needs the other to get a usable result. Kept separate because one is a recording discipline and the other an analytic computation.

both relocate authorship of a response away from the listener's will, which makes them easy to conflate. But one is a grammatical reframe applied to an already-accepted trigger so the listener cannot fail at it, while the other installs a named phrase that operates on other commands to remove the refusal gate. Reframe versus installed meta-trigger.

both deliver an identity without ever asking for belief, so a writer may reach for the wrong one. The difference is the carrier: one accrues identity as residue from a graded chain of body sensations, the other recolors the register of inner speech so the effect is content-independent and fires on any future thought.

both source an identity from behavior rather than asserting a label, on the shared premise that an observable act is harder to dispute than a claim. They differ in which behavior: a failure enacted on the spot versus an already-installed compelled movement backfilled into a name. Useful to read together when choosing which behavior to build the identity on.

both wear safety vocabulary while removing the listener's ability to revise a safety judgment downward. One pre-locks the verdict before threatening content arrives; the other targets the internal stop-faculty itself. Frequently stacked, and a reader evaluating either should see the other.

near-opposites that share the surface of relieving a control-related fear. One recodes an actual loss of control as felt gain so yielding registers as relief; the other genuinely relocates termination authority to the subject and visibly honors it. The tell is whether anything is really handed over.

both act on the stream of thought and both avoid a bare stop-thinking command, which invites confusion. But one engineers the emptying so no refusable directive exists, while the other explicitly forbids clearing and trains a notice-and-return observer loop. Opposed instructions about controlling thought content.

both present the listener with two poles, so they look alike at a glance. One offers symmetric, resolvable-either-way choices to elicit cheap commitment and habituate an accept-any-answer frame; the other sustains two incompatible desires until the paralysis is unbearable and gates the only exit on surrender. Low-stakes and resolvable versus deliberately irresolvable.

both build an equivalence through word-level seams without ever announcing a linkage, so the listener experiences continuous escalation rather than a discrete claim to refuse. One rides a shared verb, referent-slide or pun; the other hands a term forward line to line until a cross-substitutable cluster forms. Adjacent covert-binding craft.

both involve a split in the self, which is exactly the confusion worth flagging. In one the split is a maintained tool for handling charged material and is entered and exited by procedure; in the other a durable named second self is manufactured to carry the conditioned behavior. Instrument versus payload.

both make body sensation carry the frame, but one reuses a sensation already genuinely present and only reassigns its meaning, while the other induces a reversed sensation in a carved-out body part and welds it into a reciprocal loop. Reusing a real percept versus constructing an antagonistic one.

both attach state or material to a prop object, which is the confusable surface. One exports a state onto an object the listener owns so it re-fires in daily life with the operator absent; the other has the listener build or keep a container to bracket material during the session. Export-and-refire versus bracket-and-hold.

both are relabelling moves and both leave the listener feeling they reached the conclusion themselves. One hands over an under-specified prompt so the listener manufactures content that was never asserted; the other concedes the facts intact and swaps only the interpretive frame so the same fact recomputes to the opposite valence. Seeding new content versus recomputing a fixed one.

both are amnesia-family moves, which makes the boundary worth stating. One is retrospective and targets the installation event so an active command has no examinable origin; the other is prospective and dissolves comprehension of a concept during the state so there is no rule the listener could knowingly violate. Erasing provenance versus removing a comparator.

adjacent authorship moves that are easy to conflate: one leaves a category unassigned so the listener privately applies it to themselves, the other relocates authorship of the payload so the listener supplies the loaded content. The distinction is whether the listener assigns an operator-stated category or originates the content, and each entry is where a classifier will hesitate.

both install cue-response pairs and both dispense with an explicit operator-supplied verbal trigger token, so the boundary needs stating: one keys firing to a structural event of the listener's own cognition, the other keys it to a discrete non-verbal external signal paired below awareness. Self-firing from within versus covertly conditioned from outside.

both are whole-script structural properties and one already cites the other, so the boundary should be explicit: one is a trajectory in which the operator manufactures the distress it then cures, the other is a register shift that diffuses who or what caused the change. Arc of states versus attribution of agency.

both build an imaginal object the listener carries past the moment of construction, which invites conflation. One falsely attributes an operator-authored focal object to the listener's own imagery and internalizes it as a pacer; the other builds a knowingly-made object given a location or handle for later re-access. Laundered provenance versus addressability.

both make the listener the author so the result cannot be disowned, and the container entry is a concrete special case of the general authorship lever restricted to a functional prop the listener builds or keeps. The pointer helps a reader decide whether to file a self-built container under the broader authorship technique.

strong overlap: the broad entry lists preemptive disarmament of the most likely defense among its realizations, and the other entry is precisely the specific-objection form. A reader needs the pointer to decide between foreclosing resistance as a class and neutralizing one named foreseeable objection.

both externalize mental content as a graspable object handled by the operator, and the difference is what happens next: one destroys or discards a container to produce erasure, the other keeps a single persistent object and reuses it as gag and restraint. Same reification family, opposite fate for the object.

the operator-free closure names self-worth staked on compliance as one of its interlocking components, and that component is exactly the identity-priced exit. Reader of the whole-script architecture gains from the discrete move that supplies its identity-cost limb; reader of the discrete move gains from seeing the end-state it is usually built toward.

both stage the conscious/subconscious split and instruct that something be ignored, which makes them easy to conflate. But one relocates the evaluating faculty out of scope so objections are pre-classified as background noise, while the other stages an unresolved catastrophe purely so that ignoring it demonstrates ceded authority over safety orientation. The ignore-instruction is scaffolding in the second, mechanism in the first.

both use the word ritual, which is the whole overlap and a real confusion risk. One engineers a new multi-node loop (environmental cue, acquisition, private ritual, return to the recording) whose payload is perpetuation; the other substitutes content into a cultural practice the listener already runs, inheriting its weight without building any loop.

same family: new material rides in under a carrier the listener has already cleared. One hides the delta inside near-identical repetition so it reads as already heard; the other hides an identity or body-schema rewrite inside a low-resistance move already consented to. Picking between them turns on whether the cover is repetition or prior consent.

both are all-branches-confirm rigs and the discriminating question is what is rigged: a staged game whose every play route lands in the target state, versus the subject's own act of checking or reasoning, whose every verdict is pre-mapped to confirmation. Genuinely adjacent enough that a writer will mis-assign one for the other.

both delete the listener's outside reference point and are the closest neighbours to each other. One erases boundaries by asserting the same equivalence across multiple independent axes so no territory reads as not-operator; the other leaves boundaries intact and captures the sources a counter-frame would draw on, relabelling them as the operator's. Equivalence versus capture is the line.

both make compliance feel self-chosen and both traffic in a flattering self-image, which invites conflation. The lever differs: one seeds a reciprocity ledger by pricing the cost side vaguely and the benefit side concretely, so an obligation reads as a good deal; the other welds the ask to a prized self-concept the listener already holds, with no exchange implied.

ratchet vocabulary makes these look like the same move. One narrates a monotonic in-session multiplication of an already-present variable; the other overtly names an asymmetric oscillation as a portable rule, demos it on a neutral substrate, then hands it over to be attached to arbitrary variables later. Covert in-session escalation versus a taught take-home template.

both start from something the subject genuinely produced rather than from bare assertion, which is the confusion. One reassigns the meaning of an already-present sensation so the body supplies proof; the other uses a shared feature, or a spontaneously emitted slip, as a rail to bring a not-yet-active perceptual channel online. Reinterpretation versus channel recruitment.

both suppress evaluation through form rather than content and both can be mistaken for decorative style. The levers are separable: one repeats a token past the point where meaning survives, so the lever is sheer count; the other sustains metrical verse so rhyme prediction continuously consumes the evaluative budget and pivots pass without a seam. Removing the count kills the first, removing the verse kills the second.

both act on the attentional budget but by opposite levers: narrowing to a single focus versus multiplying or flooding demand until evaluation starves. The overload entry already names this contrast explicitly, and a writer choosing between them needs the boundary.

both bank a real physical act as a compliance receipt, and they differ on the axis a writer must actually pick along: binding time (waking, pre-induction) versus permanence (an irreversible act that becomes autobiographical evidence). The two can co-occur in one act, so the reader benefits from seeing both.

clothing appears in both but does different work: in one it is incidental evidence of an amnesia gap that a confabulation routine must explain away; in the other the garment-state is the cue that holds the identity lock. Adjacent enough to be confused, so the contrast is worth stating.

both are welfare-facing permission moves that pre-empt a failure reading: one licenses bodily or emotional noise so it does not read as trance failure, the other licenses leaving a task undone so it does not read as personal failure. A reader looking for the permission-grant family gains from the pairing.

this is the load-bearing safety contrast: a real subject-controlled off-ramp versus a safety assurance whose acceptance stands down the guard while never constraining the operator. A reader of either needs the who-is-constrained test.

both convert protective-sounding surface material into delivery: an escape warning that rehearses the payload it warns about, and an aftercare surface that performs install work. Same inversion applied at opposite ends of a session, and a reader auditing safety-shaped language wants both.

both install a durable standing clause rather than a present-tense claim, and they are easy to confuse: one makes future suggestion CONTENT pre-accepted, the other hardens the SCOPE of the operator's authority. Worth cross-reading for the object-of-the-clause distinction.

both reuse something already present rather than installing fresh, but one carries the payload on an internal memory the operator does not control, and the other re-keys an already-conditioned cue with retroactive reach. The reuse-versus-fresh-install similarity invites mislabeling.

both disable evaluation rather than argue a claim, and they differ only in which channel is disabled: the truth-testing faculty wholesale versus the authority of the listener's own felt sense as evidence. A reader of one is likely looking for the other.

the nod harvest is a motor rung of the same graduated-assent logic, but it ends in a standing consent claim rather than momentum. Directly neighboring, and the ladder entry already gestures at motor assents, so the reader needs the boundary.

both make the subject supply the content and then credit it as proof, one via a near-null described stimulus and one via a mimed frame with no verbal channel at all. Same self-supplied-response lever at different degrees of operator input.

both route through body sensation but in opposite directions: one seizes a sensation already present and reassigns its meaning, the other elicits a body location to originate a fresh handle on a disputed behavior. Similar surface, different operation.

both puncture something the subject was relying on, but the targets differ. One destroys the subject's ability to tell whether they were in trance, removing the criterion resistance would need; the other severs a specific unexamined inference the subject was treating as evidence, steering them toward useful self-doubt. Opposite directions on criticality, and no shared delivery structure.

directly complementary governance moves on the same axis: one asserts that the subject's freedom to choose and stop persists, the other installs a concrete stop mechanism. A reader deciding which is present in a script needs the assert-versus-install line, and each entry already leans on the other to draw it.

one overloads the resolving faculty with input that cannot be resolved; the other forecloses the audit channel so no self-report or inspection can disconfirm the frame. Both remove a defense, but one attacks parsing and the other attacks evidence — worth stating the boundary, not worth a cross-link for a reader.

same reciprocity lever run at two ranges: one seeds an obligation ledger far in advance as a desirable identity, the other renders an immediate free service and collects while the debt is live. A reader identifying an obligation play benefits from seeing both the pre-seeded and the front-loaded form, and from the repayment-channel boundary condition.

one relocates agency so compliance feels self-authored; the other selects a suggestion the subject already wants so acceptance is pre-loaded. Both lower resistance by aligning with the subject, but one manufactures felt authorship over a fixed path while the other requires a genuine pre-existing want and fails without it.

two gates that both constrain the operator before anything is installed, at different stages: one tests whether the authored procedure is correct and transferable, the other tests whether the subject actually likes the experience and can return abort. A reader auditing a script's governance layer wants both and needs the artifact-versus-lived-trial distinction.

the eyelid-closure move establishes the external-to-internal shift; the anchor move builds an operator-authored focal object attributed to the listener's own imagery and then internalizes it as a portable pacer. Closure often accompanies the anchor install, but the mechanisms and payloads are separate.

complementary levers on one contingency: one builds a cue's control by reinforcing in its presence and withholding in its absence, the other closes every path by which reinforcement reaches the behavior outside the arranged contingency. Discrimination training fails outright if the leaks are open, so a reader working on either needs the other.

both are topologies built from cue-response links, but one is a forward serial chain where each junction reinforces backward and cues forward, and the other closes the loop so the response re-summons its own cue source. Open chain versus no exit term is the whole difference and it is worth stating.

the same annexation lever aimed at different objects: one co-opts the subject's relationships or prior conditioning so no counter-frame has an outside source, the other captures the frame's own genuine off-ramp so using it reads as in-frame service. Whoever is auditing what remains outside a frame needs both, and the shared tell is capture-and-relabel rather than denial.

a trust condition bounding a first-order trigger is not the same as a second-order phrase that disables the refusal gate on other commands. One narrows when a cue may fire; the other operates on will itself. Adjacent only through the shared word clause.

both dress install work in a consent or safety surface, and both are told apart by the same question: after the move runs, is the operator constrained or is the operator's reach extended? A reader classifying a caring-sounding rider genuinely needs the other entry to pick correctly.

both relocate the self-model, but in opposite directions: one vacates identification upward off the named self and strips the proper name, the other seats the self inside a supplied figure so its predicates become first-person. Upward vacating versus downward occupation.

one moves an already-owned somatic effect to a new site by declaration with no fresh elicitation; the other originates a new kinesthetic handle by having the subject locate a disputed behavior in the body. Relocating an existing effect versus creating a first handle is the split.

both convert an installed state into real-world acquisition, and both need care to tell apart: one closes a multi-node loop through an object and a ritual back to re-listening, the other launders cultivated craving into a funding motive through a fabricated conduit chain. A reader classifying a purchase-driving move can land on the wrong one.

landing an appraisal before the subject perceives a specific stimulus is a one-shot ordering move; swapping the criterion for truth to a felt affect-tag and then driving its inputs is a sustained architecture. Pre-empting one perception versus replacing the judgment faculty.

both cite the subject's own behavior, but one annotates real acts as evidence that a target state already holds, shifting the perceived baseline, while the other hands genuine termination authority over and honors it. Evidence-manufacture versus real control transfer — near-opposite in whose position improves.

both are whole-artifact retention architectures with no single citable line, and the boundary between them is fine: one is structurally incomplete without its neighbouring pieces, the other is self-contained but engineered to re-fire and re-install itself in daily life. A reader classifying an architecture-level retention lever needs both.

both are whole-script properties rather than single moves, but one names an operator-free self-detecting and self-punishing control loop, and the other names the artifact performing the very operation it describes. Architecture of the installed system versus fusion of form and content.

one recites a closed causal cycle with an explicit no-ceiling clause so affect and compulsion escalate; the other forces assertion of a lexical identity between two concepts and frames disagreement as failed comprehension. A runaway loop versus a symbolic-registry rewrite.

both convert something the listener does into something that merely happens, and the boundary is what is retired: one reassigns agency over a state-change so there is nothing to push against, the other retires volition over an act just deliberately engaged and banks it as a template for later involuntariness. Genuinely easy to conflate.

both are whole-artifact structural properties rather than local moves, and both close a circuit: one validates claims using states the text itself induced, the other fuses form and content so encountering the description re-enacts it. A reader classifying a text-level topology needs both options side by side.

one pre-locks a single verdict, safety, so it cannot be revised downward; the other pre-maps the entire outcome space so nothing can land as disconfirmation. Same no-disconfirming-branch topology at different scope, and the broader entry already lists neighbors of this kind, so the narrower one should point up to it.

both reify cognition as a graspable object the operator handles, and both pre-empt the 'I can still think' defense. They diverge on what happens to the object: one loads content into a container and destroys it on a repeating cycle, the other keeps a single removed thought-object and reuses it as gag and restraint. A writer choosing between disposal and possession benefits from seeing both.

two whole-arc concealment structures that both withhold something evaluable until after commitment is manufactured. One hides how the relational frame was built, disclosing the role only once convincers have landed; the other hides what the session is even about until objecting reads as the predicted symptom. Same timing logic, different withheld quantity.

both are operator-side gates that can block an install from proceeding, and both are constraints on the operator rather than moves performed on the subject. One gates on the operator's foresight about downstream fallout and holds even against an explicit request to proceed; the other gates on the subject's lived, tested endorsement and can return abort. Useful pair when choosing which kind of restraint to write.

one is a concrete vehicle for the other's payload. Shifting the script's register from mystical to industrial makes the change feel done by apparatus, which is exactly the relocation of authority onto an impersonal, unfalsifiable source. Not one technique twice: the register shift is a whole-script property that also supplies permissions, while the alibi is a claim-type that can arrive in a single line.

both command a real physical act so the doing itself becomes the evidence, and the reversible/irreversible split is the whole discriminating axis. One directs a body movement to manufacture proprioceptive proof for a cognitive claim in the moment; the other directs a permanent act that becomes an undeniable autobiographical event across later sessions. Genuinely useful to see side by side.

both install a frame with a deliberately empty slot and let the slot's vacancy carry the payload, which makes them easy to confuse. They differ in who fills it and when: one leaves the slot open so the listener's own associations attach during the session, the other pre-commits the listener to accept whatever the operator later drops in. Not one technique twice — the filler and the power that fills it are different.

both get their force from routing the claim through the listener's own voice so there is no external author to reject, and both are stickier than the same content asserted by the operator. One hands over an identity claim; the other forces an asserted equivalence between two concepts that diverge in ordinary usage. Same ownership handoff, different payload.

front and back door of the same envelope: both move authorization outside the session proper. One does its framing work at purchase or selection time so the listener arrives pre-committed; the other, at the close, blanket-authorizes whatever plays next. Both leave the listener consenting to material they have not evaluated.

same strategic stance from opposite sides. Both deliberately leave the evaluating faculty intact and work around it rather than suppressing it. One narrows what the faculty may range over so the felt sense of free thought survives; the other shapes each suggestion to pass an untouched filter. Useful pair when the writer wants selectivity preserved rather than bypassed.

a specific probe and the general diagnostic surface it belongs to. Detonating a group's habitual sequence and then withholding engagement is an elicitation designed to harvest a structural read-out, with lowered resistance only a byproduct. The broader entry covers the shared discipline: the payoff lands in the operator's map and nothing is installed.

both deliver progressive motor lock, and the second entry's discriminator explicitly contrasts itself against the first (plain 'you cannot move' vs immobility caused by an ownership change). A reader deciding how to classify a catalepsy passage genuinely needs the pair. Not a merge: one spends the lock as in-session depth proof, the other as a persisting self-model rewrite that outlasts the lock.

both are closures against competing conditioning, and they differ on the one axis a reader must pick between: deny-and-route-into-erasure versus annex-and-relabel-as-the-operator's. Rival prior conditioning is the shared object, so a reader classifying an immunity clause needs to check which move is on the page. Genuinely two mechanisms, so no merge.

both are whole-arc defensive architectures built to survive later scrutiny, and their tells are close enough to confuse: a single immunity clause welded onto one ownership claim, versus several redundant layers each answering a different retrospective attack. The distinguishing question is one wrapper or many, so a reader classifying a self-sealing passage benefits from the pair.

adjacent design-time operator moves that are easy to conflate, and each discriminator already names the other: one filters and operationalizes which target to aim at, the other exhaustively enumerates the space the plan must survive. They also interlock, since the enumeration supplies the environment map the selection criteria test against. Filtering is not enumerating, so no merge.

both convert the same carrier, ongoing breath, into a standing compliance channel, and a reader looking at a breath passage must pick between them. One re-keys the act's name to import loaded connotations onto every subsequent cycle; the other retires volition over a breath just engaged so it runs unattended as banked proof. Same substrate, different lever, so no merge.

both manufacture escalation without ever presenting a fresh proposition to refuse, and both discriminators define themselves against the same neighbor that accretes distinct assents. One hardens a single operative word under fixed syntax; the other reinterprets one near-empty act as proof of broad submission. A reader trying to rule out an accumulating-agreement reading benefits from seeing the pair. No merge: hardening a held claim is not reinterpreting a performed act.

both manufacture perceptual evidence for something untrue and rely on the target skipping verification, and each names the same neighbor class in its discriminator. One stages genuine external events across redundant sense-channels so agreement reads as verified fact; the other forges a token of a single pre-existing reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires. Redundancy versus counterfeiting one releaser keeps them distinct.

the two overlap directly in one surface form: a permission question answered in the same breath with no response beat. A reader hitting that line must decide whether the payload is a manufactured stream of felt agreement or a fabricated record of a consent act invoked later against repudiation. Different products from the same beat, so cross-reference rather than merge.

both rewrite the causal story about something the listener is already experiencing. One flips the cause of immobility onto a property change so the body reads as no longer the listener's; the other reassigns the cause of ordinary drift and sensation to the operator's influence. Reading them together separates a self-model payload from an operator-credit payload.

both externalize a faculty as a graspable object, but the levers diverge. One narrates the externalized object losing under a topology where resisting and not resisting both concede; the other keeps one persistent object and reuses it as extraction, gag, and restraint. Shared surface, different load-bearing feature.

both manufacture wanting for a position rather than commanding it, by making the position scarce. One withholds the state and then grants it so the listener becomes petitioner; the other stages a peer barred from the position and openly longing, so the wanting is inherited. Useful as a pair on scarcity-driven pull.

both work by arriving first, before the subject forms their own reading. One supplies a defusing interpretation for a nameable objection; the other lands an authoritative appraisal before the stimulus is perceived at all. The contrast is what gets pre-empted: an objection versus a perception.

both protect an already-running state by managing what the subject can hear rather than by producing the state. One is standing environmental hygiene aimed at bystanders; the other is a discrete instruction that blocks one present fact from reaching the subject. Read as the ambient and the acute form of the same guard.

both are operator-side governance gates where the constrained party is the operator and the action is blocked until a condition is met. One gates a high-stakes act on verified depth rather than a look-alike sign; the other gates whether the session runs at all and on whom. Naturally read together.

both rebuild cooperation with a resisting party, and the second already names the first as its nearest neighbor. One enacts a reversal in which the operator performs and the target holds the reward; the other has the resister produce or publicly endorse the outcome so their own commitment binds later objection. Enacted reversal versus authored endorsement.

both swap the label of what is happening so the objection attached to the old name never fires. One substitutes the whole session's genre for a mundane self-selected activity; the other rewraps a single just-refused task under a harmless everyday name. The contrast is whole-session cover versus single-task wrapper.

both turn opposition into fuel, so the boundary matters. One requires a live or noticed push-back impulse and reroutes it so exercising it feeds the frame; the other wires the subject's standing antagonist role so performing the preferred dominant identity itself pumps the target craving. Live impulse versus standing role.
