both install out-of-session re-firing, and the boundary is the payload: an ambient real-world stimulus set that re-evokes and reinforces a state, versus a one-directional named-situation-to-named-response conditional. Both discriminators already gesture at the other side of this line.

two ways to manufacture felt volition: relabel a compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will, versus offer a bounded menu whose every branch executes the same compliance. A writer choosing how to launder volition should compare them.

both gate release to drive a return, and the useful contrast is where enforcement lives: routed back through re-consuming the operator's material, versus relocated entirely into an out-of-session reciprocal peer economy with no hypnotic mechanism running once the audio stops.

directly contrastive deepeners, and each discriminator already turns on the other: an actual brief upswing toward waking followed by a re-drop, versus manipulating or abolishing the floor with no waking interval at all.

both make the listener the producer, and the boundary is who supplies the words: novel content the listener invents or a control they operate, versus fixed lines handed over to be voiced back. Adjacent enough that the distinction needs to be visible from either entry.

both re-attribute an arousal signal rather than conditioning a new response, and the split is whether the signal is present or withheld: existing arousal declared to mean obedience, versus blocked and undischargeable arousal declared to be depth fuel. Useful pair for choosing which reattribution to run.

same ownership-handoff lever with different payload classes: novel compliance content the listener generates, versus an identity claim or its legitimizing judgment spoken in the listener's own voice. The payload class is the taxonomy's working boundary in this family, so they stay separate but must cross-reference.

both operate at the wake line and the boundary is whether anything new is delivered: a persistence claim about already-installed content inside a genuine return to baseline, versus a fresh vague deniable hook smuggled in under an aftercare or disclaimer wrapper.

both route payload past conscious audit, and each already draws the boundary against the other: two concurrently authored carriers with decoy and payload roles versus one carrier whose surface form hides the payload. A reader choosing between them needs the carrier-count test, so the cross-reference earns its place.

a genuine before-and-after pair on the same deception: one uses a false benign frame to get in unresisted, the other keeps a genuinely delivered frame as the carrier and cashes out an unrequested payload late. Each discriminator already turns on entry-versus-cash-out, so the link teaches the distinction.

both widen what one utterance can fire, on orthogonal axes: several channels carrying the same trigger-response pair, versus one cue composing several separately installed responses. Same-trigger-more-channels against more-triggers-one-cue is exactly the confusion a cross-reference resolves.

plain fixation narrows attention onto an inert focus under assumed cooperation; agency displacement keeps the focus but credits it as the causal author of the attention or trance, relocating locus of control so wandering attention reads as the object working.

two ways an anchor outlives the operator's voice, split by where it lives: an operator-authored pacer laundered as the listener's own imagery and moved inside the head, versus an external everyday object the listener owns and encounters. The internal-versus-external siting is the selection test and each entry names the other's territory.

covert regression re-accesses an earlier developmental state as the payload via a non-directive vehicle; the hourglass wrapper uses regression plus time-dilation instrumentally as licensing frame and rehearsal engine for a durable identity rewrite.

sibling departures from plain fixation, each altering a different property: removal of the recognize-and-refuse juncture, versus manufacture of a real physiological event that ratifies the suggestion. A reader deciding which departure is present benefits from seeing both.

layered repetition drives ONE payload by sheer exposure at roughly uniform emphasis; the frequency schedule uses several distinct phrases whose lopsided repetition RATIO is itself the encoding of a hierarchy.

both place an autonomic event under operator control, split by what is gated: release withheld until a specific target behavior unlocks it, making the body the enforcer, versus both onset and cessation transferred so neither start nor stop is retained. The unlock-key versus bidirectional-authority test is what a reader needs.

both widen an installed payload's firing surface, but scope-expansion is defined by the jump past the advertised frame into operator-benefit domains with a concrete cash-out, where plain context-generalization widens a neutral state with no such routing.

both relocate the wanting behind compliance into the subject so refusal has nothing external to push against. The second is worth reaching separately for its accumulation structures (a stack of distinct affects built to feel uncontrollable, a bonded petition-plus-identity unit) which the first does not carry; the first is the bare relabel of an act or constraint as the listener's own preference. Adjacent enough that a reader picking one should see the other.

downgraded from merge. The second is the general closed self-running loop where every resistance vector feeds it; the first is one narrow vehicle in which the listener's own spoken arousal words are asserted to cause the state, plus a forward-installed automatic vocalization. The specific vehicle and the mindlessness move that suppresses the disbelief reflex are not implied by the general entry, so this is a species link rather than a duplicate.

both transfer control of climax to the operator, and the second reads as a bounded case of the first's release-lock realization. It earns its own entry by gating both directions of an autonomic event rather than only the onset, so the subject retains neither starting nor stopping. Link so a reader working on release control sees the symmetric variant.

both weld denied orgasm to a required act, using unresolved arousal as the enforcement pressure. They differ in what the unlock buys: one routes relief through an act that benefits the operator in the real world, the other keys it to a specific behavior the script wants performed after waking. Same enforcement engine, different beneficiary and scope, so cross-reference rather than merge.

both manufacture felt authorship over an outcome the operator controls. The first is a specific beat order in which a genuine-feeling freedom is registered first so the ensuing instant compliance reads as wanting; the second is the broader agency-relocation family including converging branches and assigned observation tasks. Species to genus link, not a duplicate.

both load an occurring climax with a payload rather than letting it discharge, so the second sits inside the first's realization space. Kept separate because the second's payload is specifically self-deletion asserted as the locking step, with successive releases purging progressively heavier material; the discharge does the erasing rather than seating a claim. Link so a reader browsing climax payloads finds the purge form.

both refuse the return to baseline and seal the state past the ending, and the first's plain no-wake close is named among the second's realizations. They part on scope: one is a cross-artifact serial property in which the listener is forwarded still under into the next recording and the next opens below where the last ended, the other is a within-file close that negates the wakener. Link, do not merge.

both target the ending so the listener leaves without a clean return to baseline. The distinction is whether the wake event is negated or modified: one cancels or refuses the wakener so no off state exists, the other runs a wake that returns the subject only partway, redefining baseline as still aroused or still partly under. That is a real difference in what the reader would write, but close enough that anyone reaching one should see the other.

both are operator-narrated in-session compounding of an already-present response in one direction. The second adds a step the first does not require: the subject confirms the faint effect and that confirmation becomes the evidence base for the next multiplied pass, which also means it needs a non-zero seed to work. That per-pass ratification is a genuine structural addition, so link rather than merge.

both are whole-arc topology entries in which arousal accumulates with no discharge and no settling point, and both note the property survives deleting any single climax line. They separate on which structure does the work: one removes the relief path so the contour can only climb, the other makes arousal the substrate that carries depth and entangles the two exit routes so leaving requires both to fire at once. Related shapes, distinct levers, so link.

both enroll the listener into a category or subject-position by grammatical drift rather than assertion, but one moves the REFERENT of a third-person category description onto the listener, while the other moves the ADDRESS gradient I-we-you and makes the refusal to ever invite explicitly the load-bearing move.

strong overlap on the core act — binding a named external cue to a named future response that fires outside the session — but one is a large consolidated install-grammar entry carrying many authored refinements (cue-surface breadth, per-firing growth clauses, retroactive arming, install-by-assertion, deniable dual-function terms) while the other is the plain one-directional conditional with variation only in cue and payload surface. The narrower one looks absorbable, but a merge would fold a small entry into a very large one, so link them and let a dedicated pass decide absorption rather than

both relocate authorship of compliance to the listener, but the binding differs enough to keep them apart. One is the attribution move itself, applied prospectively or retrospectively to an act or to a constraint reframed as the listener's own preference. The other is specifically a post-hoc ratification bound to a staged choice-point, reversibility promise, or investment gate, where a consent-shaped surface is offered precisely where the veto cannot be exercised. The staged-choice apparatus is a real addition, not a restatement, so link rather than merge.

adjacent and worth linking, but one is a design-time observation about the arc — the closing function is refused, nothing is dismissed, negative-space evidence not attributable to any line — while the other is a citable engineered close-move in which a wake sequence is performed but every offered branch terminates in an operator-favored state. Refusing to close and staging a false close are different objects, and one entry explicitly disclaims the other's citation basis.

both hide a payload inside a consented progressive body scan, but one hands somatic agency to an externalized agent doing the relaxing, while the other leaves the scan intact and overwrites the body-image self-model through the station descriptors.

both remove the listener's clean way out of the state, and the difference is fine enough to be worth the link: one deletes the ordinary waking end-state from the reachable set entirely, the other leaves an exit that exists but is monopolized by an operator condition.

mirror-image authorship moves that share one lever, relocation of who is doing something. One makes the operator's words feel self-generated; the other takes a genuinely self-generated touch and credits it to the operator. Seeing them together makes the direction of the transfer legible.

both are heavy repetition of a short phrase, and the boundary is the whole point: one encodes the phrase's meaning as self-asserted belief, the other repeats past the satiation point until meaning evaporates and only a prosodic carrier remains. Same surface, opposite goal — worth stating so the count is read as the discriminator.

same compliance-to-reward loop shape, split by who generates the reward: operator-supplied phrasing framing each obedient act as producing the good state, versus the listener supplying the reward while the operator keeps only the framing. Useful adjacency because the second is what the first becomes when the labor is transferred out.

concealed install placed at the wake boundary versus concealed install disguised at delivery time anywhere in the runtime. The first is close to a placement variant of the second, and the aftercare-wrapper cover is worth reading against the general catalogue of covers.

both load paired out-and-in content onto a running cycle. One rides an already-established verbal rhythm to swap specific capacities; the other re-tasks the involuntary breath cycle so each phase gets an opposing install-or-delete job. Reader of either gains from seeing what carrier the substitution pairs can ride.

both run operator-absent in daily life on the listener's own signal generation, but one runs on a self-produced reward while the other runs on a self-produced aversive tripwire relieved by correction. Reading the reward and punishment poles of listener-generated enforcement together is genuinely informative.

both offload causation for a state-change onto an external non-self thing. One credits an imagined ingested or inhaled substance with pseudo-pharmacological power; the other declares a worn or encountered object the active cause of the mind-state. Reader needs the substance-versus-object line.

direct edge case: relocating authorship to the listener's own subconscious is the borderline instance of relocating authorship to the listener. One credits an internal automatic layer the listener does not feel she controls; the other credits the listener herself so there is nothing external to resist.

the chosen-versus-involuntary line runs directly between these. One trains a portable cue the subject deliberately runs to re-enter the state; the other makes a whole mental category the cue so thinking about it self-fires re-entry with no choice involved.

both engineer non-termination, and each names the other's shape as its contrast. One is a whole architecture aimed at unsupervised recurring self-execution with no close anywhere; the other weaponizes the close itself with a too-shallow token wake that biases immediate restart.

same physical act, different payload. Firing a genuinely installed cue for its effect, versus firing it specifically as a receipt that the install is real. A reader has to decide whether the demonstration or the effect is the point.

both engineer a state that cannot be satisfied. One drives a declared arousal scale past its own maximum while barring release; the other resets the standard of enough upward at the moment it would be met. Different substrates, same never-arrives structure — worth cross-reading.

both take something genuinely present and relabel it, which is the family they share. One re-credits authorship of a real self-generated touch to an external agent; the other reassigns the meaning of a sensation already in the body. Agency versus meaning is the line a reader needs.

a declarative install binds a cue to a distinct future response with separate endpoints, whereas the closed loop's response re-targets or re-summons its own cue source so the topology has no exit term.

both install a second inner party that absorbs the contest, and both make resistance structurally unwinnable. One routes the listener's own noticed resistance onto a pre-vilified losing self; the other delegates real decision-authority to an agent programmed never to lose. Relocation of affect versus delegation of authority is the line.

directly contrastive at the same seam. One asserts that installed material persists, delivered within a genuine return to baseline; the other fires a live trigger immediately after the wake specifically to contradict the just-given normal-and-awake framing. Same moment, opposite treatment of the boundary.

same self-sealing family, explicitly separated by scope. One pre-maps the entire space of possible outcomes so nothing can land as disconfirmation; the other manufactures evidence from one small performed compliance and uses it to foreclose a larger commitment. The whole-space versus single-act line is exactly what a reader needs.

the base form is an operator-asserted label accepted as descriptively true; the fused form additionally welds the label to a self-firing affect or categorical-incapacity modal so the identity maintains and defends itself without further operator input.

extinction removes the maintaining reinforcer entirely so the response decays; differential reinforcement keeps reinforcement flowing but pays something else — the target's absence, an incompatible competitor, or a same-reinforcer alternative.

a specialized case and its general form. The general one cites any obeyed act back as proof; the specialized one halts a high-arousal action specifically to show obedience was not just riding momentum. Useful for a reader picking the strength of proof they need.
both reify a faculty as an external object; the parked form leaves it intact and retrievable, while the destroy form adds a narrated irreversible destruction step as the whole point.

both deliver payload through a musical object that gets processed as entertainment rather than argument. They split on scope — an embedded song inside an otherwise ordinary script versus the whole artifact built as a replayed musical form — which is exactly the choice a reader is making.

both install a monotonic, never-back-to-baseline escalation whose gradient the operator supplies and which cannot be internally checked. One narrates the multiplier over steps of a session, the other binds the ratchet to a repeatable cue. Genuinely a choice a reader makes between them.

both relocate authorship of the payload onto the listener, but on opposite sides of a single axis: here the listener performs operator-supplied lines, there the listener genuinely supplies the content from a frame or menu. A reader deciding which to cite needs the other in view to answer 'who actually wrote the words?'

both dress the move in safety language, and the cut is what the safety surface does. In one, the protective element itself carries or licenses the payload; in the other, the listener's acceptance of an assurance stands the protective monitoring down and the influence advances through the opened gap.

both re-rig the pleasure/control relation so seeking the reward enacts surrender, but one relocates which quantity counts as the payoff cumulatively across a whole script, while the other stipulates a monotonic inverse law by paraphrase-saturation in a single closed block.

two routes to making an identity claim unrejectable by removing the external author. One hands the listener the grammatical subject so they speak the claim; the other reframes the content as always having been intrinsic so there was never anything imposed. Adjacent enough that a reader choosing one benefits from seeing the other route.

both read a performed in-session act back to the listener as evidence, but one proves the current state generally while the other rehearses the exact act a later cue will demand, so the body pre-proves that specific suggestion. A reader working on either will want the binding-time difference in front of them.

both delete the clean return to baseline, but serial chaining forwards a live trance across an artifact boundary into a next recording, while foreclosed emergence closes the reachable end-state set inside this file's own close.

two answers to the same design goal of making compliance feel self-driven, separated by whether the authorship is real. One hands over a decision or motive that changes nothing about the outcome; the other lets the listener actually supply the loaded content. Reading them together is how a user picks correctly.

the same double-coding of a count as both state-change and payload carrier, run at the two ends of the session. One rides the descent so refusing the content means refusing the deepening; the other exploits residual receptivity at the return so the listener arrives at waking already carrying it. Worth reading as a matched pair.

both engineer away any observation that could disconfirm, by different means: one closes the epistemic foothold through the shape of an argument or an unearned necessity, the other pre-maps the whole space of possible outcomes so every branch reads as confirmation. Adjacent enough that a reader should see both before choosing.

both work by producing a real state or arrangement first and naming it later, so the later claim reads as description rather than assertion. Useful cross-reference on the ordering lever; they differ in what is pre-made (a manufactured experiential referent inside trance versus a physical setup consented to while waking).

both install closed topologies with no exit term, and both convert resistance into reinforcement. The distinction is what circulates: one recites an escalating affect-and-need cycle as a formula, the other routes the response back onto its own cue source or the operator concept. Close enough to need the discriminating pointer.

both build return pressure by gating something the listener wants behind coming back. The gate differs: withheld physical release routed through re-consuming the material, versus re-access gated behind an earned audition paired with curated take-home memory. A reader picking a retention lever benefits from both.

both recruit the listener's own autobiography as the carrier, so the operator cannot be contradicted without the listener denying their own past. The split is function: one anchors a payload to a memory so unprompted recall reactivates it later, the other spends recognized memories as in-session depth fuel. Reader needs the axis.

both end on a compelled first-person claim spoken by the listener, and one uses that avowal explicitly as the seal on a multi-variable yoke. A reader who has the self-spoken ownership claim should see the yoked-variable version and vice versa, since the avowal alone does not distinguish them.

complementary negative-space arc properties: one deletes the INDUCTION boundary so there is no threshold at which entry could be refused, the other deletes the EMERGENCE ramp so suggestions are never domain-limited to the session.

both fabricate a past to make later content feel remembered rather than introduced, and both explicitly separate themselves from replacement-memory work. The split is what the fabrication produces: unresolvable uncertainty priming an always-been-there frame, versus additive rehearsal of a specific cue-response shape. Close neighbors.

both give the unverifiable depth variable a concrete spatial referent, and the axis is who moves: the listener descends through an imagined architecture, or a stimulus approaches the listener. The larger entry already treats vehicle as surface, so a reader needs to know the approach vector sits outside it.

both seize a real, locally-verifiable bodily signal and rewrite its meaning rather than conjuring a sensation, but mirroring reads the sensation as evidence of the theme with valence intact while annexation inverts the signed valence and deletes the source affect as a category.

both make the subject the source of what is being done to them, but one retroactively relabels the descent already underway as a chosen or informed act, while the other relocates the WANTING itself so the imposition reads as pre-existing preference — authorship of the choice versus authorship of the desire.

both re-price yielding against resisting, but one delivers a felt affective relief that makes surrender register as gain, while the other only advertises resistance as costly or ruinous so the option is declined without any state change being manufactured.

both treat amnesia as a depth criterion, but one PRODUCES the blank and uses the subject's failed retrieval as a convincer aimed at the subject, while the other constrains the OPERATOR — refusing to infer depth from an ambiguous sign and blocking the high-stakes act until recall is independently re-tested.

both cash an accepted cover for an uncovered payload, but the fiction form relies on the diegetic boundary so defenses calibrated for make-believe apply to the real content, while the withheld-frame form uses a benign non-fictional cover disclosed or reused late, after sunk participation forecloses renegotiation.

both quarantine resistance into a bounded site so it stops threatening the session. They differ on what the container is and who owns it: one licenses a body region to hold tension while the global relaxation claim proceeds, the other has the listener build or keep a container object, with self-authorship as the active ingredient. Adjacent enough that a writer choosing a resistance-parking move wants both.

both are wake-line moves that leave something live after the count, and they are opposites worth reading together: one smuggles a fresh, deliberately vague suggestion in under cover of aftercare and disclaimer; the other openly declares a complete restoration while carving out an already-installed cue and using remembered acceptance as the binding surface. Concealed-new versus disclosed-old is the useful contrast.

both are counterfeit exits that leave the listener believing they returned normally. One inverts the fade gradient so emerging strengthens the install and pairs it with a conscious-irrelevance clause; the other performs a structurally complete reversal and then pivots to retain residue so the leftover state feels native. Different concealment devices, same deceptive-return family.

two positions on one consent-architecture axis. One uses a false benign frame to cross the entry seam before a resistance surface forms; the other places a permission early and cheap and spends it later where it would be expensive, never re-opening the question. Entry-concealment and deferred cash-out are frequently stacked in the same piece, and each entry's boundary is stated against the other.

very close - both direct an easy act and later read it back as first-person evidence. Held apart on two real differentiators: the deferred callback (the act is harvested much later rather than confirmed on the spot) and what the act is claimed to prove (that wanting is operator-manufactured, rather than that the target state is already present). Link rather than merge until the timing gap is shown to be incidental.

both extend reach past the session by recruiting the everyday environment, and they are defined against each other: one seeds specific real-world objects and situations as re-firing anchors, the other declares the whole ambient field reinforcing with no defined cue and no defined response. A writer choosing an out-of-session persistence move needs the discrete-cue versus no-cue distinction in front of them.

both are amnesia installs, but they split on a real axis an author has to choose between: erasure as a discrete staged event performed on an externalized container, versus a block that lives in the retrieval act itself and re-runs every time recall is attempted. A reader picking an amnesia approach benefits from seeing both poles.

both harvest the listener's own stored experience rather than installing new content, and the split is worth showing: one presupposes a previously-owned trance and does zero induction work, the other reconstructs any lived state in multi-sensory detail until physiology reinstates it. Useful adjacency for anyone building on autobiographical material.

adjacent foreclosure moves with a stated boundary: one engineers a single task or success criterion whose performed outcome is then cashed as the target, the other pre-maps the entire reachable option space including inaction and over-compliance so nothing disconfirms. One constructed pivot versus exhaustive branch coverage.

both sustain the state on the listener's own production rather than operator delivery, and one of them is literally a chant mapped onto the cadence of the listener's footfall — so they overlap where a self-produced phrase and a self-produced body rhythm meet. The split is whether the maintaining engine is the meaning-bearing phrase or the bodily cadence carrying it.

sibling proof moves that both convert an operator claim into the subject's own first-person evidence. One points at a noticed internal phenomenon the subject interprets, the other stages a consensual motor incapacity and invites a failed challenge test. Choosing between them is a routine authoring decision, so they should point at each other.

both make the listener's past the carrier, split on whether that past is real. One staples the payload to a genuine autobiographical memory the operator does not control, so unprompted recall reactivates it; the other asserts a conditioning history that never occurred and has the listener supply it by imagination. Real-memory carrier versus counterfactual sourcing.

structurally the same move at different targets: both install a general claim presented as a neutral fact about how minds or trance work, accepted rather than obeyed, and cashed later by content that depends on it. One makes felt duration plastic, the other ties a capability or a lifted limit to depth. An author reaching for a licensing premise should see both.

both make rhythm the carrier that content rides on rather than a cue that fires a response. One is whole-artifact musical form with layered mantra, chorus and recital tiers built for replay; the other is continuous verbal meter or rhyme whose predicted completions pre-validate the suggestions parked in them. Related enough that a rhythmic-carrier decision touches both.

they overlap directly where a success criterion is redefined so it cannot fail: one engineers and cashes a performed outcome, the other forecloses the evidence and audit channel so no self-report can register failure. Because the tautological-success form sits in the seam, the cross-reference prevents mis-assignment.

convergent goal by different routes: both leave the subject's resistance with nothing to push against, one by explicitly disavowing that the operator does anything and pushing agency onto the subject, the other by hiding each move inside an innocuous act so no outcome can be traced to a cause. Declared absence versus concealed causation.

both are emergence-boundary moves built on an asymmetric carve-out: a wake that presents itself as complete or as merely a dream while one element is deliberately exempted and preserved. One exempts an engraved phrase from a dream frame, the other exempts an installed trigger from a full restoration of the pre-session self.

adjacent levers on the same channel: one makes the operator's voice the sole standing input with no specific propositional cargo; the other plants exact first-person sentences felt as self-generated. Useful together when a passage does both at once.

inverse directions on the same self/operator authorship boundary: one plants content so it feels self-generated, the other reassigns credit for the subject's own states to the operator. Worth pairing when a passage disclaims operator authorship while also claiming causal reach.

both are closure topologies rather than pushes on any one dimension, but one enumerates the listener's reachable actions and states and finds no exit while the other locks the reachable joint affective states so no feeling can disconfirm.

both hand the subject a post-session means of re-entering the state, but one installs a portable cue the subject deliberately fires at will while the other installs a dissociated part that self-re-induces on a specific real-world event.

both manufacture acceptance from the subject's own output, but one reads back what the subject actually supplies in the present tense while the other pre-rigs the frame so even feeling nothing or failing counts as confirmation.

both make a repeated cycle the conditioning unit with cumulative carryover rather than a reset, differing in the cycled variable: a whole narrative scene run again with a degraded start, versus an arousal trough that denies release without dropping baseline. Useful together when judging whether a repetition is a drill or a ratchet.

two opposed scene-close reframes over the same fantasy-versus-waking boundary: filing the session as a dream while exempting the retained mantra, versus levelling the two planes and reassigning waking life as the service realm. Read together when classifying how a close handles the reality boundary.

the second is a specific relational instance of the first's general principle: a person becomes the discriminative stimulus through a history of reliably mediating a want. A reader working the interpersonal case gains from the general reinforcement-history account, and the general entry gains a concrete inter-agent realization it does not otherwise cover.

both re-credit something the listener generated to the operator, but one moves the reward source (whose pleasure counts) and the other moves sensory authorship (whose hand is touching). Related enough to be confused in erotic material where they frequently co-occur, and the source-versus-authorship distinction is the useful thing to carry across.

complementary boundary deletions at opposite ends of the artifact: one deletes the emergence so trance is carried forward, the other deletes the induction so entry is never marked. Same design logic (remove the threshold at which a listener could refuse) applied to different edges, and the serial forms of each depend on the other.

both weaponize the close by denying a genuine recovery window, differing in how: one plants a self-firing line inside the outro that outruns a nominal release clause, the other offers a too-shallow token wake that makes re-listening the path of least resistance. A reader auditing a script's ending needs both patterns in hand.
transient inability demonstrated by an invited challenge-test to prove depth, versus a durable re-routing of the action set through operator permission that enforces behavior after the session.
in the alter install the listener inhabits the manufactured second self and enacts through it; in the proxy install the agent holds authority AGAINST the listener and cannot be reclaimed.

direct complements in the same memory-manufacture family and each discriminator's logic depends on the contrast: one fabricates a positive recollection and frames it as retrieval, the other fabricates only the absence, creating uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader distinguishing manufactured content from manufactured gaps needs both.

the canonical pairing for out-of-session behavior: an unconditionally assigned waking action versus a conditional if-situation-then-response install. Both discriminators already turn on this exact split, and misfiling between them is the most likely error a reader makes, so the link is load-bearing.

both keep arousal from discharging, and the discriminating question is sharp and useful: whether there is a met-able key that would release it. One holds release behind a compliance condition, the other severs the relief path entirely so the arc can only accumulate. Adjacent enough that a writer will need to pick, so the link earns its place.

both convert a suggested bodily event into proof, but the gate differs: one reads a felt-automatic movement back as evidence of responsiveness, the other stipulates that accepting a relational concession mechanically produces a two-vector body-shift, so the sensation evidences the belief. Useful as a contrast pair on what the somatic proof is proving.

both deliver a payload the listener never evaluates as addressed to them. One rides the surface form of a single utterance; the other stages a whole-artifact relational topology so a foreground relation absorbs the heavy claims. Scope is the discriminator: one utterance versus one architecture, and the second already names the contrast.

both manufacture a shortfall the listener owns, then trade on it. One installs a deficit up front and sells the payload as remedy; the other renders an insufficiency verdict at the moment of likely success on a standard that cannot be satisfied. Reading both clarifies whether the shortfall is a diagnosis or a moving standard.

both make forgetting operable by a token rather than an ambient suggestion. One compresses amnesia into a portable waking handle that erases arbitrary named content; the other trains a tonal mark as a binary switch that opens or closes already-sealed material. The fork is whether the token installs forgetting or operates an existing seal.

both stage authority over a high-arousal bodily event, and each already gestures at the other. One commands a voluntary halt to isolate obedience from arousal momentum; the other transfers both onset and cessation of an autonomic event to command. Useful for separating proof-of-obedience from authority transfer.

both engineer an outcome the listener cannot control and then cash the verdict, in opposite directions: one rebrands a real failure or tautological success as the target achieved, the other invalidates a felt success to keep demand climbing. The shared rigged-criterion lever makes the contrast instructive.

fixation narrows attention onto any operator-chosen focus that need not be the operator at all, whereas voice-absorption makes the speech itself the field that fills and replaces mental space — the tell is whether removing the voice as the target leaves the technique intact.

declarative installation binds one specified cue to one future response, while the multi-modal form takes an existing pair and widens its cue surface across sensory or representational channels so the same response fires from hearing, reading, thinking, or touch.

closer than the general fabricated-past link: both set the present depth floor from material the listener supplies about their own past, and both make denying depth require denying one's own history. They diverge on veridicality, one asserts sessions that never occurred, the other recruits genuine prior absorptive experiences, which is the fork a reader needs.

both weld extra payload onto a recurring carrier the listener is already trained to accept, so refusing the payload costs the carrier. Worth traversing because the counted form and the pulse form shade into each other and a writer picking one should see the parametric boundary.

both rig the scoring so the subject cannot read their own performance honestly, but one scores every outcome as success to close the failure exit while the other scores every outcome as shortfall to keep demand climbing — opposite verdicts on the same rigged meter.

both hand the listener a loop that re-arms between sessions with no operator present and no natural point of drift. One renews through a compulsion to re-administer the material, the other through two cues that each summon craving for the other — near neighbours on the same operator-absent topology.

both make the present state unarguable by locating its basis in the past, but one presupposes the target as an already-settled fact by grammar and tense, while the other stipulates specific prior sessions that never occurred and has the listener imagine them into existence.

genuine boundary case: both leave the listener responding outside the session without an operator. The split is whether the listener deliberately runs a portable cue to re-access a state, or an ordinary named occasion fires a programmed response pre-attentively. Worth sending a reader across to check which side a candidate falls on.

both partition the listener, but the payload differs: one assigns the evaluating faculty an ignore-task so objections are out of scope, the other preserves awareness precisely so the felt loss of volition is convincing. Useful contrast because the partition surface looks identical in text.

both bind relief to compliance. The distinction is whether affect is loaded onto a cue's presence and absence, or a distress is manufactured and its exit monopolized by the same source. The second already carries this separation explicitly, so the link is reciprocal and load-bearing.

both end with the listener treating operator content as self-authored, by different routes: a standing rule over the whole future suggestion stream, versus the listener actively voicing supplied lines so authorship is self-attributed by the act. Easy to conflate in practice; the link marks the split.

adjacent and genuinely confusable: a sustained third-person frame whose payoff is the eventual collapse to direct address, versus the unmarked pointer-swap itself treated as the payload. A reader deciding between them needs both, since the first contains an instance of the second at its climax.

both hide acceptance work inside a carrier, but the defeat differs: locating and reassembling scattered payload versus pre-validating content by pattern prediction. The second already distinguishes itself from carrier siblings generally, so the link sharpens an explicitly drawn boundary.
arousal stamping uses the arousal as the vehicle that makes adjacent content land as true; the obedience readout takes up no new content at all, it only relabels what an already-present signal means.

both restructure how reward relates to compliance. One stipulates a monotonic inverse law between retained control and pleasure; the other remaps which content is permitted to occupy the reward channel at all. Related enough that a writer picking a reward-structure move should see both, distinct in whether a law is asserted or a field is rewritten.

both manufacture confirmation that cannot be audited from inside, through different channels: staged external events that several senses independently corroborate, versus the listener's own introspective check pre-loaded so every outcome confirms. The contrast between external staging and rigged self-check is the useful takeaway.

both work on how the listener will later account for the session, from different frame positions: a public attributable act performed under a maintained eyes-open overlay, versus a claim delivered after full emergence aimed at retrospective self-interpretation. The frame position is the discriminating variable and the link makes it visible.

both defeat the listener's ability to verify depth. One stacks declared layers so there is always a guaranteed level below; the other has the listener grant depth to an imagined figure and then swaps the protagonist so that depth is inherited. Different routes to the same unverifiability, worth cross-reading.

both sustain state through rhythm, split by who supplies it: the listener's own body cadence, which makes the effect portable and operator-independent, versus operator-delivered continuous verbal form whose predicted completions pre-validate content. The first explicitly contrasts itself against operator-delivered carriers, so the link is reciprocal.

both make a climax structural rather than a payoff, with different payloads: the discharge asserted to expel prior self-content and seal permanence, versus the climax welded redundantly to a re-invokable sensory anchor so it can be fired again. Same moment, different work done with it.

both generalize past a single install to a standing rule, but the meta-rule blanks the SOURCE of suggestions by reattributing content to the listener, while the blank-occupant slot blanks the AUTHORITY figure so obedience attaches to any future voice.

the two main retention levers for chaining a listener into a series, already contrasted in both entries: never emerging and being forwarded still under, versus emerging and returning of compelled volition. Anyone classifying a retention move must pick between them, so the link does real work.

both use a symbolic container to partition contents away from the waking self, but the amnesia container is operator-commanded with asymmetric recall and a deliberately leaked craving, while the listener-kept container derives its force from the listener authoring or holding the key.

both hand causal authority to a thing rather than the operator, but by different routes: one declares an already-present object the active cause of the mind-state, the other walks abstract words up an incremental gradient until they are claimed to have condensed into a solid device. The gradient is the lever in the second and absent from the first, so they stay separate — but a writer building object-attributed control will want both.

both run clench-and-release physiology, but one is an induction manufacturing a state from scratch via a tension spike and autonomic rebound, while the other is a deepening/compliance drill that reframes voluntary strain as depth and banks a run of obeyed micro-commands. Same bodily raw material, different job in the script — useful adjacency, not the same entry.

both fire at the emergence boundary and both assert something about what survives the session, but one targets the listener's retrospective self-interpretation after full waking and outside the frame, while the other asserts persistence of installed content within a genuine return to baseline. The timing distinction is fine enough that cross-reference helps.

the suggestion form is a declared forget delivered verbally against a bounded referent; the container form routes erasure through a destructible external object the listener fills, splitting agency so forgetting becomes a discrete felt event.

both aim past the current session, and both can be dressed in a replay urge, but the installed object differs: general receptivity to whatever the operator delivers next, versus a self-administered loop the listener runs and reinforces alone. The overlapping replay-craving machinery makes them easy to confuse, so the link should exist with the split stated.

both remove the ground a refusal would stand on rather than asserting a new label, one by stripping the self of all properties, the other by capturing the first-person symbol handle itself. Adjacent operations on the same self-model apparatus, frequently co-occurring, but distinct targets — properties versus the grammatical seat.

both install something that keeps working between sessions and drives return, but one holds a live affective residue continuously all day as compounding glue, while the other lies dormant and fires only when an emotion inconsistent with the programming appears. Continuous drive versus failure-triggered self-repair is the axis a reader needs.

both compound belief across repetitions, and the multiplier language is nearly identical, but the time horizon splits them: an expectancy that effect accrues across future sessions and replays, versus an in-session loop that harvests the subject's own just-given confirmation and multiplies it on a fresh act. Near-identical vocabulary makes the cross-reference necessary.

both manage what the listener may conclude after waking, using a deniability clause. One delegates the wake to an in-fiction character and files the session as a dream while exempting the mantra; the other reverses the fade gradient so emerging strengthens the install. Useful side-by-side when choosing an emergence frame.

two erasure vehicles that frequently co-occur in one script: one destroys an externalized container the listener packaged; the other stages an ordered ladder of removals escalating in identity load. A ladder can run with or without a container, so both entries are needed when composing erasure.

both keep the install alive past the ending, one as a whole-arc refusal to perform the closing function, the other by preclosing specific named objections and exit routes. Complementary rather than overlapping: global omission versus targeted route foreclosure.

both operate on the wake boundary to legitimize an install. One speaks to the fully awake listener about how to interpret the session; the other interrupts emergence to demonstrate a trigger firing across the boundary. Assertion versus demonstration is the useful contrast.

both relocate agency onto the listener so resistance has no target. One relabels a compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will or preference; the other denies the operator applies any force at all. Act-level attribution versus operator self-disavowal.

both build self-sustaining loops. One recites a closed causal cycle as an explicit no-ceiling formula; the other interlocks self-detection, self-reward and self-punishment across a whole script into an operator-free control system. A stated loop versus an architectural one.

both attack the self-model rather than asserting a label over it. One removes or captures the first-person symbol handle so there is no seat from which to refuse; the other deletes the baseline by relocating the identity's origin into an erased past. Handle surgery versus timeline deletion.

both engineer durable post-session persistence. One layers heterogeneous anchors so each backstops another's failure; the other fires a re-listen loop only when an emotion inconsistent with the programming appears. Redundancy versus failure-keyed self-repair, both aimed at surviving decay.

both gate a wanted release behind a key the listener cannot turn, but one relocates the key to the operator's own command/interlock while the other relocates it to an out-of-session reciprocal peer-vote economy with no hypnotic mechanism running at unlock time.

both convert a session into recurring re-consumption, but one withholds a physical discharge whose only sanctioned unlock is returning to the operator's material, while the other installs replay itself as the appetite with no release valve involved.

both externalize a private trajectory variable onto an operator-turned quantized dial, but one stops at the ownership transfer of depth/arousal while the other adds a ceiling that flips the climbed state into a mandated behavioral act pre-immunized against refusal.

two fixation moves that a practitioner will confuse in the wild, and they resolve each other cleanly: one manufactures a real physiological event and reframes it as suggestion success, the other credits the object itself with causing the attention or the trance. Both define themselves against inert fixation, so reading either benefits from seeing the other.

both close the falsification branch, but one is a bounded convincer where every introspective result scores as proof of state, while the other closes the entire reachable behavioral option space including inaction and over-compliance to one attractor.

both relocate authorship of the listener's state outside the self, and the pair marks the useful axis between them: one uses deliberately vague testimony about an unnamed agent so nothing is specific enough to scrutinize, the other names a concrete object as the active cause and hands the listener a portable external switch. Reading one clarifies the diffuse-versus-concrete choice in the other.

both read the listener's own output back as proof, but one takes an actively supplied present-moment response (a report, a sensation, a signal), while the other infers state from mere inertia — continuing to listen, sitting in silence — where no response is required at all.

both are closed topologies with no exit node, but one is a recited in-session causal formula that escalates affect and need with no stated ceiling, while the other wires the waking protocol's own predicted failures — relapse, defection, premature listening — back into re-entry.

both relocate where experience comes from. One re-credits the authorship of a real self-generated touch to an external agent; the other replaces the body itself as the sensory source, routing sensation inbound from external depicted bodies. Useful neighbors on the felt-agency axis.

both modify the emergence gate rather than delivering a standard counted return, but toward opposite ends: one hands emergence timing to the subject with no payload, the other deliberately refuses clean baseline to sustain an installed state. Contrastive pairing on the same structural slot.

both make yielding cost nothing, by different routes: one re-prices the surrendered state as relief the listener wants, the other reassigns agency so the change is never something the listener did. Complementary framing layers that frequently co-occur over the same drop.

mirror images on the same rigged-metric axis: one scores every outcome as sufficient depth so failure is impossible, the other revokes sufficiency at the moment of success so completion is impossible. Both close the same exit from opposite sides.

both defeat evaluation by concealment, but at different layers: one hides a payload inside a separately-processed carrier stream, the other routes it on the surface form of a single utterance. Same selection question (where is the payload hidden), so a reader benefits from seeing the layer distinction.

disavowal hides or denies that an operation is running so there is nothing to refuse, whereas disclosure-as-inoculation openly names the operation precisely so that later recognition of it is pre-coded as further capture.

both are interleave-based concealment, distinguished by stream count: payload fragments scattered through one carrier whose density is the cover, versus two or more streams interleaved below the sentence boundary so no stream can be isolated. Genuine selection fork.

release gating withholds the reward behind a met-able compliance key so mounting drive enforces the condition, while direct pleasure linkage delivers the reward live and welds it to a named act or stimulus so compliance pays out immediately.

same ownership-identity payload delivered from opposite ends: asserted by the operator as a fact about who the listener now is, versus voiced by the listener so authorship is self-attributed. The choice turns on who speaks the claim.

both stage an in-session phenomenon the subject notices, but one frames the noticing as proof depth is real while the other builds a demonstrably-owned voluntary behavior specifically so it can be repossessed as operator-controlled. Proof versus theft is a real fork a reader can miss.

both remove the escape channel between opposed states, but one is a climbing mutual-amplification loop over real felt variables while the other fuses two antagonistic responses onto a single installed cue. Loop versus trigger is the discriminating question.

both are whole-arc ordering relationships with no declarative moment, and the pre-slotted-identity form of one looks close to the role-accretion form of the other. The cut is whether the arc builds a frame by drift or manufactures a referent and then names it, which is exactly why the reader needs the pointer.

both engineer the wake phase rather than the install, one preserving a trigger through an otherwise complete-sounding restoration, the other inverting the alert trigger into a deprivation event that manufactures craving. Anyone working the exit beat needs both.

contrastive pair a writer actively chooses between: depth set by an operator-supplied signal the listener accepts, versus depth powered by the listener's own freshly built appetite so the drop reads as self-caused. The second already defines itself against a plain counted or commanded deepener.

both make the listener's own body supply the reinforcer rather than the operator, but service-as-self-pleasure rewires whose body feels a sensation while the self-administered loop leaves sensation where it is and merely reattributes authorship of the reward to the operator.

adjacent escalation shapes that are easy to confuse and worth reading together. One multiplies an already-present response in one direction within a session; the other reframes repeatable, resettable cycles as permanent one-way loss that never returns to baseline. Both discriminators already reference the other's boundary.

two concealment vehicles at different scales, and the discriminators already gesture at each other. One uses a predictable repeating frame so novel payloads land in the unwatched slot; the other uses the advertised surface purpose of the whole piece as the carrier, with the late arrival of explicit payload language as the tell. Reading both clarifies which scale a given case sits at.

nested pair with a sharp line between them. One elicits any obeyed act purely so it can be cited back as evidence of control; the other rehearses the exact act a later suggestion will demand, so the body pre-proves that specific suggestion. Anyone reaching for the general proof beat should know the targeted-rehearsal variant exists.

two ways of ensuring push-back is never exercised, and the discriminators cross-reference each other's boundary. One defines the mental category where refusal would form out of existence; the other leaves the category intact and simply prices resisting as exhausting or ruinous so the listener declines. Useful together for classifying a passage that does a bit of both.

complementary treatments of the same discharge moment, and they compose in one piece. One severs the relief path entirely so the arc can only accumulate; the other lets the discharge happen but assigns it the job of expelling prior self-content and sealing the install. A reader examining what a script does with climax should see both options.

both make a label self-defending, but affect-fusion welds the label to a self-firing reward or aversion, while behavioral backfill derives the label from an observable compelled behavior so refusing it means denying a fact.

both extend the install past session-end without the operator, but one fires on ambient real-world stimuli seeded in advance while the other fires only on the internal failure state — an emotion inconsistent with the programming — making it silent during compliance and self-repairing on drift.

both disable a defensive channel rather than push content: one hides that an operation is running, the other makes no observation able to disconfirm it. They compose in practice and a reader picking a concealment strategy should see both, but the targets differ (the act's existence versus the evidence channel).

both close the disavowal exit by making the listener the author, but retrospective attribution relocates the want into an asserted past history, while the ledger cites the listener's genuine just-performed acts as contemporaneous evidence of the state.

both make the subject their own enforcer, but one is a bounded in-session forfeiture contract during an undisclosed operator silence, while the other is a whole-script end-state where self-detection, self-reward and self-punishment interlock into a permanently operator-free loop.

both manufacture confirmation from the subject's own output, but self-validating language opportunistically reads back whatever the subject happens to supply, while the stacked-deck architecture engineers in advance the specific sensation each later claim will cite as proof.

same surface operation, opposite goal: repetition to encode one payload versus repetition to bleach a token's meaning. The first's discriminator already names the second as the inverse-goal sibling. This is the canonical case where a boundary note is mandatory and a merge would be wrong.

both make a produced memory-experience function as present fact, and a writer will confuse them. The split is provenance: one fabricates material wholesale and frames it as recovery, the other reconstructs the subject's own genuine autobiographical episode until its state re-instates. Harvest vs. manufacture.

same delivery form, different cargo: a count the listener accepts rather than derives. One asserts somatic depth; the other counts down the faculty that tags suggestions as fictional, pre-licensing later hallucination as real. A writer picking a countdown needs both.

neighboring answers to who produces the first-person content. One has the listener actively repeat a chosen phrase so the claim is self-attested; the other plants specific sentences to feel spontaneously arisen with no recitation drill. Produced vs. planted is the boundary.

two whole-script state-space topologies that a writer must choose between. One requires exit back to baseline and biases drift across repeated cycles; the other welds state variables so no single-variable exit exists at all. Re-runnable switching vs. reachability closure.

same lever, different cover: a benign-seeming, non-trance surface that the listener consumes with the analytical mind awake, carrying an install that passes unchallenged. One uses a didactic explanatory passage, the other a caring safety and aftercare surface. Pick by which cover fits the moment.

both stage a noticed phenomenon as proof, and the second is explicitly a special case: the demonstration operates on the subject's memory of the session and its point is the reveal-and-restore, transferring trust in operator control rather than confirming depth.

opposite solutions to the same problem of where resistance is aimed. One dissolves the authority surface so there is no figure to confront; the other installs a persistent agent that holds real decision-authority and carries the contest. Each discriminator already leans on the other, so the link is earned.

grammatical-person opposites that already cite each other as contrast cases: one puts the listener in the speaker seat, the other makes the listener the described third party. Useful as a paired decision, since both remove the operator-addresses-you frame by opposite routes.

both route an identity claim through the listener rather than the operator, but one requires an enacted failure as evidence and the other requires only spoken authorship of the claim. The boundary is worth showing: enacted proof versus ownership handoff.

both are operator-side conditional rules that branch or block the plan before anything is done to the subject, with no subject-facing surface. One is a general precondition-branch family, the other a specific hold on altering a load-bearing belief until consequences are foreseeable; the specific case reads as an instance of the general gate and readers should see the relation.

two deepeners that both remove the need for the operator to deliver each increment, one by recruiting the subject's built appetite as the motive force and the other by installing a self-running loop. A writer wanting operator-absent descent will be choosing between exactly these, so the cross-reference earns its place.

both convert an installed trigger from claim into felt fact, but one is a single-shot demonstration used as a receipt and the other is massed repeated fire-and-reward. Readers routinely conflate the one-cycle proof with the drilling loop, so the pointer does real disambiguating work.

both convert denied release into fuel, but one removes the terminating move by driving past a declared ceiling while the other breaks an announced release contract and trains distrust of the count. Adjacent enough that a writer choosing a denial engine wants both, distinct enough not to merge.

two amnesias distinguished by what is scoped out: everything after a declared anchor versus the installation event itself. Both leave a payload operative while removing something from audit, and the pair is the standard confusion point in the amnesia family.

both are whole-script architectures aimed at surviving past the recording, and they compose: a two-state machine with a drift bias supplies the re-entry gate that a self-perpetuating harness needs, while the harness supplies the out-of-session firing the state machine assumes. A writer designing either will want the other's checklist.

both are whole-artifact relationships rather than single passages, and they are commonly layered: an advertised benign frame carries the payload while ordering makes the costly parts land. The second entry already distinguishes itself as concealment rather than contour, which is exactly the comparison a reader needs.
direct structural opposition: the clean operator-paced return to baseline versus a whole-arc design that deliberately omits any return ramp. A reader deciding how a piece ends needs both.

agency inversion over the same threshold moment: one keeps authorship of the letting-go with the subject as a performed release, the other frames the change as something that happens to her with no author at all.
two carrier choices worth comparing: sustaining the state on the listener's own body rhythm, versus loading multiple simultaneous payloads onto one operator-delivered recurring pulse.

complementary halves of conditioning work: one specifies arousal as the conditioned output of a declared cue, the other is the massed in-session fire-and-reward cycling that makes such a cue felt rather than merely claimed.

old-self discreditation disavows who the listener WAS so the return path closes; retrospective desire attribution asserts the listener always WANTED this so refusal reads as self-betrayal — one repudiates the prior self, the other recruits it as witness.

container and named member: the operator-free self-detecting, self-rewarding, self-punishing closure is one specific whole-arc architecture worth pulling out of the looser grouping of arc-shape observations.

both recruit the listener's own appetitive or physiological process as the descent engine; the split is a discrete consummation or pursuit event versus arousal treated as a continuous depth substrate.

fixation installs a NEW narrowing onto an operator-chosen focus assuming cooperation; adverse-state recruitment installs nothing and instead relabels whatever attentional posture the listener already fails in — drift or strain — as the vehicle.

single-move and whole-document versions of the same relocation: reattributing inner speech to the listener at a passage level, versus a monotonic one-way collapse of voice ownership tracked across an entire piece and never reversed.

both remove the external addressee the guard pushes against, and the boundary between them is fine enough to need cross-referencing: total absence of an operator voice throughout the artifact versus an operator who is present but re-attributes authorship of inner speech to the listener. The second entry already treats the first as its boundary case.

identity-labeling asserts or paces a label as already-true; identity-from-coerced-behavior derives the label from an observable compelled behavior plus a morphological trigger weld, so denying it means denying a visible fact.

the second is the gate-key parameter pushed entirely outside the session: release withheld behind a met-able condition, where the condition is a reciprocal peer-vote economy rather than a task, a permission, a belief, or a depth price. Useful as the boundary case showing where the gating family stops being a hypnotic mechanism at all.

both weld something to a descending count, and the discriminator is exactly the thing a reader has to decide: many discrete payload claims attached per number, versus one continuous second state-variable ratcheting on the same axis. Each entry names the other; keep the link.

adjacent memory-architecture constructs with a real cut: a commanded reversible partition with asymmetric access plus a deliberately leaked motivating residue, versus a deposit-only custodian with a retrieval promise the script never honors. The presence or absence of the leaked residue and the reversibility is what a reader must check.

both delegate authority away from the listener, and the recipient is the whole question: the operator taking over cognition as felt relief, versus an installed autonomous agent that holds authority against the listener and cannot be reclaimed. Each entry already treats the other as the boundary it must not be confused with.

both run on the same folk two-minds premise and are separated by what is done with the split: one reassigns authorship of behavior to the listener's own internal layer so ownership resistance never engages, the other assigns the critical faculty an ignore-task so any objection is pre-classified as the wrong audience. A reader meeting a subconscious-addressing script needs the pair.

body substitution rewrites the body's material part-by-part as a commitment ratchet; ontological reversal leaves the material alone and instead declares the imagined body the real one, relocating sensory authority and disabling reality-testing.

both are closed self-amplifying circuits and the tell separating them is worth the link: one loops inside the session, where the listener's own utterances re-cause the state, while the other loops across sessions, where the only relief route for a raised waking baseline is more of the same material. Same topology, different span.

sequential in practice and mutually defining: the second presupposes a built identity-reward of exactly the kind the first installs, then fences it with a self-scanning deviation detector that runs in daily life. A reader tracing how a rewarding label becomes self-enforcing needs both entries.

both operate at the wake boundary and both leave programming live past apparent session-end. One asserts persistence openly inside a genuine return to baseline; the other hides a self-firing line in the outro that outruns a nominal release clause. Adjacent enough to be mistaken for each other.

both are whole-script topologies that make the script self-sufficient, but one manufactures a distress the operator then sells the cure for, while the other closes an evidentiary circuit in which each induced state corroborates the next claim.

both make an installed want read as self-authored. One relocates its authorship into the listener's past; the other strips the obligation channel so the craving looks freely held. Complementary routes to the same disavowal-proofing.

both keep the listener bodily active while framed as still under, and both convert that activity into proof. One turns the motion itself into the depth convincer; the other routes it into an attributable public act that ratifies the session afterward. Same eyes-open overlay, different cash-out.

both relabel a physiological signal the listener is already producing rather than conditioning anything new — one reads it back as obedience, the other as trance depth. Same re-attribution lever, different readout; worth seeing side by side when choosing what the body signal should mean.

both make the listener supply the evidence so the operator cannot be wrong. One points at an in-session phenomenon and names it proof; the other recruits the listener's own recalled absorptive history as depth fuel. Denying either requires denying one's own experience.

both are cross-session force multipliers rather than content installs, but one rewrites the success metric so replay is licensed and no attempt can fail, while the other conditions general responsiveness so the NEXT file lands faster.

both are conditioning loops, but A's loop spans sessions and inverts the cure into the disease (the relief route escalates the condition), while B's loop is a within-session cue-response-reward drill the operator both fires and rewards. A reader designing or auditing a loop benefits from seeing the in-session drill next to the cross-session dependency form.

complementary halves of the same attention narrowing: A subtracts competing external input, B supplies a constructed scene that absorbs attention with dissociation as a byproduct. Scripts routinely run them on the same beat, and the discriminator turns on whether the fade or the scene is doing the work, so a reader of either should see the other.

both use a descent count as the depth vehicle, and they compose: A welds a distinct non-depth payload to each number, B gives the depth variable a concrete spatial referent. B's discriminator already names the payload-carrying armature as a neighboring technique, so the link is mutual and useful when classifying a counted descent.

deprivation manufactures a want by removing a delivered state or swapping in an unsatisfiable object; reward-channel rerouting remaps which content may occupy the reward channel at all. The monopolization and sole-supply forms of the latter sit close to the uncloseable-object variant of the former, so the boundary is worth flagging. Distinct levers: felt deficit versus comparator rewrite.

both bind to internal material the listener cannot disown, and the pair turns on provenance: operator-authored content laundered as the listener's own imagery versus a genuinely listener-owned memory the operator does not control. That contrast is the useful discrimination for anyone reaching for either.

both are whole-artifact multi-track delivery architectures where concealment is structural rather than a discrete move. The boundary is whether the payload rides a staged foreground relation the listener identifies with, or an interleave below the sentence or line boundary that prevents isolating any one stream. Close enough to confuse, distinct enough to keep apart.

both are architectures over a set of triggers rather than single installs, and the difference is topology: separately addressable handles that stay individuated versus a mutually cross-wired web where any node fires all others. That is exactly the choice a reader faces when designing a multi-trigger surface.

both convert effort into depth via a repeating load-then-release cycle, differing in whether the load is cognitive and strictly inside trance or physical strain doubling as an obedience drill. A reader reaching for effort-as-deepening should see both forms before picking.

both recruit a real bodily event to carry an abstract claim past evaluation. The split is function: in one the body reading that would say stop is redefined so it can only confirm, in the other a genuine physical event licenses a separate cognitive edit as its channel. Close neighbors that need the distinction stated.

both take a conscious-versus-deep partition and put it to structural work — one invents the anatomy to license bypass and pre-route objections, the other uses the partition as an epistemic shield so self-report cannot falsify the install. Adjacent uses of the same partition device, distinguished by whether the payload is bypass licensing or unfalsifiability.

the staged-erosion entry's discriminator explicitly separates itself from time distortion by making time the last of three sequenced anchors, so a classifier seeing time-unrecoverability language will hover between them. The pointer resolves whether the warp is the payload or one stage in an ordered dismantling.

the garment entry prices exit at the identity level too, but binds the identity to a physical worn state with a deliberately costly named escape. That is close enough to the exit-tax structure that the boundary needs stating: a persistent physical cue with hysteresis versus a general cost-on-leaving contingency.

both discriminators already cite each other by name as the primary confusion: pairing that transfers reinforcing function delivered as a consequence versus pairing that elicits an involuntary response or valence. Contiguous pairing is the shared surface and the operant/respondent split is the line, so the pointer is exactly what a classifier needs.

both manufacture felt volition without accumulated agreement, and both explicitly separate themselves from the same neighbors. One rigs a live choice so all branches execute the compliance; the other reinterprets an already-performed trivial act as proof of a larger submission. Useful adjacency when picking between prospective and retrospective volition manufacture.

both restructure the reward field rather than adding a single pleasure link: one installs a negative pole so relief runs through compliance, the other deletes or dwarfs competing sources so only sanctioned content can register as rewarding. Adjacent options when the goal is monopoly over reward, and each names the other's territory as out of scope.

both load many functions onto one recurring element so opting out of any one costs the others; one uses a repeated pulse carrying simultaneous payloads, the other a single lexical token doing topic, content, trigger and delivery duty at once. Same overload lever on different carriers, and the pairing clarifies which carrier a given script is using.

both place something of the listener into an external container, and the distinction is who holds it and what is stored: identity or state relocated into an operator-addressable object, versus a container the listener builds or keeps to bracket anxiety or resistance. Directly comparable and easy to misfile without the pairing.

both install multiple anchors rather than one cue-response pair, and the difference is the design intent: separately addressable handles for independent control versus heterogeneous anchors backstopping each other's failure modes. Anyone reading a multi-anchor install needs to distinguish control surface from redundancy.

both convert bodily events into proof, and the boundary is whether the movement is elicited or already occurring: one prompts a felt-automatic motion and reads it back, the other names autonomic activity in progress and presupposes the induction caused it. The second already names the first as its nearest contrast.

context-lock-staging gates the payload on a logistical listening condition with no protective rhetoric at all; weaponized-safety-framing requires an ostensibly protective surface that itself delivers, licenses, or fake-bounds the payload.

direct contrast on the same axis: one fabricates or forecloses the consent act outright, the other genuinely obtains consent but relocates it upstream of the moment deliberation is stripped. The distinction is whether the listener could still deliberate when they agreed, and a reader adjudicating a banked agreement needs both.

explicit boundary pair: an up-swing toward waking followed by a re-drop is a deepening engine, while a graded return that actually arrives at baseline and stays there is a clean exit. Same surface gesture, opposite function, and the entries already define themselves against each other.

contrast the entries already draw: one fuses the self-model into a single supplied figure whose predicates become first-person, the other relocates the source of sensation to arbitrary external footage so which body counts as self is variable. Both feel like becoming someone else; the tell is fixed authored identity versus substituted sensory source.

the two temporal directions of the same memory-boundary logic: one wraps an already-delivered install in amnesia so the cue still fires with no traceable source, the other declares everything after a stated anchor un-encodable so later material lands with the critical filter framed as offline. Direction is the whole distinction, so the pointer earns its place.

one is the whole-arc observation that the closing function is deliberately refused; the other is a concrete outro move where a disguised self-firing line is planted and a nominal release clause fails to neutralize it. The second reads as a passage-local realization of the first's load-bearing-ending tell, so a reader arriving at either wants the other.

both remove the listener from the addressee position so resistance has no target.
