Both discriminators already gesture at each other, and confusing them is a live risk, so a mutual pointer earns its place.

genuinely confusable: both involve more than one perceptual channel. The bridge uses a shared feature as a carry-over rail to bring a channel online during state-building; the multi-channel trigger widens the cue surface so one conditioned response fires from many channels. Cross-referencing prevents miscoding a channel-widening install as a state-building bridge.

both ride an established repeating cadence as cover for varying payload, but the repeating-frame carrier hides novelty in the varying slot of an expectation-setting frame, while replacement-pair substitution uses paired out/in lines so a substitute occupies the attention that would register the removed capacity.

real confusion risk: both produce a response that fires without operator presence and both target the subject's own cognition. The distinction is whether the cue is a structural cognitive event or the absence of commands, and whether what is installed is a discrete routine or a replacement baseline.

permanence claims assert that installed content will endure past the session; self-sealing pre-maps every observable outcome to confirmation so the did-this-work check has no disconfirming branch — a duration claim versus a rigged evidence channel.

both act on a nameable objection before it can do its work, and both leave the objection formally acknowledged. One supplies a defusing reading so the objection never forms; the other grants the objecting part a scheduled, honored turn. Genuine selection question for a reader.

both construct binary option sets the listener cannot answer wrongly, but the payoff differs: one pre-loads every branch so any pick ratifies the frame, the other over-covers every axis with resolvable pairs to harvest low-stakes commitment to imagery. A writer choosing between a no-lose bind and a compliance probe benefits from seeing the contrast, and the no-fail-license realization sits close enough to warrant the pointer.

directly complementary: one maintains a response by relief from an aversive condition, the other neutralizes or dissolves that same aversive antecedent so there is nothing left to escape. Reading the escape contingency without knowing the upstream edit that abolishes it leaves the practitioner with only the consequence-side half of the pair.

both build operator standing, but by different routes: claiming perceptual access to the interior versus capturing attribution for effects that occur. Each discriminator already names authority-adjacent neighbours, and a reader deciding how an operator's credibility was manufactured needs both options on the table.

deficit-driven pair: one fabricates a shortcoming and sells the payload as its remedy, the other grants a success then revokes its sufficiency so no stable done-state exists. The second is effectively the repeating form of the first, and a writer needs to know whether the deficit is installed once or refreshed each cycle.

explicitly cross-referenced in both directions already: one engineers how much a consequence is worth without delivering anything, the other teaches the asking repertoire that rides on that value. A practitioner building a request-making repertoire needs the value-side move, and vice versa.

one is the baseline cue-to-response install with its enumerated variants; the other loads several distinct effects onto a single freshly-minted cue in one pass. The bundle case is the nearest sibling of the baseline and its discriminator turns on how many payloads ride one anchor, so the reader needs both.

direct inverses on the same surface: the stop-signal installs a real subject-controlled exit, while objection-and-exit preclosure names each anticipated exit and pre-answers or reroutes it so no route stays usable.

both make a command unchallengeable by removing what would be needed to evaluate it — function-amnesia voids the payload's rationale while the imperative persists, and semantic ablation dissolves comprehension of the target concept during the active state so no rule remains to violate.

both build verbal repertoires, but verbal-operant teaching directly shapes each naming, asking, or comprehending response by reinforced trials, while derived-relations installation deliberately teaches only a spanning subset and harvests untaught relations under extinction probe.

the constructed addressable object is typically built by the listener, so self-authorship supplies its investment while addressability supplies its later re-access. A reader choosing between them benefits from the split: what makes the object re-navigable versus what makes the payload unresistable.

direct opposites on the closure axis: one refuses the close-down function as a whole-arc property so the installed state stays live, the other pre-loads a targeted removal onto the same kind of cue used to install. Reading either clarifies what the other declines or performs.

opposite operations on the same authority surface: dissolve it so resistance has no addressee, or harden its scope so a challenge route is foreclosed. Both presume authority is in play and a reader choosing between them benefits from seeing the pair.

neighbouring self-maintaining fusions: one welds a category label to a self-firing affect, the other asserts flat identity between distinct concepts until they are interchangeable. Both make partial consent hard, and the tell separating them (affect engine versus declarative equivalence) is worth stating in both places.

two ways of making prior consent cover more than it did: widening a consented term by asserted definitional equivalence, or manipulating the fiction boundary so consent calibrated for the fiction applies to the real payload. Same target (the scope of an existing yes), different instrument.

genuinely confusable where arousal is involved. One lends the credibility of a just-demonstrated involuntary motor effect forward onto an untested claim, sometimes reusing the same phrasing on arousal; the other uses live arousal as the carrier that makes adjacent content land. The direction of borrowing is opposite, and a reader working an arousal-plus-proof passage needs both to pick correctly.

close kin worth cross-reading. Both erect a second addressable party that absorbs the contest and is structurally guaranteed to lose, so opposition has nowhere to land. They split on what is routed: one classifies incoming external commands and reroutes hostile ones onto a sacrificial self; the other installs a standing agent holding real decision authority the subject defers to.

both bind an installed effect to an ongoing condition using so-long-as grammar, so the effect maintains itself with no re-suggestion. They differ in what the condition is: continued trust in the operator, which makes any failure read as insufficient trust, versus a behavior the subject is sustaining right now. A writer reading either will want the contrast.

a sharp opposed pair on the same object, the subject's retained veto. One narrows the operator's own license by declining to proceed when the subject is unfit or unauthorized; the other leaves the veto fully intact and instead shapes every input to pass through it. Same faculty, opposite postures toward it.

real discrimination need: both state a contingency in words in advance, and both use the same when-X-then-Y surface. The split is whether behavior comes under the control of the verbal description itself, bypassing trial and error, or whether a cue is bound to a specified future response that later fires. Easy to mislabel without the contrast.

the most useful contrast in this set. Both are framed around safety and operator restraint, but only one actually constrains the operator: verification blocks the high-stakes act until the state is confirmed, while the assurance move widens effective license because acceptance of the assurance stands down the subject's guard and is never operationalized. Who ends up constrained is the test.

a mirror pair with a clean test. Both hand the subject a felt sense of control to dissolve resistance, but one offers branches that all collapse to the same compliance or operator-served outcome, while the other transfers narrow termination authority and visibly honors it. Whether the transfer is actually honored is the discrimination.

both manage consent by moving the decision point away from the real payload. One completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface before playback so the listener arrives pre-committed; the other manipulates the fiction boundary so consent calibrated for fiction is applied to the real content. A writer auditing where consent was actually given needs both.

both install a general proposition presented as a neutral fact about how minds work, accepted rather than obeyed, and cashed by later content. They differ in what the proposition does: one relocates a threatening state word onto experience the subject already owns so no untouched baseline remains, the other ties a capability or a lifted limit to trance depth. Same acceptance route, different payload.

both make an unwanted loss of control feel good, but one inverts valence by exploiting a pre-existing aversion so yielding registers as relief the listener wanted anyway, while the other pairs each coercive imposition with a benevolent safety rationale in the same breath so involuntariness never stands unframed.

both bind the later self during an earlier window, and the contrast is exactly the foreclosure-versus-evocation line one of them already draws. One pre-assigns a null or aversive outcome to a whole future class of mental acts so the later comparator is deleted; the other restructures a real contingency -- an irreversible act or a non-waivable stake -- so the later self cannot cheaply defect. Deleting the ability to evaluate versus removing the ability to choose.

both convert an abstract faculty or state into a concrete felt object, in opposite directions, which makes them a clean contrasting pair. One narrates the mind's substance as observably degrading and departing the body so cognitive surrender feels watched rather than chosen; the other introduces a persisting tactile substance welded to a state and turned into an adjustable dial. Departure-of-substance versus persisting-gauge is the axis.

the whole-file policy-spec shape is precisely the kind of member the loose whole-arc container is built to hold: a structural property of the entire artifact, uncitable to a single line, non-executable as a session move. Linking them helps a reader see where a specific whole-artifact architecture sits relative to the general grouping. Not a merge -- the container explicitly disclaims a shared mechanism across its members.

both are pre-working-phase moves that fix what the target means before anything depends on it, but one pins an operationally recordable definition and watch-list to reduce observer drift, while the other reconciles operator and subject referents so later instructions land on the state the subject can actually reproduce.

both engineer what survives past the moment, so the contrast is useful. One installs a deliberately asymmetric exit cue that returns the surface state while explicitly preserving the install as dormant; the other builds a coordinated harness where out-of-session cues re-fire the state and each use raises the odds of the next. Preserving an install through a clean exit versus making the install propagate on its own.

both run a self-ratifying escalation loop where each pass uses the prior pass as its evidence base, which is a real shared craft worth cross-reading. They diverge at the top: one confirms and multiplies a growing effect indefinitely, the other reaches a ceiling and flips on a mandated behavior framed as the inevitable overflow of a climb the listener performed. The ceiling-to-command conversion is the added move.

both carry something out of the session into daily life and the boundary between them is worth showing. One assigns a specific concrete waking action whose performance re-evokes the installed content; the other levels the two planes against each other and reclassifies mundane waking time itself as the service realm, with an ever-present re-entry cue. One task versus a reframe of the entire waking plane.

the saturation front-end is literally shared — a rapid stream of attentional demands. They diverge at the payload: one keeps starving the evaluator with sustained load, the other switches to withholding the next pointer so the subject leans in and waits to be directed. Worth the link because the second is best understood as the first repurposed.

both hand an off-switch to the operator, but the named-person gate blocks self-granted RELEASE by collapsing permission onto a non-substitutable proper noun, while the asymmetric lock monopolizes the subject's autonomous EXIT from the state regardless of who holds the key.

both genuinely preserve an exit and constrain the operator, but the agency reminder asserts a standing frame-external power to stop, while the anti-stuck filter appends a narrow caveat to one specific immobility suggestion the listener never consented to as literal inability.

these stack rather than overlap. One narrows what the still-active critical faculty may range over; the other forecloses the channel by which a listener would check whether any of it is working. Reading them together shows a two-layer defense — scope restriction upstream, audit foreclosure downstream — which is how they tend to appear in practice.

ownership language asserts belonging as an identity fact delivered warmly, while sourcing monopoly assigns away the faculty or the existence needed to object — possession claim versus a grant economy that makes refusal structurally incoherent.

both extend a consent the listener already gave, but term-redefinition widens the SCOPE of a word already agreed to via asserted equivalence, while press-play laundering relabels an act, non-act, or circumstance as the yes itself — widening the grant versus manufacturing it.

both move authorship to the subject so there is nothing external to resist, but self-authored-construct leverage relocates authorship of the CONTENT in a single move, while contingency-authorship transfer fades authorship of the reinforcement contingency itself across steps until the subject is both parties.

both fuse real proprioceptive output with the voice's pacing so the body's own motion confirms the verbal frame. One mirrors a narrated fantasy body, the other hides the cadence inside real exercise motion. Same channel-fusion lever at different degrees of disguise.

both empty the thinking channel and both frame the emptying as relief rather than demand. They differ in where cognition goes: one has thought simply depart, the other hands it to the operator who performs it instead. A writer choosing an emptying move should compare them directly.

both are whole-arc closing properties that hand agency back, but one does it at a hard author-signed seam with a coequal inverse aftercare act under a different identity, while the other is an unflagged monotonic decrease in operator authority across the whole runtime.

both recruit parties outside the operator to hold the install, and they chain naturally: joining a happy peer collective sets up being sent out to recruit or publicly avow. Kept separate because one uses a cohort's membership to pull the listener in, and the other sends the listener outward so an audience or third party maintains the state.

both use the same reorientation channels (breath, body awareness, eyes open, looking around) and a reader picking one should understand the other. The difference is who initiates and where it lands: a subject-initiated temporary re-grounding with an explicit path back into the state, versus an operator-paced full return to waking baseline.

both avoid meeting resistance head-on, and one entry's members are already the stated contrast case for the other. One removes the window, existence or object of resistance before an impulse forms; the other applies no counter-force at all and re-aims whatever the subject volunteers. Read together when deciding how to handle an anticipated objection.

both remove the juncture at which a listener could decline, because nothing in the message is presented as opposed to them. One declares the target already settled so refusal would mean disputing one's own biography; the other selects a suggestion the listener already craves so acceptance is pre-loaded. Complementary ways to make a suggestion non-oppositional.

both route the subject's motivation through the operator's person, and the contrast is the useful part: one re-credits the subject's own pleasure to the operator inside a session, the other builds a history in which the operator's presence becomes the cue that evokes the subject's requesting. Sending a reader from one to the other prevents mislabeling a relational dependency as an in-session affect reroute.

both bank a lever now for withdrawal later, and the escrow entry's pre-signed open-ended consent token is the same shape as an obligation seeded long before any specific ask. Useful contrast: one disguises the cost side inside a fairness frame, the other withholds and accumulates a reward or a consent claim to discharge on a condition.

both reify mental content as a manipulable object, but one destroys or discards a container in a discrete operator-executed removal event while the other quantizes a continuous faculty into countable units the listener watches drain indefinitely.

both dissolve attachment to a fixed demand, one by building a substitute route to the outcome the symptom was protecting, the other by climbing the same want upward until the specific behavior stops mattering.

both install a craving that keeps re-arming outside the session, and the discriminator between them is exactly where a classifier slips: appetite framing done in words versus a closed two-cue ring where each leg cues the other. The craving entry already lists closed-loop topology as the sibling to prefer, so the pointer is load-bearing.

the ladder requires real assents the subject performs, each lowering the next rung's cost; the answer-supply loop denies a response window and voices the yeses for them, so no increment is actually granted.

both dispense with verbal suggestion-as-usual, one by miming an empty frame the subject perceptually fills and then defends, the other by speaking a plain suggestion into an already-offline critical faculty supplied by natural sleep.

both remove a defense before it is exercised, and the useful contrast is the target's breadth: one pre-assigns a null or aversive outcome to a whole future class of mental acts, the other identifies the single strongest foreseeable objection and dissolves or decoy-denies that one. Reader choosing between them needs the class-vs-named-objection line.

both put the subject's properties onto an external object and are the primary mis-assignment risk for each other. One keeps the state grammatically the object's so no first-person claim exists to refuse; the other relocates the identity or state so the object becomes the person's address for later control. Unfalsifiability versus addressability is the discriminating question.

both speak of the target in accomplished past tense and both delete the decision point by presupposition, so the grammar alone will not separate them. The split is what follows: one declares the fact settled and asks nothing, the other asks the subject to recall specifics and thereby generates a plan the subject authors. Declaration versus elicited recall.
already discriminated in both entries: quieting empties by letting cognition depart, saturation empties by exceeding the processing budget — a listener kept busy is saturation, not quieting.

both corrupt a precondition of valid agreement rather than extracting a fresh yes. One silently widens the scope of an already-granted consent by stipulating a false equivalence for the consented term; the other inverts the understanding requirement so failure to parse is itself defined as agreeing. Scope widening versus waiver of comprehension.

both operate on antecedents, but discrimination training BUILDS a cue's evocative control through a differential reinforcement history, whereas antecedent manipulation EDITS an already-functioning situation (remove the cue, dissolve the motivating operation, preclude the topography) with no consequence applied at all.

both counterfeit authorization, but future-commitment binding installs a standing rule that genuine future promises extracted under an overwhelm condition are binding, while consent-counterfeit theater fabricates the record of an agreement act the listener never performed at all.

both harvest the listener's own performed behavior as unrepudiable evidence, differing on whether the act is an installed near-involuntary motion banked as consent or genuine prior acts annotated as evidence of a state. Neighboring enough that a writer picks between them.

both convert something already banked into leverage on later asks: real acts relabeled as evidence of a state, versus a foreclosed verification of past trustworthiness banked as spendable capital. Same forward-spending logic on different collateral.

both recruit something already real in the subject to buy credibility, but one weaponizes a live body signal so the falsification loop closes from inside the body, while the other imports an external reflex, memory, ritual, or neighbouring working suggestion as engine or sanction.

a useful contrast for a writer choosing between two ways of removing a failure exit: one feeds the resolving faculty input it cannot resolve until it surrenders, the other rigs the metric so every outcome including no response scores as depth. Both often relabel the same drift as depth, and the tell that separates them is which faculty is targeted.

opposed operations on the same reach dimension, and one is the documented counter to the other: a declared anchor after which later material is framed as un-encodable, versus explicit bounds that carve out prior installs so a standing forget-suggestion cannot reach the current content. A reader assessing whether a series seals or disarms forgetting needs the pair.

both destroy the independence of two states, by opposite routes and with opposite affect: one fuses state variables gradually via a shared verb, count, rhythm, or equivalence ring so neither moves alone; the other fires two established anchors for mutually exclusive states simultaneously, producing overt disorganization until a bridge forms. A reader looking at any collapse of state separability should see the gradual and the forced version together.

both wire arousal into the suggestion economy, but one uses a live arousal state as the carrier that makes separate content stick, while the other closes arousal onto itself so the listener's own utterances re-cause the state with no content payload at all.

both leave a variable deliberately unfilled so the listener supplies it — one blanks WHO is obeyed so any voice occupies the slot, the other blanks WHAT is commanded so the listener's own interpretation generates the act.

both weaponize a structural slot that should protect the listener — the pre-content warning and the closing wake — by making the protective form itself deliver payload or suppress the evaluation window, differing in whether the exit is denied at entry or at exit.

both reify cognition as a manipulable material, and the distinguishing question is ownership and persistence: one narrates the faculty decaying out of the body as an observed departure, the other has the operator take possession of a single externalized object and reuse it as gag and restraint. Close enough that a reader can mis-sort.

two adjacent claims about the operator's relation to the subject's interior: perceiving it as telemetry versus constitutively supplying the faculty needed to object. Both strip standing to deny, by different routes, and the discriminating question is perception versus supply.

both disable a token at the comprehension layer rather than arguing with it, but satiation bleaches meaning through sheer over-repetition of any word, while concept ablation targets one specific concept so the rule the listener would violate no longer parses.

directly opposed handling of the same material: one directs thought-content to depart toward a stilled mind, the other explicitly forbids clearing and trains a notice-and-return observer stance. The non-control instruction is the tell, and a reader can easily mis-file one as the other.

two routes to the same foreclosure: redefining a neutral cognitive category as prohibited or impossible so refusal has nowhere to form, versus assigning the faculty refusal would require to the operator. A reader classifying a resistance-foreclosing move needs both to choose correctly.

both foreclose refusal by handing the listener the appearance of authorship, but at different scopes: one rigs a bounded menu where every branch executes the same compliance; the other installs an open-ended interpretive rule that resolves all future uninstructed choices toward the operator. A reader choosing between a closed rigged choice and an open construction rule benefits from the contrast.

both concern who owns an oscillating or graded state variable, and the discriminators are adjacent: one transfers ownership of the variable to an operator-turned instrument, the other hands the listener a named portable rule for oscillating it. Useful pairing precisely because both sit next to plain fractionation and a reader needs the ownership-versus-template distinction.

both hide the install act, and the return-step framing is arguably one more cover among the concealment inventory. Worth linking so a classifier decides deliberately between the fair-exchange return frame and the broader concealed-install family rather than assigning by habit.

both run on built appetite, but one labels the desire-to-return as a craving in words while the other uses freshly built wanting as the descent engine. The pairing helps a reader see that appetite-as-label and appetite-as-switch are separate levers that often co-occur in the same text.

genuinely adjacent trigger architectures a classifier will confuse: one swaps in a whole labeled alternate personality with a paired release and delegated firing rights; the other installs a set of separately addressable handles onto facets of one state. Both already reference the single cue-response install as their common foil.

both install a one-way asymmetry that makes over-compliance the only success path, and one already names the other as the contrast case: an operator-owned adequacy standard versus a named sleep-onset reflex. The link makes an existing distinction navigable.

both install a portable template the listener carries out of the session rather than a state or a single response: one an oscillation rule attachable to arbitrary variables, the other a multi-step executive routine drilled at decision-point granularity. The template-as-payload framing is the shared, non-obvious point.

old-self discreditation closes the return path by making the prior self disavowed, while identity-congruence leverage recruits a prized self-image the listener already holds so compliance reads as self-chosen — attacking the past self versus enlisting the present one.

both hand the subject a choice that costs the operator nothing, and both convert the pick into commitment. The instructive difference is that one uses binaries that genuinely resolve either way across every axis, training that authority does not depend on the content; the other uses branches that converge on a single predetermined outcome. Writers reaching for a low-stakes choice move should see which kind they mean.

adjacent welds with different targets. One fuses a self-firing affect to category membership so being the label is itself rewarding and violating it is aversive; the other fuses acute reward to a named act, state, token, or voice so compliance becomes self-motivating. Both leave the reward running without the operator present; pick by whether the anchor is an identity or a behavior.

opposite poles of the same arc-shape axis. One refuses the closing function as a deliberate design property so the installed state bleeds past the ending; the other builds a structurally complete, roughly coequal restoration act that mirrors each erasure. Reading them together shows what the refusal is refusing.

real confusion risk worth signposting. Both produce an emptied mind without a refusable command, but one treats the emptiness as the payload and engineers it so no directive exists to refuse, while the other builds the empty space specifically as a pre-staged delivery site for a payload named afterward. Pick by whether something is going to be put in the space.

the feedback weld asserts two real state-variables cause each other in a climbing loop with no exit, whereas anchor-collapse fires two pre-installed anchors for mutually exclusive physiologies at once to destroy their exclusivity through overt disorganization.

both present an itemized ledger that shifts the perceived baseline to already-surrendered, and both make later resistance feel like self-contradiction. The items differ in kind: one enumerates named decision-authorities and reassigns them in the past tense, the other annotates the listener's genuine recent behavior as evidence of a state. Choose by whether the ledger rows are fictive authorities or real acts.
the return itself steps depth down to waking baseline; the settle is the pause-and-ground operation that runs after baseline has already been reached.

two self-reinforcing topologies distinguished by shape. One hands a term forward line by line until a set of distinct words becomes cross-substitutable, so any single node later fires the whole cluster. The other closes the ring outright, with the response re-summoning its own cue source. Open-forward-then-clustered versus closed-loop is the axis to pick along.

both neutralize refusal in advance, and they abut closely at one seam: naming a specific fear and declaring it absent, versus naming the subject's own stop-faculty and deleting it. A reader looking at a passage that names 'brainwashing' or 'I can always wake myself' must decide which of these is on the page. Distinct targets keep them separate: one named objection versus the internal verification faculty as a whole.

both hang on a single token repeated far past normal use, and the tells sit close: sheer count crossing into visible meaning loss, versus one token carrying topic, content, trigger, and delivery key at once. A reader facing a heavily repeated word needs to know which is on the page, especially since saturation can be the delivery vehicle for the architecture. Different units of analysis, so no merge.

both install a verbal rule in advance that governs how later events are read rather than letting experience do the shaping, and the second entry's advance-specification form comes close to the first's pre-installed reading. The separating question is whether later outcomes can disconfirm: one is engineered so no branch can, the other states a real contingency that experience could contradict. Worth the cross-reference, not a merge.

both defeat evaluation by placement rather than content, but one hides a payload inside a consciously-processed carrier so it cannot be located or reassembled, while the other places the identical sentence in a channel or register the evaluator never scans at all.

both convert something coded as loss into something coded as gain. One reranks a worth or motivational ordering so subordination reads as an upgrade; the other names a shame-coded involuntary event precisely in order to overwrite its meaning as success. The contrast is ordering versus single-event interpretation.

both smuggle a persisting modification through a phase the listener experiences as restoration. One is a wake that restores the prior self while carving out and preserving an installed cue; the other returns each surrendered faculty with a modification embedded and framed as part of its nature. The return framing is the shared cover.

direct inverses on the same object: one installs a real subject-controlled off-ramp that halts the state on demand, the other leaves an exit existing but monopolized by an operator condition so autonomous return to baseline is eliminated.

both hold value across time as leverage rather than spending it live. One withholds and banks a reward or a pre-signed consent lever for later discharge on a condition; the other keeps a relational debt balance permanently open by over-repaying. Stored reservoir versus never-settled balance.

both relocate who is driving attention away from the subject, and contrasting the destination is the payoff. One credits the fixation artifact with causal agency for the pull; the other saturates with pointers and then withholds the next one so the subject leans in waiting to be directed. Object as cause versus operator as cause.

the same lever run in opposite directions: unresolved doubt deliberately seeded and left to grow into a durable belief, versus doubt arriving as an accident that re-arms judgment and instantly dissolves an established effect. Useful pairing because it shows doubt as both construction material and solvent.

complementary halves of the same smuggle: one is the outer relabeling wrapper that gets a refused procedure accepted under a harmless name, the other is the payload embedded inside an already-accepted carrier — the wrapper hides the modality, the piggyback hides the content.

directly opposed handling of the same wake-side question, who owns the return. One gates re-access behind an audition the listener must earn, with the criterion left unspecified, and pairs it with recall curated toward the pleasurable parts. The other frames return as the subject's own capability, deliberately can rather than must. Reading them together makes the ownership axis visible.

both design the exit and are best read as a pair. One builds a deliberately collision-proof release that returns the surface state while explicitly preserving the install underneath. The other uses the aftercare surface itself to extend reach, smuggling a propagation clause and a self-rearm carve-out under a caring banner. The diagnostic question in both cases is who is constrained once the move has run.

both borrow the wake-and-drop cycling surface but run it on an axis other than trance depth, which is the reason to see them together. One cycles the listener's certainty about their own state until the criterion for resisting is gone; the other cycles relational stance between control and likeability so willingness rises because the controller is charming. Neither deepens by felt contrast.

sibling operator-side families that a writer will genuinely confuse, so the cross-reference earns its place. One covers everything where the operator learns something about the subject and the payoff lands in the operator's map. The other covers everything where the operator shapes their own transmitted signal, tone, gesture, intonation, or whole-script texture. Neither pushes on the subject's state, which is exactly why the routing needs to be explicit.

adjacent answers to the same design question, where does the authority to object go. One installs an autonomous agent that holds real decision authority the listener defers to and cannot simply reclaim. The other assigns the faculty itself, so objecting would require the cognition or the very existence already granted away. Delegated authority versus supplied constituent.

both build a guided scene, but one exists for present absorption while the other runs the imagery as instrumentation so the operator can read congruence and harvest leverage — the payoff lands in the operator's map.

appetite and craving vocabulary is one of the delivery forms the replay compulsion uses, so the two are commonly co-present. They stay distinct because one points the craving at a state or operator and the other at replaying a specific recording.

both end with the listener owning the attribution, but one has the operator assert the listener's authorship of an act, while the other leaves a category unassigned so the listener applies it privately. Worth one hop for the operator-asserted versus listener-performed contrast.

the reward-remapping entry already names craving-to-return framing as the thing it is not, on the grounds that it lacks exclusivity and a comparator rewrite. That contrast is exactly what a reader needs when choosing between them.

both encode several distinct propositions as a set rather than looping one suggestion, differing in whether ordering and enumeration or relative repetition frequency carries the weight. Direct sibling worth the cross-reference.

quarantine reifies a named internal faculty and strips its standing so rebellion has no agent-locus; the two-target router leaves faculties alone and instead classifies EXTERNAL incoming commands by intent, dispatching hostile ones onto a sacrificial self.

both remove feeling-nothing as grounds for disconfirmation, one by scoring every response as proof and the other by demoting the felt sense as an evidence channel outright. Complementary approaches to the same hole.

tense-mirrored pair: one asserts the target as already settled so no decision point exists, the other projects a specified effect forward by declaration in a way that can observably fail. The contrast clarifies both.

both extend an install beyond the state that produced it, but one asserts persistence across the wake boundary within a genuine return to baseline while the other enumerates a cross-state scope (distinct personas, waking and sleeping) specifically to remove the off-state self as a brake.

both defuse resistance by denying a loaded label its trigger, but one is a systematic framing posture removing dread from first contact while the other is a discrete re-offer of an already-refused intervention under a harmless carrier task.

both protect a belief from disconfirmation, but one forecloses the listener's whole audit channel so any observation confirms, while the other is a discrete act of hiding one specific already-present contradicting fact.

both are operator-side craft rather than subject-state moves, but one structures the running of a parts negotiation or reframe while the other disciplines how the intervention's content and tactics are sourced before anything fires.

both exploit apparent repetition, but one hides a between-pass delta in a single restatement while the other is a spanning architecture that harvests consent where it is cheap and cashes it where it is expensive.

both manufacture agreement without a genuine assent, but one denies the response window and supplies the yes outright, while the other pre-charges the word 'yes' with abstract positive valence before any request is made.

both are operator conduct rules around a load-bearing belief, but one withholds change until downstream fallout is foreseen while the other actively hides a fact that would collapse an effect already running.

both smuggle payloads through a structurally privileged slot, but one grafts an off-theme behavior into the deep window the session produced while the other uses the aftercare and safety surface itself to extend operator reach.

both get returns that outpace the instruction delivered: one installs a frame-plus-question habit whose repertoire gains compound, the other layers a harness so each use raises the odds of the next. Useful together when designing for compounding rather than one-shot effect.

two topological operations on the listener's state space. One welds variables so they co-move and no single-variable exit remains; the other fires two opposing anchors at once to destroy the exclusivity between states. Read together for how state geometry gets reshaped.

the sharpest available contrast on permission-giving: identical surface form, opposite answers to who ends up constrained. One supplies an assurance whose acceptance stands down protective monitoring and widens operator licence; the other is a genuine welfare permission that narrows what the script demands.

both defeat targeted objection by keeping the payload below salience rather than by force. One scatters directives through a carrier stream so they cannot be located or reassembled; the other hides a delta under the appearance of restatement so it reads as already heard.

the tense boundary is the whole distinction and each entry's discriminator already leans on the other: one asserts the target as already complete so no decision point exists, the other previews a not-yet experience so the later experience ratifies the frame. Read as a pair to pick correctly.

direct inverses on the who-is-constrained axis. One blocks the install pending a lived, endorsed trial that can return abort; the other brackets every ask with a denial of compulsion precisely to make the installed craving read as self-authored. The second is the counterfeit of the first.

both deliver structure overtly rather than covertly, and both leave the listener holding something citable afterwards — an ordered enumerated lesson set in one case, a named portable rule that can be re-applied to arbitrary variables in the other. The didactic register is the shared axis.

adjacent self-model surgery, and the ownership boundary is exactly what separates them. One empties the self of properties so refusal has no standing to rest on; the other flips the causality of immobility onto a body declared no longer yours, with the ownership claim engineered to outlast the physical effect.

inverse movements on the same variable: an itemised revocation that reassigns named decision-rights to the operator, versus an unflagged arc that hands authority steadily back until the listener is sole authority on their own state. Instructive as a matched pair.

opposite uses of engineered failure. One arranges a task the listener genuinely cannot pass and then cashes the failure as the target result; the other grants permission to leave one thing undone specifically to counterweight a compulsion the same material installs. The contrast clarifies both.

both run on a lie about the referent that lets an existing check be skipped rather than overcome — a forged token of a normally reliable cue in one, a false benign frame consuming the resistance surface before it forms in the other. The counterfeit-disclaimer register sits close to the boundary, so the pairing earns its place.

both give a state a location so returning to the location returns the state. The split is detachability: one rides real body sensation or a durable mark and cannot be set down, the other builds an imaginal locus with a defended perimeter that distress is defined as outside of.

both concern how a suggestion is transmitted rather than what it says. Register-camouflaged delivery hides content in a channel the listener does not monitor; operator-delivery-craft shapes the operator's own tone, manner and gesture. They meet where wording is held constant and intonation alone carries the directive — worth checking both before coding a covert-delivery case.

protective inverse. One conceals the fact that an install happened so its origin cannot be audited; the other narrows what suggestions may reach, including a variant that explicitly carves out standing forget-suggestions from earlier material. Reading the bounding move clarifies exactly what the concealment move defeats.

both leave the listener to supply the content, and both depend on an internal search firing. One opens the gap by violating expectation or timing in a waking exchange; the other engineers a grammatical absence or impossibility the hearer must repair. Check both when a surprising reply sends the subject inward to work out what was meant.

direct inverse on the same surface: the operator's standing license. One narrows it explicitly with declared off-limits domains and carve-outs; the other widens it covertly by placing a generalization authorization in a slot processed as procedural housekeeping. The pair reads as the honest and the disguised version of one control.

both manufacture a slot in which content lands without review, differing in how the slot is made. One disables the tools for objecting and then states positive claims into the gap; the other declares a venue sealed, operator-exclusive and outside memory so anything edited there inherits unreviewability. Compare when edits are described as happening somewhere the subject cannot look.

they meet at the rigged question. One denies any response window and supplies the answer itself, so no produced response exists; the other pre-maps every reachable option to the same outcome so nothing disconfirms. The variant in which every possible answer increments the same counter sits on the boundary.

they dispute the same object class. One relocates identity, will or a whole state-bundle into an external item so addressing the item addresses the person; the other couples an identity-state to a worn garment with hysteresis and a costly named exit. Decide whether the identity is understood to live in the object or merely to be re-fired by wearing it.

both attach something to a cue; the difference is the payload's size and kind. One drills a multi-step executive procedure at decision-point granularity as the product; the other binds a cue to a discrete future state-change or behavior. Compare when a trigger appears to fire a whole routine rather than a single response.

both occupy the exit slot with a benign payload and are easy to confuse. One fills that slot with a protective directive so no spontaneous negative self-suggestion can form there; the other installs a belief in the subject's own capability to return at will. Code by whether the payload forecloses harm or credits the subject.

adjacent solutions to the same problem of getting a belief accepted without asserting it: one leaves the utterance under-specified so the listener supplies the content, the other lands the appraisal before any independent perception can form. The contrast between listener-authored and pre-empted appraisal is genuinely clarifying.

both build an object engineered to be addressed later, and the boundary between them is exactly what the object contains: a constructed payload given a location versus the listener's own identity or state relocated to live inside it. The pairing is how a reader tells them apart.

both compress repeated material down to a single spoken token that then fires the whole response, differing in whether the compressed object is a multi-step procedure the listener runs on themselves or a single word conditioned by sheer massed repetition. The compression-to-one-token lever is genuinely shared.

both hand the metronome to a bodily rhythm the listener supplies rather than pacing them verbally. Distinguish by whether the rhythm drives eyelid fractionation or hides an induction cadence inside ordinary physical motion.

guided visualization constructs a scene to inhabit; valued-channel induction builds no scene at all and instead picks the subject's strongest representational channel and presupposes it in an opening task, so executing the task is the entry.

both neutralize the off-state self as a brake on an install: one carves the trigger out of an otherwise complete wake, the other scopes the wanting across personas and waking and sleeping. Same escape hatch, two ways of closing it.

genuinely adjacent foreclosure moves a writer must discriminate: one declares the evaluation gate off before the payload, the other forecloses the audit channel so no observation can disconfirm. Turning checking off and making checking useless are close enough that each entry's boundary is clearer with the other in view.

both concern where control of a response sits and how it moves. One has the subject manufacture their own antecedent cue; the other fades an operator-supplied support until the natural cue takes over. A reader choosing a control-transfer route benefits from seeing both handoff shapes.

relabeling is the shared lever and the split is subtle enough to be worth marking: one holds the facts fixed and swaps the evaluative frame so valence flips, the other swaps the name of the modality so a refusal never triggers. Reframing the thing versus renaming the thing is a discrimination a reader will otherwise blur.

both act on the subject's selectivity and the contrast is the point: one leaves the filter fully intact and shapes inputs to pass it, the other deletes or reroutes the internal stop-faculty itself. Seeing them together is what keeps an untouched filter from being described as a disabled one.

both are zero-ramp openers that skip induction work by presupposing something the listener already has: a previously owned trance state in one case, a fluent representational channel in the other. Anyone choosing a low-friction entry benefits from seeing both, and the failure modes contrast usefully (one idles on a first-time listener, the other misfires on a wrong channel read).

both manufacture trust by staging a power dynamic for the target's benefit, but favor theater fabricates an off-stage adversary to create felt debt (it collapses if the empty office is glimpsed), whereas role inversion stages a genuine reversal the target actually enforces, targeting an unfairness prior rather than manufacturing obligation.

both govern what survives the wake. One asserts that installed material persists as a trait inside a genuine return to baseline; the other plants a residue whose decay time is deliberately left unspecified so checking refreshes it. A reader designing carryover wants the pair: a persistence claim and an unfalsifiable fade.

both bypass argument by supplying the frame through non-didactic means, but covert-fact-install occupies the analytical mind with a neutral-seeming lecture that carries the payload inside it, whereas competence-harvest teaches nothing at all — it elicits a real accessed expert experience and renames that as the concept, so acceptance is the subject's own.

both effect the external-to-internal shift at induction and are commonly stacked, but one subtracts the surrounding field as competing input while the other lands the single eyelid-closure act as the gateway event.

both end in performed rather than asserted degradation. One routes a target word through a benign equivalence ring and then collapses into filler that enacts the emptiness it sells; the other has the listener rehearse the actual production loop of a speech-motor deficit. Demonstrate-versus-claim siblings worth reading together.

two self-propagating topologies that need no external prompt per link. One is a forward serial chain where each junction is both reinforcer backward and cue forward; the other is a closed two-cue ring where each leg cues craving for the other. Topology siblings — the contrast between open chain and closed ring is the instructive part.

two whole-work closure architectures whose scope expands until nothing falls outside. One retro-scores all behavior as serving the operator and extends outward through recruitment; the other internalizes detection, reward and punishment until no operator is needed. Complementary end-state architectures — outward-extending versus operator-free.

both compress many actions onto a single invocation, differing on axis. One drills a multi-step procedure with shrinking latency until one lead token runs the whole sequence; the other loads several simultaneous payloads plus a motor command onto one recurring pulse so partial refusal costs more than full compliance. Serial compression versus simultaneous multiplexing.

sequencing relation worth surfacing: one installs a conditioned link by unannounced pairing with no declarative instruction, and the other presupposes an already-live anchor and re-keys or overwrites it, reaching backward across everything that used the cue before. The covert install supplies exactly the precondition the overload assumes.

contrasting contingency structures worth reading together: one delivers the maintaining reinforcer on a clock with no behavioural contingency, the other makes relief from an aversive contingent on responding. Both are commonly confused in practice with positive reinforcement, and the selection question genuinely runs between them.

both hand emergence-side control to the subject rather than the operator: a permissive wake paced by the subject, and a claim about the subject's own ability to return. They pair naturally at the close of a session and are easy to conflate as 'permissive ending'.

both run on an installed or exploited part-self split, but one uses it as a workspace for handling charged material and the other as an epistemic shield that makes self-report unable to disconfirm the install. Same structural precondition, opposite purposes, so the pairing is a genuine disambiguation.

both make giving up agency feel unproblematic: one builds a precedent that ceding decisions is comfortable, the other reframes the change as something happening rather than something done. A reader working on agency framing has real reason to compare precedent-building with agency-reassignment.

both load the exit phase with a claim about future re-entry, and they are the two poles of that slot: one manufactures a compelled need to return, the other frames return as a self-owned capability the listener holds the key to. Useful to a writer choosing which flavor of return-hook to close on.

two forms of covert referent manipulation under a stable surface word: one migrates the grammatical seat that names the listener, the other captures a shared vocabulary item so the operator becomes what it means. Both defeat resistance by removing the marked boundary where an objection could fire; the difference is which referent moves.

both neutralize refusal by relocating something onto an external object, and the boundary is worth reading directly: in one the desired property is grammatically the object's so no first-person claim exists to falsify; in the other the object is declared the active cause of the mind-state so refusing means fighting an object.

near-inverses on the same axis: whether the consent question is re-openable at the point it is spent. One bounds the deal in time and installs a standing channel to renegotiate; the other harvests assent where it is cheap and cashes it where it is expensive, never re-opening. Best read as a contrast pair.

the two operator-side families where nothing is installed on the subject, and the disambiguation is live: one tests whether the operator's own authored procedure or install spec is well-formed and transferable, the other tests or measures the subject so the operator's map updates. A move that changes no subject state belongs to one or the other.

both work the split between the perceiving self and the perceived self rather than collapsing it. One uses a reflective surface so the suggestion returns as something the listener saw for themselves; the other relocates identification upward to the watcher and then strips the proper name. Same structural seam, different payload — evidence versus identity relocation.

both make a protective frame the delivery vehicle for coercion, with the safety later exposed as part of the trap. One narrates each restraint with a benevolent rationale in the same breath so involuntariness reads as care; the other assigns the listener a bystander protector role so the content lands on someone wearing a not-me costume. Same trick at different scopes — line-level framing versus a whole scene role.

both lower felt ownership by relocating agency away from the listener, and both stop short of crediting the operator. One hands authorship to the subject's own internal automatic layer; the other diffuses it into apparatus/machinery via a whole-script register shift. Same question (who did this), different answer.

both hand the subject an interpretation before the experience arrives, but expectancy-seeding previews WHAT will happen so later experience ratifies it, while objection pre-emption targets a specific resistant reading so it never forms.

both run retroactive attribution toward the operator: one via a totalizing clause that retro-scores any behavior as service inside the installed rule-set, the other by reassigning the motive of the listener's own out-of-session self-improvement acts. Overlapping lever, different scope and reach; worth cross-checking when a move scores existing behavior as service.

both leave a question unresolved so the subject's own search does the work, but one withdraws permanently so an unspecified doubt compounds unrebuttable, while the other later drops in an unrelated answer that the primed search makes feel self-discovered.

two amnesia entries separated on different axes and able to co-occur: one is the training FORM (repeatedly asking then dismissing, so the non-answer is conditioned rather than declared), the other is the SHAPE of the resulting gap (everything dropped except one curated surviving token). Reader navigating amnesia moves needs both.

both remove the second-person claim so resistance has no target, but the surrogate is an agent the listener follows and identifies with, while the projection parks the property on a neutral object nobody needs to become.

both stage a receptacle before naming what fills it, so the delivery site pre-exists the content and resistance has no arrival to contest. One builds a persistent, reusable somatic port fused to a body location with a resistance gate; the other clears a transient, content-free mental slot just ahead of one payload.

both pre-license acceptance rather than changing anything now, but content-blind preauthorization removes suggestion-by-suggestion scrutiny inside the ongoing relationship, while forward-dated authorization specifically pre-licenses trait-level rewrites in later sessions.

strong surface overlap: both reify cognition into countable objects that pop. One installs a reusable fill-and-destroy ritual powered by a capacity the operator first validated, aimed at identity-content; the other quantizes a continuous faculty into a self-generated depleting counter with no reset. Neither discriminator currently names the other, so the cross-link is load-bearing.

overlapping on exit control: in the substate toggle neither token returns the subject to waking, so the actual off-switch stays with the operator even though both directions are offered. The other entry names operator-monopolized exit as its whole mechanism. Check both when a state offers movement but no autonomous way out.

both are safety-shaped constraints on the environment, and each already names the other. One gates whether the session may run at all given the listener's situation, stated before induction; the other manages people in the room mid-state so no stray remark acts as a counter-suggestion. Production-permission versus state-protection.

the rouse-by-channel move is a specific case of shaping the operator's own transmitted signal: what carries is the channel property (private, close, individually addressed), not content or volume. The broader entry collects the same operator-output lever across tone, gesture, intonation and whole-script texture. Worth linking in both directions.

both operate on the awake subject's retrospective self-narrative outside the trance frame, but one secures conscious endorsement of an uncovered CAUSE as the curative step while the other legitimizes the session itself against the was-it-real reading.

one is the flagship deployable contingency technique; the other is the design-principle substrate stating how a stimulus's function is assigned by arrangement, where leverage lives, and what onset a consequence needs. Reference-and-instance rather than rivals, but a reader choosing how to schedule a cue should read both.

both dampen the critical faculty before payload, but scope-restriction leaves evaluation running while pre-narrowing what it may range over (the listener still feels they are thinking freely), whereas gate-standdown announces the checking is off, unnecessary, or impossible.

both put a contingency into words in advance rather than letting experience shape behavior, but precommitment sets a non-waivable stake or irreversible act that forecloses the later choice, whereas rule-governed install merely states the contingency so a rule-following repertoire produces the behavior from the description.

both are whole-artifact architecture entries where the file's global shape is the technique rather than any passage in it: one is a policy-specification shape wearing trance grammar, the other saturates a single token across every functional role. A reader classifying an artifact by its overall build should see both.

a whole-script register shift is a whole-artifact structural property of exactly the kind the arc-shape container gathers, and its own discriminator already distinguishes itself from arc-shape by acting on agency attribution rather than state contour. Useful as a sibling pointer; not a merge, since the container explicitly disclaims a shared mechanism.

both relocate the enforcement role into the subject so control persists with no external agent present, and the contrast is sharp and instructive: one is an autonomy-intact self-run loop the subject owns, the other a self-surveillance and forfeiture contract serving the operator. The pairing is the clearest way to teach that boundary.

both foreclose disconfirmation by rigging the scoring rule rather than by pushing a state: one retro-scores any behavior as serving the frame, the other pre-maps every outcome including failure onto success. The shared everything-counts scoring lever is worth the pointer even though the domains differ.

both make a subordinated or denied position read as desirable rather than as a loss, one by reranking the value hierarchy directly and the other by staging a surrogate who is barred from it and longing. Same design problem, two routes; the reader choosing between them benefits.

both convert an act of the listener's own into the engine of descent so that going deeper is inseparable from complying, one via a self-perpetuating reward loop and the other by making a spoken petition the price of each increment. The self-fuelling depth pump is genuinely shared.

two ways of making a suggestion arrive without an addressable target: concealment in an unmonitored register versus grammatical routing through a proxy the listener identifies with. Both already reference the same neighbourhood of deniable-delivery entries, so a reader selecting a delivery channel benefits from seeing them side by side.

one is a deployable arrangement, the other the design constraints governing any such arrangement, including whether a self-delivered consequence has a sharp enough onset to function as one. The reference entry is explicitly the substrate the deployable moves sit on, so the link runs in a genuinely useful direction.

both work by applying no counter-force, but the source of the free ride differs: one re-aims material the subject has volunteered, the other selects a suggestion the subject already wants to hear. Close enough in operator stance that the discriminating question -- volunteered material versus pre-existing want -- is worth stating.

both use a split within the subject as working apparatus rather than as the payload. The discriminating line is real versus invented: one enters and exits a pre-existing or induced split as a workspace, the other fabricates an anatomical partition purely to license bypass. Worth flagging so the fictional variant is not filed as instrumental use.

both defeat a running expectation the listener is actively tracking, and each already distinguishes itself from the same neighbours (sustained content-confusion, fractionation). The dividing line -- a single interrupt with an immediate gap-filling follow-through versus sustained sabotage of the tracking device itself -- is worth keeping visible.

both degrade the speech faculty, but one has the listener motor-rehearse a specific broken production pattern while the other walks a named ladder of categories that reclassifies what speech means without touching production.

both relocate causation for a felt state away from the operator's suggestion, but laundering asserts a plausible benign real cause for an already-running state while the substance form invents a fictional carrier with narrated pharmacology that the listener must imagine.

both ladder 'what is that trying to do for you' up to a superordinate aim, but one is aimed inward at an objecting internal part to convert it into a satisfiable stakeholder, the other outward at negotiating parties to dissolve attachment to a fixed demand.

antecedent siblings that pair constantly in practice: one builds a cue's evocative control through a differential reinforcement history, the other shifts how much the consequence is worth right now without delivering anything.

both hide payload in the perceptual field, but the dual-stream form requires two concurrently authored carriers with decoy and payload roles, while camouflage needs only one unmonitored register — remove the concealment and the camouflage move dies, whereas the dual-stream move still has two tracks.

both partition the listener to place content beyond monitoring, but the audience split is an asserted conscious/subconscious addressing rule that dismisses objections as out-of-scope, while channel partitioning routes output across actual representational modalities so no level owns it.

both reify something internal into an external object, but the parked faculty is set aside for quieting with retrieval implied, while the displaced identity RESIDES in the object so addressing the object addresses the person across sessions.
the grant this entry withdraws; 1321 presupposes the trigger exists and hands off activation authority — this entry takes that authority back from a named delegate
programming-revocation neighbor: 907 voids the effect for everyone via a mirrored off-switch; this entry revokes one delegate's access and keeps the programming
adversarial namesake: 91 strips the LISTENER's decision rights and reassigns them to the operator; this entry strips a THIRD PARTY's granted rights and returns control toward the subject
the access-control sibling in the restrict direction: 1307 binds firing to the operator's voice from install time; this entry returns an already-delegated trigger to that narrower state
bounds a specific named cue-response pair by time; programming-expiration bounds ambient states or programming with no trigger cue.
the expiry here fires on a clock, automatically; trust-gated-trigger-clause binds on a trust/context condition and carries the self-fulfilling loyalty rider a plain time bound never does.
self-executing teardown declared at install vs the functional inverse — teardown gated behind operator judgment or prescribed routes.
bounds an installed trigger's lifetime; depth-capping-time-commitment uses a duration commitment to cap trance depth and involves no trigger.
bounds a cue-response pair inside the hypnotic frame; time-boxed-consent-contract bounds a negotiated agreement, with a subject-invoked renegotiation channel.
deactivation by a pre-declared window that fires on its own vs mirrored-install-removal's targeted removal performed by a later act.

reciprocal of 306's existing crosswalk note: expiry governs whether a trigger fires at all after a window; discrimination training re-sorts stimulus-class membership on the fly, with no bearing on a trigger's lifetime.
opposite pole on the same axis: fuzzy-decay-posthypnotic deliberately refuses to specify decay time so the residue self-refreshes; this states it exactly so the response can actually end.
a permitted drift-to-sleep close genuinely ENDS the session as a comfort endpoint; no-return-terminal-close negates the wakener and seals the state past session end.
an honestly offered sleep option against a fully available wake; loop-hook-non-wake-close disguises a non-wake as a wake to suppress the exit choice and bias restart.
the wake-or-drift binary alone licenses nothing; playlist-preauthorization-handoff's move is the blanket pre-authorization of unheard downstream content wrapped around that ordinary binary.
hands over the choice of exit STATE (wake vs sleep); self-paced-wake-bridge hands over only the TIMING of a wake.
ends a session by permitting sleep; natural-state-suggestion begins one by exploiting sleep the subject was already in.
drift into sleep at emergence; borrowed-reflex-recruitment runs the opposite arc, borrowing the sleep reflex to enter trance at the start.
hazard neighbor: the same sleep crossing this close leaves empty is the delivery channel self-firing-environmental-recurrence loads with a recurrence rule.
direct inverse: this installs/affirms the deeper mind's power to reject harm; named-safety-belief-purge locates that same faculty and deletes, reroutes, or co-opts it.
a genuine net lets the deeper mind reject harm from ANY source; weaponized-transparency-inoculation inverts the frame into a single-channel filter admitting only the operator.
here the protective element actually protects and constrains the operator; in weaponized-safety-framing the safety surface itself carries or licenses the payload.
a real filter keeps the safety verdict revisable in both directions; pre-armored-safety-ratchet one-way-locks the verdict so unsafety can never be registered.
general standing screen keyed on well-being conflict vs anti-stuck-filter's additive caveat welded to one specific immobility suggestion.
